analyzed: tat eva ca āha tasmāt yasmāt prāṇa āśraya tayā eva prāṇa anujñayā abhisaṃniviṣṭāḥ vāc ādi devatāḥ tasmāt yat annam anena prāṇena atti lokaḥ tena annena etāḥ vāc ādyāḥ tṛpyanti vāc ādi āśrayam prāṇam yaḥ veda vāc ādayaḥ ca pañca prāṇa āśrayāḥ iti tam api evam evam ha vai svāḥ jñātayaḥ abhisaṃviśanti vāc ādayaḥ iva prāṇam

original: jñātīnāmāśrayaṇīyo bhavatītyabhiprāyaḥ. abhisaṃniviṣṭānāṃ ca svānām, prāṇavadeva vāgādīnām, svānnena bhartā bhavati; tathā śreṣṭhaḥ; puro'grataḥ, etā gantā, bhavati, vāgādīnāmiva prāṇaḥ; tathā annādo'nāmayāvītyarthaḥ; adhipatiradhiṣṭhāya ca pālayitā svatantraḥ patiḥ prāṇavadeva vāgādīnām; ya evaṃ prāṇaṃ veda tasyaitadyathoktaṃ phalaṃ bhavati.
analyzed: jñātīnām āśrayaṇīyaḥ bhavati iti abhiprāyaḥ abhisaṃniviṣṭānām ca svānām prāṇa vat eva vāc ādīnām sva annena bhartā bhavati tathā śreṣṭhaḥ purogrataḥ etāḥ gantā bhavati vāc ādīnām iva prāṇaḥ tathā anna ādaḥ na āmayāvī iti arthaḥ adhipatiḥ adhiṣṭhāya ca pālayitā svatantraḥ patiḥ prāṇa vat eva vāc ādīnām yaḥ evam prāṇam veda tasya etat yathoktam phalam bhavati

original: kiṃca ya u haivaṃvidaṃ prāṇavidaṃ prati, sveṣu jñātīnāṃ madhye, pratiḥ pratikūlaḥ, bubhūṣati pratispardhībhavitumicchati, so'surā iva prāṇapratispardhino na haivālaṃ na paryāptaḥ, bhāryebhyaḥ bharaṇīyebhyaḥ, bhavati, bhartumityarthaḥ.
analyzed: kiṃca yaḥ u ha evaṃvidam prāṇa vidam prati sveṣu jñātīnām madhye pratiḥ pratikūlaḥ bubhūṣati pratispardhībhavitum icchati sa usurāḥ iva prāṇa pratispardhinaḥ na ha eva alam na paryāptaḥ bhāryebhyaḥ bharaṇīyebhyaḥ bhavati bhartum iti arthaḥ

original: atha punarya eva jñātīnāṃ madhye etamevaṃvidaṃ vāgādaya iva prāṇam, anu anugato bhavati, yo vā etamevaṃvidam, anveva anuvartayanneva, ātmīyānbhāryānbubhūrṣati bhartumicchati, yathaiva vāgādayaḥ prāṇānuvṛttyātmabubhūrṣava āsan; sa haivālaṃ paryāptaḥ, bhāryebhyo bharaṇīyebhyaḥ, bhavati, bhartum, netaraḥ svatantraḥ.
analyzed: atha punar yaḥ eva jñātīnām madhye etam evaṃvidam vāc ādayaḥ iva prāṇam anu anugataḥ bhavati yaḥ vai etam evaṃvidam anu eva anuvartayan eva ātmīyān bhāryān bubhūrṣati bhartum icchati yathā eva vāc ādayaḥ prāṇa anuvṛtti ātma bubhūrṣavaḥ āsan sa ha eva alam paryāptaḥ bhāryebhyaḥ bharaṇīyebhyaḥ bhavati bhartum na itaraḥ svatantraḥ

original: 'so'yāsya āṅgirasaḥ' ityādi yathopanyastamevopādīyate uttarārtham. 'prāṇo vā aṅgānāṃ rasaḥ' ityevamantaṃ vākyaṃ yathāvyākhyātārthameva punaḥ smārayati. katham? --- prāṇo vā aṅgānāṃ rasa iti. prāṇo hi; hi-śabdaḥ prasiddhau; aṅgānāṃ rasaḥ; prasiddhametatprāṇasyāṅgarasatvaṃ na vāgādīnām; tasmādyuktam 'prāṇo vā' iti smāraṇam.
analyzed: āṅgirasaḥ ityādi yathā upanyastam eva upādīyate uttara artham prāṇaḥ vai aṅgānām rasaḥ iti evam antam vākyam yathā vyākhyāta artham eva punar smārayati katham prāṇaḥ vai aṅgānām rasaḥ iti prāṇaḥ hi hi śabdaḥ prasiddhau aṅgānām rasaḥ prasiddham etat prāṇasya aṅga rasa tvam na vāc ādīnām tasmāt yuktam prāṇaḥ vai iti smāraṇam

original: kathaṃ punaḥ prasiddhatvamityata āha --- tasmācchabda upasaṃhārārtha uparitvena saṃbadhyate; yasmādyato'vayavāt, kasmādanuktaviśeṣāt; yasmātkasmāt yataḥ kutaścicca, aṅgāccharīrāvayavādaviśeṣitāt, prāṇaḥ utkrāmatyapasarpati, tadeva tatraiva, tadaṅgaṃ śuṣyati nīrasaṃ bhavati śoṣamupaiti. tasmādeṣa hi vā aṅgānāṃ rasa ityupasaṃhāraḥ.
analyzed: katham punar prasiddha tvam iti atas āha tasmāt śabdaḥ upasaṃhāra arthaḥ uparitvena saṃbadhyate yasmāt yatas vayavāt kasmāt anukta viśeṣāt yasmāt kasmāt yatas kutaścid ca aṅgāt śarīra avayavāt aviśeṣitāt prāṇaḥ utkrāmati apasarpati tat eva tatra eva tat aṅgam śuṣyati nīrasam bhavati śoṣam upaiti tasmāt eṣa hi vai aṅgānām rasaḥ iti upasaṃhāraḥ

original: ataḥ kāryakaraṇānāmatmā prāṇa ityetatsiddham. ātmāpāye hi śeṣo maraṇaṃ syāt. tasmāttena jīvanti prāṇinaḥ sarve. tasmādapāsya vāgādīnprāṇa evopāsya iti samudāyārthaḥ.
analyzed: atas kārya karaṇānām atmā prāṇaḥ iti etat siddham ātma apāye hi śeṣaḥ maraṇam syāt tasmāt tena jīvanti prāṇinaḥ sarve tasmāt apāsya vāc ādīn prāṇaḥ eva upāsyaḥ iti samudāya arthaḥ

original: eṣa u. na kevalaṃ kāryakaraṇayorevātmā prāṇo rūpakarmabhūtayoḥ; kiṃ tarhi? ṛgyajuḥsāmnāṃ nāmabhūtānāmātmeti sarvātmakatayā prāṇaṃ stuvanmahīkarotyupāsyatvāya ---
analyzed: eṣaḥ u na kevalam kārya karaṇayoḥ eva ātmā prāṇaḥ rūpa karma bhūtayoḥ kim tarhi ṛk yajuḥ sāmnām nāma bhūtānām ātmā iti sarva ātmaka tayā prāṇam stuvan mahīkaroti upāsya tvāya

original: ṣaṭtriṃśadakṣarā. anuṣṭupca vāk; katham? 'vāgvā anuṣṭup' iti śruteḥ; sā ca vāganuṣṭubbṛhatyāṃ chandasyantarbhavati; ato yuktam 'vāgvai bṛhatī' iti prasiddhavadvaktum. bṛhatyāṃ ca sarvā ṛco'ntarbhavanti, prāṇasaṃstutvāt; 'prāṇo bṛhatī prāṇa ṛca ityeva vidyāt' iti śrutyantarāt; vāgātmatvāccarcāṃ prāṇe'ntarbhāvaḥ;
analyzed: ṣaṭtriṃśat akṣarā anuṣṭubh ca vāc katham vāc vai anuṣṭubh iti śruteḥ sā ca vāc anuṣṭubh bṛhatyām chandasi antarbhavati atas yuktam vāc vai bṛhatī iti prasiddha vat vaktum bṛhatyām ca sarvāḥ ṛcaḥ ntarbhavanti prāṇa saṃstu tvāt prāṇaḥ bṛhatī prāṇaḥ ṛcaḥ iti eva vidyāt iti śruti antarāt vāc ātma tvāt ca ṛcām prāṇe ntarbhāvaḥ

original: tatkathamityāha --- tasyā vāco bṛhatyā ṛcaḥ, eṣaḥ prāṇaḥ, patiḥ, tasyā nirvartakatvāt; kauṣṭhyāgnipreritamārutanirvartyā hi ṛk; pālanādvā vācaḥ patiḥ; prāṇena hi pālyate vāk, aprāṇasya śabdoccāraṇasāmarthyābhāvāt; tasmādu bṛhaspatiḥ ṛcāṃ prāṇa ātmetyarthaḥ.
analyzed: tat katham iti āha tasyāḥ vācaḥ bṛhatyāḥ ṛcaḥ eṣaḥ prāṇaḥ patiḥ tasyāḥ nirvartaka tvāt kauṣṭhya agni prerita māruta nirvartyā hi ṛc pālanāt vā vācaḥ patiḥ prāṇena hi pālyate vāc a prāṇasya śabda uccāraṇa sāmarthya abhāvāt tasmāt u bṛhaspatiḥ ṛcām prāṇaḥ ātmā iti arthaḥ

original: tathā yajuṣām. katham? eṣa u eva brahmaṇaspatiḥ. vāgvai brahma --- brahma yajuḥ; tacca vāgviśeṣa eva. tasyā vāco yajuṣo brahmaṇaḥ, eṣa patiḥ; tasmādu brahmaṇaspatiḥ --- pūrvavat.
analyzed: tathā yajuṣām katham eṣaḥ u eva brahmaṇaspatiḥ vāc vai brahma brahma yajuḥ tat ca vāc viśeṣaḥ eva tasyāḥ vācaḥ yajuṣaḥ brahmaṇaḥ eṣa patiḥ tasmāt u brahmaṇaspatiḥ pūrvavat

original: kathaṃ punaretadavagamyate bṛhatībrahmaṇoḥ ṛgyajuṣṭvaṃ na punaranyārthatvamiti? ucyate --- vācaḥ ante sāmasāmānādhikaraṇyanirdeśāt 'vāgvai sāma' iti. tathā ca 'vāgvai bṛhatī' 'vāgvai brahma' iti ca vāksamānādhikaraṇayoḥ ṛgyajuṣṭvaṃ yuktam. pariśeṣācca --- sāmnyabhihite ṛgyajuṣī eva pariśiṣṭe. vāgviśeṣatvācca --- vāgviśeṣau hi ṛgyajuṣī;
analyzed: katham punar etat avagamyate bṛhatī brahmaṇoḥ ṛk yajuḥ tvam na punar anya artha tvam iti ucyate vācaḥ ante sāma sāmānādhikaraṇya nirdeśāt vāc vai sāmaḥ iti tathā ca vāc vai bṛhatī vāc vai brahma iti ca vāc samāna adhikaraṇayoḥ ṛk yajuḥ tvam yuktam pariśeṣāt ca sāmni abhihite ṛk yajuṣī eva pariśiṣṭe vāc viśeṣa tvāt ca vāc viśeṣau hi ṛk yajuṣī

original: tasmāttayorvācā samānādhikaraṇatā yuktā. aviśeṣaprasaṅgācca --- 'sāma' 'udgīthaḥ' iti ca spaṣṭaṃ viśeṣābhidhānatvam, tathā bṛhatībrahmaśabdayorapi viśeṣābhidhānatvaṃ yuktam; anyathā anirdhāritaviśeṣayorānarthakyāpatteśca, viśeṣābhidhānasya vāṅmātratve cobhayatra paunaruktyāt; ṛgyajuḥsāmodgīthaśabdānāṃ ca śrutiṣvevaṃ kramadarśanāt.
analyzed: tasmāt tayoḥ vācā samāna adhikaraṇa tā yuktā aviśeṣa prasaṅgāt ca sāmaḥ udgīthaḥ iti ca spaṣṭam viśeṣa abhidhāna tvam tathā bṛhatī brahma śabdayoḥ api viśeṣa abhidhāna tvam yuktam anyathā anirdhārita viśeṣayoḥ ānarthakya āpatteḥ ca viśeṣa abhidhānasya vāc mātra tve ca ubhayatra paunaruktyāt ṛk yajuḥ sāma udgītha śabdānām ca śrutiṣu evam krama darśanāt

original: eṣa u eva sāma. kathamityāha --- vāgvai sā yatkiṃcitstrīśabdābhidheyaṃ sā vāk; sarvastrīśabdābhidheyavastuviṣayo hi sarvanāma-sā-śabdaḥ; tathā ama eṣa prāṇaḥ; sarvapuṃśabdābhidheyavastuviṣayo'maḥ-śabdaḥ; 'kena me pauṃsnāni nāmānyāpnoṣīti, prāṇeneti brūyāt; kena me strīnāmānīti, vācā' iti śrutyantarāt; vākprāṇābhidhānabhūto'yaṃ sāmaśabdaḥ.
analyzed: eṣaḥ u eva sāma katham iti āha vāc vai sā yat kiṃcid strī śabda abhidheyam sā vāc sarva strī śabda abhidheya vastu viṣayaḥ hi sarvanāmasā śabdaḥ tathā amaḥ eṣa prāṇaḥ sarva pum śabda abhidheya vastu viṣayaḥ umaḥ śabdaḥ kena me pauṃsnāni nāmāni āpnoṣi iti prāṇena iti brūyāt kena me strī nāmāni iti vācā iti śruti antarāt vāc prāṇa abhidhāna bhūtaḥ ayam sāma śabdaḥ

original: tathā prāṇanirvartyasvarādisamudāyamātraṃ gītiḥ sāmaśabdenābhidhīyate; ato na prāṇavāgvyatirekeṇa sāmanāmāsti kiṃcit, svaravarṇādeśca prāṇanirvartyatvātprāṇatantratvācca. eṣa u eva prāṇaḥ sāma. yasmāt sāma sāmeti vākprāṇātmakam --- sā cāmaśceti, tat tasmāt sāmno gītirūpasya svarādisamudāyasya sāmatvaṃ tat pragītaṃ bhuvi.
analyzed: tathā prāṇa nirvartya svara ādi samudāya mātram gītiḥ sāma śabdena abhidhīyate atas na prāṇa vāc vyatirekeṇa sāma nāma asti kiṃcid svara varṇa ādeḥ ca prāṇa nirvartya tvāt prāṇa tantra tvāt ca eṣaḥ u eva prāṇaḥ sāma yasmāt sāma sāma iti vāc prāṇa ātmakam sā ca amaḥ ca iti tat tasmāt sāmnaḥ gīti rūpasya svara ādi samudāyasya sāma tvam tat pragītam bhuvi

original: yat u eva samaḥ tulyaḥ sarveṇa vakṣyamāṇena prakāreṇa, tasmādvā sāmetyanena saṃbandhaḥ. vā-śabdaḥ sāmaśabdalābhanimittaprakārāntaranirdeśasāmarthyalabhyaḥ.
analyzed: yat u eva samaḥ tulyaḥ sarveṇa vakṣyamāṇena prakāreṇa tasmāt vā sāma iti anena saṃbandhaḥ vā śabdaḥ sāma śabda lābha nimitta prakāra antara nirdeśa sāmarthya labhyaḥ

original: kena punaḥ prakāreṇa prāṇasya tulyatvamityucyate --- samaḥ pluṣiṇā puttikāśarīreṇa, samo maśakena maśakaśarīreṇa, samo nāgena hastiśarīreṇa, sama ebhistribhirlokaiḥ trailokyaśarīreṇa prājāpatyena, samo'nena jagadrūpeṇa hairaṇyagarbheṇa. puttikādiśarīreṣu gotvādivatkātsnryena parisamāpta iti samatvaṃ prāṇasya, na punaḥ śarīramātraparimāṇenaiva;
analyzed: kena punar prakāreṇa prāṇasya tulya tvam iti ucyate samaḥ pluṣiṇā puttikā śarīreṇa samaḥ maśakena maśaka śarīreṇa samaḥ nāgena hasti śarīreṇa samaḥ ebhiḥ tribhiḥ lokaiḥ trailokya śarīreṇa prājāpatyena samaḥ unena jagat rūpeṇa hairaṇyagarbheṇa puttikā ādi śarīreṣu go tva ādi vat kātsnryena parisamāptaḥ iti sama tvam prāṇasya na punar śarīra mātra parimāṇena eva

original: evaṃ samatvātsāmākhyaṃ prāṇaṃ veda yaḥ śrutiprakāśitamahattvaṃ tasyaitatphalam --- aśnute vyāpnoti, sāmnaḥ prāṇasya, sāyujyaṃ sayugbhāvaṃ samānadehendriyābhimānatvam, sālokyaṃ samānalokatāṃ vā, bhāvanāviśeṣataḥ, ya evametat yathoktaṃ sāma prāṇaṃ veda --- ā prāṇātmābhimānābhivyakterupāste ityarthaḥ.

original: 'puṇyo vai puṇyena karmaṇā bhavati' 'taṃ vidyākarmaṇī samanvārabhete' 'mantā boddhā kartā vijñānātmā puruṣaḥ' ityevamādiśrutismṛtinyāyebhyaḥ parasmādvilakṣaṇo'nyaḥ saṃsāryavagamyate; tadvilakṣaṇaśca paraḥ 'sa eṣa neti neti' 'aśanāyādyatyeti' 'ya ātmāpahatapāpmā vijaro vimṛtyuḥ' 'etasya vā akṣarasya praśāsane' ityādiśrutibhyaḥ;

original: 'so'nveṣṭavyaḥ sa vijijñāsitavyaḥ' 'taṃ viditvā na lipyate' 'brahmavidāpnoti param' 'ekadhaivānudraṣṭavyametat' 'yo vā etadakṣaraṃ gārgyaviditvā' 'tameva dhīro vijñāya' 'praṇavo dhanuḥ, śarohyātmā, brahma tallakṣyamucyate' ityādikarmakartṛnirdeśācca; mumukṣośca gatimārgaviśeṣadeśopadeśāt;
analyzed: saḥ unveṣṭavyaḥ sa vijijñāsitavyaḥ tam viditvā na lipyate brahma vidā āpnoti param ekadhā eva anudraṣṭavyam etat yaḥ vai etat akṣaram gārgi a viditvā tam eva dhīraḥ vijñāya praṇavaḥ dhanuḥ śaraḥ hi ātmā brahma tat lakṣyam ucyate iti ādi karma kartṛ nirdeśāt ca mumukṣoḥ ca gati mārga viśeṣa deśa upadeśāt

original: asati bhede kasya kuto gatiḥ syāt? tadabhāve ca dakṣiṇottaramārgaviśeṣānupapattiḥ gantavyadeśānupapattiśceti; bhinnasya tu parasmāt ātmanaḥ sarvametadupapannam; karmajñānasādhanopadeśācca --- bhinnaścedbrahmaṇaḥ saṃsārī syāt, yuktastaṃ pratyabhyupadayaniḥśreyasasādhanayoḥ karmajñānayorupadeśaḥ, neśvarasya āptakāmatvāt;
analyzed: asati bhede kasya kutas gatiḥ syāt tad abhāve ca dakṣiṇa uttara mārga viśeṣa anupapattiḥ gantavya deśa anupapattiḥ ca iti bhinnasya tu parasmāt ātmanaḥ sarvam etat upapannam karma jñāna sādhana upadeśāt ca bhinnaḥ ced brahmaṇaḥ saṃsārī syāt yuktaḥ tam prati abhyupadaya niḥśreyasa sādhanayoḥ karma jñānayoḥ upadeśaḥ na īśvarasya āpta kāma tvāt

original: tasmādyuktaṃ brahmeti brahmabhāvī puruṣa ucyata iti cet --- na, brahmopadeśānarthakyaprasaṅgāt --- saṃsārī cedbrahmabhāvī abrahma san, viditvātmānameva ahaṃ brahmāsmīti, sarvamabhavat; tasya saṃsāryātmavijñānādeva sarvātmabhāvasya phalasya siddhatvātparabrahmopadeśasya dhruvamānarthakyaṃ prāptam.
analyzed: tasmāt yuktam brahma iti brahma bhāvī puruṣaḥ ucyate iti ced na brahma upadeśa ānarthakya prasaṅgāt saṃsārī ced brahma bhāvī abrahma san viditvā ātmānam eva aham brahma asmi iti sarvam abhavat tasya saṃsāri ātma vijñānāt eva sarva ātma bhāvasya phalasya siddha tvāt para brahma upadeśasya dhruvam ānarthakyam prāptam

original: tadvijñānasya kvacitpuruṣārthasādhane'viniyogātsaṃsāriṇa eva --- ahaṃ brahmāsmīti --- brahmatvasaṃpādanārtha upadeśa iti cet --- anirjñāte hi brahmasvarūpe kiṃ saṃpādayet --- ahaṃ brahmāsmīti? nirjñātalakṣaṇe hi brahmaṇi śakyā saṃpatkartum --- na 'ayamātmā brahma' 'yatsākṣādaparokṣādbrahma' 'ya ātmā' 'tatsatyaṃ sa ātmā' 'brahmavidāpnoti param' iti
analyzed: tad vijñānasya kvacid puruṣa artha sādhane viniyogāt saṃsāriṇaḥ eva aham brahma asmi iti brahmatva saṃpādana arthaḥ upadeśaḥ iti ced anirjñāte hi brahma svarūpe kim saṃpādayet aham brahma asmi iti nirjñāta lakṣaṇe hi brahmaṇi śakyā saṃpad kartum na ayam ātmā brahma yat sākṣāt aparokṣāt brahma yaḥ ātmā tat satyam saḥ ātmā brahma vidā āpnoti param iti

original: prakṛtya 'tasmādvā etasmādātmanaḥ' iti sahasraśo brahmātmaśabdayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyāt ekārthatvamevetyavagamyate; anyasya vai anyatra saṃpat kriyate, naikatve; 'idaṃ sarvaṃ yadayamātmā' iti ca prakṛtasyaiva draṣṭavyasyātmana ekatvaṃ darśayati; tasmānnātmano brahmatvasaṃpadupapattiḥ. na cāpyanyatprayojanaṃ brahmopadeśasya gamyate;
analyzed: prakṛtya tasmāt vai etasmāt ātmanaḥ iti sahasraśas brahma ātma śabdayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyāt eka artha tvam eva iti avagamyate anyasya vai anyatra saṃpad kriyate na ekatve idam sarvam yat ayam ātmā iti ca prakṛtasya eva draṣṭavyasya ātmanaḥ ekatvam darśayati tasmāt na ātmanaḥ brahmatva saṃpad upapattiḥ na ca api anyat prayojanam brahma upadeśasya gamyate

original: 'brahma veda brahmaiva bhavati' 'abhayaṃ hi janaka prāpto'si' 'abhayaṃ hi vai brahma bhavati' iti ca tadāpattiśravaṇāt. saṃpattiścet, tadāpattirna syāt. na hyanyasyānyabhāva upapadyate. vacanāt, saṃpatterapi tadbhāvāpattiḥ syāditi cet, na, saṃpatteḥ pratyayamātratvāt. vijñānasya ca mithyājñānanivartakatvavyatirekeṇākārakatvamityavocāma.
analyzed: brahma veda brahmā eva bhavati abhayam hi janaka prāptaḥ usi abhayam hi vai brahma bhavati iti ca tad āpatti śravaṇāt saṃpattiḥ ced tad āpattiḥ na syāt na hi anyasya anya bhāvaḥ upapadyate vacanāt saṃpatteḥ api tad bhāva āpattiḥ syāt iti ced na saṃpatteḥ pratyaya mātra tvāt vijñānasya ca mithyājñāna nivartaka tva vyatirekeṇa ākāraka tvam iti avocāma

original: na ca vacanaṃ vastunaḥ sāmarthyajanakam. jñāpakaṃ hi śāstraṃ na kārakamiti sthitiḥ. 'sa eṣa iha praviṣṭaḥ' ityādivākyeṣu ca parasyaiva praveśa iti sthitam. tasmādbrahmeti na brahmabhāvipuruṣakalpanā sādhvī.

original: yattu ṛṇaiḥ pratibadhyata iti, tanna, avidyāvadviṣayatvāt --- avidyāvānhi ṛṇī, tasya kartṛtvādyupapatteḥ, 'yatra vā anyadiva syāttatrānyo'nyatpaśyet' iti hi vakṣyati --- ananyat sadvastu ātmākhyaṃ yatrāvidyāyāṃ satyāmanyadiva syāt timirakṛtadvitīyacandravat tatrāvidyākṛtānekakārakāpekṣaṃ darśanādikarma tatkṛtaṃ phalaṃ ca darśayati,
analyzed: yat tu ṛṇaiḥ pratibadhyate iti tat na avidyāvat viṣaya tvāt avidyāvān hi ṛṇī tasya kartṛ tva ādi upapatteḥ yatra vā anyat iva syāt tatra anyonyam paśyet iti hi vakṣyati ananyat sat vastu ātma ākhyam yatra avidyāyām satyām anyat iva syāt timira kṛta dvitīya candra vat tatra avidyā kṛta aneka kāraka apekṣam darśana ādi karma tad kṛtam phalam ca darśayati

original: tatrānyo'nyatpaśyedityādinā; yatra punarvidyāyāṃ satyāmavidyākṛtānekatvabhramaprahāṇam, 'tatkena kaṃ paśyet' iti karmāsaṃbhavaṃ darśayati, tasmādavidyāvadviṣaya eva ṛṇitvam, karmasaṃbhavāt, netaratra. etaccottaratra vyācikhyāsiṣyamāṇaireva vākyairvistareṇa pradarśayiṣyāmaḥ.
analyzed: tatra anyonyam paśyet ityādinā yatra punar vidyāyām satyām avidyā kṛta anekatva bhrama prahāṇam tat kena kam paśyet iti karma asaṃbhavam darśayati tasmāt avidyāvat viṣayaḥ eva ṛṇi tvam karma saṃbhavāt na itaratra etat ca uttaratra vyācikhyāsiṣyamāṇaiḥ eva vākyaiḥ vistareṇa pradarśayiṣyāmaḥ

original: tadyathehaiva tāvat --- atha yaḥ kaścidabrahmavit, anyāmātmano vyatiriktāṃ yāṃ kāṃciddevatām, upāste stutinamaskārayāgabalyupahārapraṇidhānadhyānādinā upa āste tasyā guṇabhāvamupagamya āste --- anyo'sāvanātmā mattaḥ pṛthak, anyo'hamasmyadhikṛtaḥ, mayā asmai ṛṇivatpratikartavyam --- ityevaṃpratyayaḥ sannupāste, na sa itthaṃpratyayaḥ veda vijānāti
analyzed: tat yathā iha eva tāvat atha yaḥ kaścid a brahma vid anyām ātmanaḥ vyatiriktām yām kāṃcid devatām upāste stuti namaskāra yāga bali upahāra praṇidhāna dhyāna ādinā upa āste tasyāḥ guṇa bhāvam upagamya āste anyaḥ asau anātmā mattaḥ pṛthak anyaḥ aham asmi adhikṛtaḥ mayā asmai ṛṇi vat pratikartavyam iti evaṃpratyayaḥ san upāste na saḥ itthaṃpratyayaḥ veda vijānāti

original: tattvam. na sa kevalamevaṃbhūtaḥ avidvān avidyādoṣavāneva, kiṃ tarhi, yathā paśuḥ gavādiḥ vāhanadohanādyupākārairupabhujyate, evaṃ saḥ ityādyanekopakārairupabhoktavyatvāt ekaikena devādīnām; ataḥ paśuriva sarvārtheṣu karmasvadhikṛta ityarthaḥ.
analyzed: tattvam na sa kevalam evaṃbhūtaḥ avidvān avidyā doṣavān eva kim tarhi yathā paśuḥ gavādiḥ vāhana dohana ādi upākāraiḥ upabhujyate evam saḥ ityādi aneka upakāraiḥ upabhoktavya tvāt ekaikena deva ādīnām atas paśuḥ iva sarva artheṣu karmasu adhikṛtaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: etasya hi aviduṣo varṇāśramādipravibhāgavato'dhikṛtasya karmaṇo vidyāsahitasya kevalasya ca śāstroktasya kāryaṃ manuṣyatvādiko brahmānta utkarṣaḥ; śāstroktaviparītasya ca svābhāvikasya kāryaṃ manuṣyatvādika eva sthāvarānto'pakarṣaḥ; yathā caitat tathā 'atha trayo vāva lokāḥ' ityādinā vakṣyāmaḥ kṛtsnenaivādhyāyaśeṣeṇa.
analyzed: etasya hi aviduṣaḥ varṇa āśrama ādi pravibhāgavatā adhikṛtasya karmaṇaḥ vidyā sahitasya kevalasya ca śāstra uktasya kāryam manuṣya tva ādikaḥ brahma antaḥ utkarṣaḥ śāstra ukta viparītasya ca svābhāvikasya kāryam manuṣya tva ādikaḥ eva sthāvara anta upakarṣaḥ yathā ca etat tathā atha trayaḥ vāva lokāḥ ityādinā vakṣyāmaḥ kṛtsnena eva adhyāya śeṣeṇa

original: vidyāyāśca kāryaṃ sarvātmabhāvāpattirityetat saṃkṣepato darśitam. sarvā hi iyamupaniṣat vidyāvidyāvibhāgapradarśanenaivopakṣīṇā. yathā ca eṣo'rthaḥ kṛtsnasya śāstrasya tathā pradarśayiṣyāmaḥ.
analyzed: vidyāyāḥ ca kāryam sarva ātma bhāva āpattiḥ iti etat saṃkṣepataḥ darśitam sarvā hi iyam upaniṣad vidyā avidyā vibhāga pradarśanena eva upakṣīṇā yathā ca eṣaḥ ṛthaḥ kṛtsnasya śāstrasya tathā pradarśayiṣyāmaḥ

original: yasmādevam, tasmādavidyāvantaṃ puruṣaṃ prati devā īśata eva vighnaṃ kartum anugrahaṃ ca ityetaddarśayati --- yathā ha vai loke, bahavo go'śvādayaḥ paśavaḥ manuṣyaṃ svāminamātmanaḥ adhiṣṭhātāraṃ bhuñjyuḥ pālayeyuḥ, evaṃ bahupaśusthānīyaḥ ekaikaḥ avidvānpuruṣaḥ devān --- devāniti pitrādyupalakṣaṇārtham --- bhunakti pālayatīti --- ime indrādayaḥ anye
analyzed: yasmāt evam tasmāt avidyāvantam puruṣam prati devāḥ īśate eva vighnam kartum anugraham ca iti etat darśayati yathā ha vai loke bahavaḥ go śva ādayaḥ paśavaḥ manuṣyam svāminam ātmanaḥ adhiṣṭhātāram bhuñjyuḥ pālayeyuḥ evam bahu paśu sthānīyaḥ ekaikaḥ avidvān puruṣaḥ devān devān iti pitṛ ādi upalakṣaṇa artham bhunakti pālayati iti ime indra ādayaḥ anye

original: matto mameśitāraḥ bhṛtya ivāhameṣāṃ stutinamaskārejyādinā ārādhanaṃ kṛtvā abhyudayaṃ niḥśreyasaṃ ca tatprattaṃ phalaṃ prāpsyāmītyevamabhisaṃdhiḥ.
analyzed: mattaḥ mama īśitāraḥ bhṛtyaḥ iva aham eṣām stuti namaskāra ijyā ādinā ārādhanam kṛtvā abhyudayam niḥśreyasam ca tad prattam phalam prāpsyāmi iti evam abhisaṃdhiḥ

original: tatra loke bahupaśumato yathā ekasminneva paśāvādīyamāne vyāghrādinā apahriyamāṇe mahadapriyaṃ bhavati, tathā bahupaśusthānīya ekasminpuruṣe paśubhāvāt vyuttiṣṭhati, apriyaṃ bhavatīti --- kiṃ citram --- devānām, bahupaśvapaharaṇa iva kuṭumbinaḥ. tasmādeṣāṃ tanna priyam; kiṃ tat? yadetadbrahmātmattvaṃ kathaṃcana manuṣyā vidyuḥ vijānīyuḥ.
analyzed: tatra loke bahu paśumataḥ yathā ekasmin eva paśau ādīyamāne vyāghra ādinā apahriyamāṇe mahat apriyam bhavati tathā bahu paśu sthānīye ekasmin puruṣe paśu bhāvāt vyuttiṣṭhati apriyam bhavati iti kim citram devānām bahu paśu apaharaṇe iva kuṭumbinaḥ tasmāt eṣām tat na priyam kim tat yat etat brahma ātmattvam kathaṃcana manuṣyāḥ vidyuḥ vijānīyuḥ

original: tathā ca smaraṇamanugītāsu bhagavato vyāsasya --- 'kriyāvadbhirhi kaunteya devalokaḥ samāvṛtaḥ. na caitadiṣṭaṃ devānāṃ martyairuparivartanam' iti. ato devāḥ paśūniva vyāghrādibhyaḥ, brahmavijñānādvighnamācikīrṣanti --- asmadupabhogyatvānmā vyuttiṣṭheyuriti. yaṃ tu mumocayiṣanti, taṃ śraddhādibhiryokṣyanti, viparītamaśraddhādibhiḥ.
analyzed: tathā ca smaraṇam anugītāsu bhagavataḥ vyāsasya kriyāvadbhiḥ hi kaunteya deva lokaḥ samāvṛtaḥ na ca etat iṣṭam devānām martyaiḥ uparivartanam iti atas devāḥ paśūn iva vyāghra ādibhyaḥ brahma vijñānāt vighnam ācikīrṣanti asmat upabhogya tvāt mā vyuttiṣṭheyuḥ iti yam tu mumocayiṣanti tam śraddhā ādibhiḥ yokṣyanti viparītam aśraddhā ādibhiḥ

original: tasmānmumukṣurdevārādhanaparaḥ śraddhābhaktiparaḥ praṇeyo'pramādī syāt vidyāprāptiṃ prati vidyāṃ pratīti vā kākvaitatpradarśitaṃ bhavati devāpriyavākyena.
analyzed: tasmāt mumukṣuḥ deva ārādhana paraḥ śraddhā bhakti paraḥ praṇeya upramādī syāt vidyā prāptim prati vidyām prati iti vā kākvā etat pradarśitam bhavati deva apriya vākyena

original: sūtritaḥ śāstrārthaḥ --- 'ātmetyevopāsīta' iti; tasya ca vyācikhyāsitasya sārthavādena 'tadāhuryadbrahmavidyayā' ityādinā saṃbandhaprayojane abhihite; avidyāyāśca saṃsārādhikārakāraṇatvamuktam --- 'atha yo'nyāṃ devatāmupāste' ityādinā; tatra avidvān ṛṇī paśuvaddevādikarmakartavyatayā paratantra ityuktam.
analyzed: sūtritaḥ śāstra arthaḥ ātmā iti eva upāsīta iti tasya ca vyācikhyāsitasya sārthavādena tat āhuḥ yat brahma vidyayā ityādinā saṃbandha prayojane abhihite avidyāyāḥ ca saṃsāra adhikāra kāraṇatvam uktam atha yonyām devatām upāste ityādinā tatra avidvān ṛṇī paśu vat deva ādi karma kartavyatayā paratantraḥ iti uktam

original: kiṃ punardevādikarmakartavyatve nimittam? varṇā āśramāśca; tatra ke varṇā ityata idamārabhyate --- yannimittasaṃbaddheṣu karmasu ayaṃ paratantra evādhikṛtaḥ saṃsarati. etasyaivārthasya pradarśanāya agnisargānantaramindrādisargo noktaḥ; agnestu sargaḥ prajāpateḥ sṛṣṭiparipūraṇāya pradarśitaḥ; ayaṃ ca indrādisargaḥ tatraiva draṣṭavyaḥ, taccheṣatvāt;
analyzed: kim punar deva ādi karma kartavya tve nimittam varṇāḥ āśramāḥ ca tatra ke varṇāḥ iti atas idam ārabhyate yat nimitta saṃbaddheṣu karmasu ayam paratantraḥ eva adhikṛtaḥ saṃsarati etasya eva arthasya pradarśanāya agni sarga anantaram indra ādi sargaḥ na uktaḥ agneḥ tu sargaḥ prajāpateḥ sṛṣṭi paripūraṇāya pradarśitaḥ ayam ca indra ādi sargaḥ tatra eva draṣṭavyaḥ tad śeṣa tvāt

original: iha tu sa evābhidhīyate aviduṣaḥ karmādhikārahetupradarśanāya.
analyzed: iha tu saḥ eva abhidhīyate a viduṣaḥ karma adhikāra hetu pradarśanāya

original: brahma vā idamagra āsīt --- yadagniṃ sṛṣṭvā agnirūpāpannaṃ brahma --- brāhmaṇajātyabhimānāt brahmetyabhidhīyate --- vai, idaṃ kṣatrādijātam, brahmaiva, abhinnamāsīt, ekameva --- na āsītkṣatrādibhedaḥ. tat brahmaikaṃ kṣatrādiparipālayitrādiśūnyaṃ sat, na vyabhavat na vibhūtavat karmaṇe nālamāsīdityarthaḥ.
analyzed: brahma vai idam agre āsīt yat agnim sṛṣṭvā agni rūpa āpannam brahma brāhmaṇa jāti abhimānāt brahma iti abhidhīyate vai idam kṣatra ādi jātam brahma eva abhinnam āsīt ekam eva na āsīt kṣatra ādi bhedaḥ tat brahma ekam kṣatra ādi paripālayitṛ ādi śūnyam sat na vyabhavat na vibhūta vat karmaṇe na alam āsīt iti arthaḥ

original: tatastadbrahma --- brāhmaṇo'smi mametthaṃ kartavyamiti brāhmaṇajātinimittaṃ karma cikīrṣuḥ ātmanaḥ karmakartṛtvavibhūtyai, śreyorūpaṃ praśastarūpam, ati asṛjata atiśayena asṛjata sṛṣṭavat. kiṃ punastat, yatsṛṣṭam? kṣatraṃ kṣatriyajātiḥ; tadvyaktibhedena pradarśayati --- yānyetāni prasiddhāni loke, devatrā deveṣu, kṣattrāṇīti --- jātyākhyāyāṃ pakṣe
analyzed: tatas tat brahma brāhmaṇaḥ asmi mama ittham kartavyam iti brāhmaṇa jāti nimittam karma cikīrṣuḥ ātmanaḥ karma kartṛ tva vibhūtyai śreyaḥ rūpam praśasta rūpam ati asṛjata atiśayena asṛjata sṛṣṭa vat kim punar tat yat sṛṣṭam kṣatram kṣatriya jātiḥ tad vyakti bhedena pradarśayati yāni etāni prasiddhāni loke devatrā deveṣu kṣattrāṇi iti jāti ākhyāyām pakṣe

original: bahuvacanasmaraṇāt vyaktibahutvādvā bhedopacāreṇa --- bahuvacanam. kāni punastānītyāha --- tatrābhiṣiktā eva viśeṣato nirdiśyante --- indro devānāṃ rājā, varuṇo yādasām, somo brāhmaṇānām, rudraḥ paśūnām, parjanyo vidyudādīnām, yamaḥ pitṛṇām, mṛtyuḥ rogādīnām, īśāno bhāsām --- ityevamādīni deveṣu kṣatrāṇi.
analyzed: bahuvacana smaraṇāt vyakti bahu tvāt vā bheda upacāreṇa bahuvacanam kāni punar tāni iti āha tatra abhiṣiktāḥ eva viśeṣataḥ nirdiśyante indraḥ devānām rājā varuṇaḥ yādasām somaḥ brāhmaṇānām rudraḥ paśūnām parjanyaḥ vidyut ādīnām yamaḥ pitṛṇām mṛtyuḥ roga ādīnām īśānaḥ bhāsām iti evamādīni deveṣu kṣatrāṇi

original: tadanu indrādikṣatradevatādhiṣṭhitāni manuṣyakṣatrāṇi somasūryavaṃśyāni purūravaḥprabhṛtīni sṛṣṭānyeva draṣṭavyāni; tadartha eva hi devakṣatrasargaḥ prastutaḥ. yasmāt brahmaṇā atiśayena sṛṣṭaṃ kṣatram, tasmātkṣatrātparaṃ nāsti brāhmaṇajāterapi niyantṛ;
analyzed: tadanu indra ādi kṣatra devatā adhiṣṭhitāni manuṣya kṣatrāṇi soma sūrya vaṃśyāni purūravaḥ prabhṛtīni sṛṣṭāni eva draṣṭavyāni tad arthaḥ eva hi deva kṣatra sargaḥ prastutaḥ yasmāt brahmaṇā atiśayena sṛṣṭam kṣatram tasmāt kṣatrāt param na asti brāhmaṇa jāteḥ api niyantṛ

original: tasmādbrāhmaṇaḥ kāraṇabhūto'pi kṣatriyasya kṣatriyam adhastāt vyavasthitaḥ san upari sthitam upāste --- kvaḥ? rājasūye. kṣatra eva tat ātmīyaṃ yaśaḥ khyātirūpam --- brahmeti --- dadhāti sthāpayati; rājasūyābhiṣiktena āsandyāṃ sthitena rājñā āmantrito brahmanniti ṛtvik punastaṃ pratyāha --- tvaṃ rājanbrahmāsīti;

analyzed: kena sāmānyena prajāpatiḥ iti tat ucyate tasya evaṃvidaḥ puruṣasya gavādi vittam eva pañcadaśa kalāḥ upacaya apacaya dharmi tvāt vitta sādhyam ca karma tasya kṛtsnatāyai ātmā eva piṇḍaḥ eva asya viduṣaḥ ṣoḍaśī kalā dhruva sthānīyā sa candra vat vittena eva āpūryate ca apakṣīyate ca tat etat loke prasiddham

original: atheti vākyopanyāsārthaḥ. trayaḥ --- vāvetyavadhāraṇārthaḥ --- traya eva śāstroktasādhanārhā lokāḥ, na nyūnā nādhikā vā; ke ta ityucyate --- manuṣyalokaḥ pitṛloko devaloka iti. teṣāṃ so'yaṃ manuṣyalokaḥ putreṇaiva sādhanena jayyaḥ jetavyaḥ sādhyaḥ --- yathā ca putreṇa jetavyastathottaratra vakṣyāmaḥ --- nānyena karmaṇā, vidyayā veti vākyaśeṣaḥ.

original: karmaṇā agnihotrādilakṣaṇena kevalena pitṛloko jetavyaḥ, na putreṇa nāpi vidyayā. vidyayā devalokaḥ, na putreṇa nāpi karmaṇā. devaloko vai lokānāṃ trayāṇāṃ śreṣṭhaḥ praśasyatamaḥ; tasmāt tatsādhanatvāt vidyāṃ praśaṃsanti.

original: evaṃ sādhyalokatrayaphalabhedena viniyuktāni putrakarmavidyākhyāni trīṇi sādhanāni; jāyā tu putrakarmārthatvānna pṛthaksādhanamiti pṛthak nābhihitā; vittaṃ ca karmasādhanatvānna pṛthaksādhanam; vidyākarmaṇorlokajayahetutvaṃ svātmapratilābhenaiva bhavatīti prasiddham; putrasya tu akriyātmakatvāt kena prakāreṇa lokajayahetutvamiti na jñāyate;

original: atastadvaktavyamiti atha anantaramārabhyate --- saṃpratiḥ saṃpradānam; saṃpratiriti vakṣyamāṇasya karmaṇo nāmadheyam; putre hi svātmavyāpārasaṃpradānaṃ karoti anena prakāreṇa pitā, tena saṃprattisaṃjñakamidaṃ karma.
analyzed: atas tat vaktavyam iti atha anantaram ārabhyate saṃpratiḥ saṃpradānam saṃpratiḥ iti vakṣyamāṇasya karmaṇaḥ nāmadheyam putre hi sva ātma vyāpāra saṃpradānam karoti anena prakāreṇa pitā tena saṃpratti saṃjñakam idam karma

original: tat kasminkāle kartavyamityāha --- sa pitā yadā yasminkāle praiṣyan mariṣyan mariṣyāmītyariṣṭādidarśanena manyate, atha tadā putramāhūyāha --- tvaṃ brahma tvaṃ yajñastvaṃ loka iti. sa evamuktaḥ putraḥ pratyāha; sa tu pūrvamevānuśiṣṭo jānāti mayaitatkartavyamiti; tenāha --- ahaṃ brahma ahaṃ yajñaḥ ahaṃ loka iti etadvākyatrayam.
analyzed: tat kasmin kāle kartavyam iti āha sa pitā yadā yasmin kāle praiṣyan mariṣyan mariṣyāmi iti ariṣṭa ādi darśanena manyate atha tadā putram āhūya āha tvam brahma tvam yajñaḥ tvam lokaḥ iti saḥ evam uktaḥ putraḥ pratyāha sa tu pūrvam eva anuśiṣṭaḥ jānāti mayā etat kartavyam iti tena āha aham brahma aham yajñaḥ aham lokaḥ iti etat vākya trayam

original: etasyārthastirohita iti manvānā śrutirvyākhyānāya pravartate --- yadvai kiṃca yatkiṃca avaśiṣṭam anūktam adhītamanadhītaṃ ca, tasya sarvasyaiva brahmetyetasminpade ekatā ekatvam; yo'dhyayanavyāpāro mama kartavya āsīdetāvantaṃ kālaṃ vedaviṣayaḥ, saḥ itha ūrdhvaṃ tvaṃ brahma tvatkartṛkośtvityarthaḥ.
analyzed: etasya arthaḥ tirohitaḥ iti manvānā śrutiḥ vyākhyānāya pravartate yat vai kiṃca yat kiṃca avaśiṣṭam anūktam adhītam anadhītam ca tasya sarvasya eva brahma iti etasmin pade ekatā ekatvam mama kartavyaḥ āsīt etāvantam kālam veda viṣayaḥ saḥ ithas ūrdhvam tvam brahma tvad kartṛkaḥ ūśtu iti arthaḥ

original: tathā ye vai ke ca yajñā anuṣṭheyāḥ santo mayā anuṣṭhitāścānanuṣṭhitāśca, teṣāṃ sarveṣāṃ yajña ityetasminpada ekatā ekatvam; matkartṛkā yajñā ya āsan, te ita ūrdhvaṃ tvaṃ yajñaḥ tvatkartṛkā bhavantvityarthaḥ. ye vai ke ca lokā mayā jetavyāḥ santo jitā ajitāśca, teṣāṃ sarveṣāṃ loka ityetasminpada ekatā; ita ūrdhvaṃ tvaṃ lokaḥ tvayā jetavyāste.

analyzed: tatra imam pituḥ abhiprāyam manvānā ācaṣṭe śrutiḥ etāvat etad parimāṇam vai idam sarvam yat gṛhiṇā kartavyam yat uta vedāḥ adhyetavyāḥ yajñāḥ yaṣṭavyāḥ lokāḥ ca jetavyāḥ

original: ata eva hyenaṃ putramanuśāsati --- lokyo'yaṃ naḥ syāditi --- pitaraḥ. sa pitā yadā yasminkāle evaṃvit putrasamarpitakartavyatākratuḥ asmāllokāt praiti mriyate, atha tadā ebhireva prakṛtairvāṅmanaḥprāṇaiḥ putramāviśati putraṃ vyāpnoti.

analyzed: adhyātma pariccheda hetu apagamāt pituḥ vāc manaḥ prāṇāḥ svena ādhidaivikena rūpeṇa pṛthivī agni ādi ātmanā bhinna ghaṭa pradīpa prakāśa vat sarvam āviśanti taiḥ prāṇaiḥ saha pitā api āviśati vāc manaḥ prāṇa ātma bhāvi tvāt pituḥ aham asmi anantāḥ vāc manaḥ prāṇāḥ adhyātma ādi bheda vistārāḥ iti evaṃbhāvitaḥ hi pitā

original: tasmāt prāṇānuvṛttitvaṃ piturbhavatīti yuktamuktam --- ebhireva prāṇaiḥ saha putramāviśatīti; sarveṣāṃ hyasāvātmā bhavati putrasya ca. etaduktaṃ bhavati --- yasya piturevamanuśiṣṭaḥ putro bhavati sośminneva loke vartate putrarūpeṇa naiva mṛto mantavya ityarthaḥ; tathā ca śrutyantare --- śośyāyamitara ātmā puṇyebhyaḥ karmabhyaḥ pratidhīyate' iti.

original: athedānīṃ putranirvacanamāha --- sa putraḥ yadi kadācit anena pitrā akṣṇayā koṇacchidrato'ntarā akṛtaṃ bhavati kartavyam, tasmāt kartavyatārūpātpitrā akṛtāt sarvasmāllokaprāptipratibandharūpāt putro muñcati mocayati tatsarvaṃ svayamanutiṣṭhanpūrayitvā; tasmāt pūraṇena trāyate sa pitaraṃ yasmāt, tasmāt, putro nāma;
analyzed: atha idānīm putra nirvacanam āha sa putraḥ yadi kadācid anena pitrā akṣṇayā akṛtam bhavati kartavyam tasmāt kartavya tā rūpāt pitrā akṛtāt sarvasmāt loka prāpti pratibandha rūpāt putraḥ muñcati mocayati tat sarvam svayam anutiṣṭhan pūrayitvā tasmāt pūraṇena trāyate sa pitaram yasmāt tasmāt putraḥ nāma

original: idaṃ tatputrasya putratvam --- yatpituśchidraṃ pūrayitvā trāyate. sa pitā evaṃvidhena putreṇa mṛto'pi san amṛtaḥ asminneva loke pratitiṣṭhati evamasau pitā putreṇemaṃ manuṣyalokaṃ jayati; na tathā vidyākarmabhyāṃ devalokapitṛlokau, svarūpalābhasattāmātreṇa;
analyzed: idam tat putrasya putra tvam yat pituḥ chidram pūrayitvā trāyate sa pitā evaṃvidhena putreṇa mṛtaḥ api san amṛtaḥ asmin eva loke pratitiṣṭhati evam asau pitā putreṇa imam manuṣya lokam jayati na tathā vidyā karmabhyām deva loka pitṛ lokau sva rūpa lābha sattā mātreṇa

original: na hi vidyākarmaṇī svarūpalābhavyatirekeṇa putravat vyāpārāntarāpekṣayā lokajayahetutvaṃ pratipadyete. atha kṛtasaṃprattikaṃ pitaram enam ete vāgādayaḥ prāṇāḥ daivāḥ hairaṇyagarbhāḥ amṛtāḥ amaraṇadharmāṇa āviśanti.
analyzed: na hi vidyā karmaṇī svarūpa lābha vyatirekeṇa putra vat vyāpāra antara apekṣayā loka jaya hetu tvam pratipadyete atha kṛta saṃprattikam pitaram enam ete vāc ādayaḥ prāṇāḥ daivāḥ hairaṇyagarbhāḥ amṛtāḥ amaraṇa dharmāṇaḥ āviśanti

original: kathamiti vakṣyati --- pṛthivyai cainamityādi. evaṃ putrakarmāparavidyānāṃ manuṣyalokapitṛlokadevalokasādhyārthatā pradarśitā śrutyā svayameva; atra kecidvāvadūkāḥ śrutyuktaviśeṣārthānabhijñāḥ santaḥ putrādisādhanānāṃ mokṣārthatāṃ vadanti;
analyzed: katham iti vakṣyati pṛthivyai ca enam ityādi evam putra karma apara vidyānām manuṣya loka pitṛ loka deva loka sādhya artha tā pradarśitā śrutyā svayam eva atra kecid vāvadūkāḥ śruti ukta viśeṣa artha anabhijñāḥ santaḥ putra ādi sādhanānām mokṣa artha tām vadanti

original: athātaḥ anantaraṃ vartamīmāṃsā upāsanakarmavicāraṇetyarthaḥ; eṣāṃ prāṇānāṃ kasya karma vartatvena dhārayitavyamiti mīmāṃsā pravartate. tatra prajāpatiḥ ha --- ha-śabdaḥ kilārthe --- prajāpatiḥ kila prajāḥ sṛṣṭvā karmāṇi karaṇāni vāgādīni --- karmārthāni hi tānīti karmāṇītyucyante --- sasṛje sṛṣṭavān vāgādīni karaṇānītyarthaḥ.
analyzed: atha atas anantaram varta mīmāṃsā upāsana karma vicāraṇā iti arthaḥ eṣām prāṇānām kasya karma varta tvena dhārayitavyam iti mīmāṃsā pravartate tatra prajāpatiḥ ha ha śabdaḥ kila arthe prajāpatiḥ kila prajāḥ sṛṣṭvā karmāṇi karaṇāni vāc ādīni karma arthāni hi tāni iti karmāṇi iti ucyante sasṛje sṛṣṭavān vāc ādīni karaṇāni iti arthaḥ

original: tāni punaḥ sṛṣṭāni anyonyena itaretaram aspardhanta spardhāṃ saṃgharṣaṃ cakruḥ; katham? vadiṣyāmyeva svavyāpārādvadanādanuparataiva ahaṃ syāmiti vāgvrataṃ dadhre dhṛtavatī --- yadyanyo'pi matsamośti svavyāpārādanuparantuṃ śaktaḥ, so'pi darśayatvātmano vīryamiti; tathā drakṣyāmyahamiti cakṣuḥ; śroṣyāmyahamiti śrotram;
analyzed: tāni punar sṛṣṭāni anyonyena itaretaram aspardhanta spardhām saṃgharṣam cakruḥ katham vadiṣyāmi eva sva vyāpārāt vadanāt anuparatā eva aham syām iti vāc vratam dadhre dhṛtavatī yadi anyaḥ api sva vyāpārāt anuparantum śaktaḥ saḥ api darśayatu ātmanaḥ vīryam iti tathā drakṣyāmi aham iti cakṣuḥ śroṣyāmi aham iti śrotram

analyzed: evam anyāni karmāṇi karaṇāni yathākarma yat yat yasya karma yathākarma tāni karaṇāni mṛtyuḥ mārakaḥ śramaḥ śrama rūpī bhūtvā upayeme saṃjagrāha katham tāni karaṇāni sva vyāpāre pravṛttāni āpnot śrama rūpeṇa ātmānam darśitavān āptvā ca tāni avārundha avarodham kṛtavān mṛtyuḥ sva karmabhyaḥ pracyāvitavān iti arthaḥ

original: tasmādadyatve'pi vadane svakarmaṇi pravṛttā vāk śrāmyatyeva śramarūpiṇā mṛtyunā saṃyuktā svakarmataḥ pracyavate; tathā śrāmyati cakṣuḥ; śrāmyati śrotram. athemameva mukhyaṃ prāṇaṃ na āpnot na prāptavānmṛtyuḥ śramarūpī --- yo'yaṃ madhyamaḥ prāṇaḥ tam. tenādyatve'pyaśrānta eva svakarmaṇi pravartate.

original: tānītarāṇi karaṇāni taṃ jñātuṃ dadhrire dhṛtavanti manaḥ; ayaṃ vai naḥ asmākaṃ madhye śreṣṭhaḥ praśasyatamaḥ abhyadhikaḥ, yasmāt yaḥ saṃcaraṃścāsaṃcaraṃśca na vyathate, atho na riṣyati --- hanta idānīmasyaiva prāṇasya sarve vayaṃ rūpamasāma prāṇamātmatvena pratipadyemahi --- evaṃ viniścitya te etasyaiva sarve rūpamabhavan prāṇarūpameva ātmatvena

original: dikṣu karṇayoḥ hṛdi caikā devatā aśivanau devāvaviyuktasvabhāvau; guṇastasya dvitīyavattvam anapagatvam aviyuktatā cānyonyaṃ diśāmaśivanośca evaṃ dharmitvāt; tadeva ca phalamupāsakasya --- gaṇāvicchedaḥ dvitīyavattvaṃ ca.
analyzed: dikṣu karṇayoḥ hṛdi ca ekā devatā aśivanau devau a viyukta svabhāvau guṇaḥ tasya dvitīya vat tvam anapaga tvam aviyukta tā ca anyonyam diśām aśivanoḥ ca evam dharmi tvāt tat eva ca phalam upāsakasya gaṇa avicchedaḥ dvitīya vat tvam ca

original: chāyāyāṃ bāhye tamasi adhyātmaṃ ca āvaraṇātmake'jñāne hṛdi ca ekā devatā, tasyā viśeṣaṇam --- mṛtyuḥ; phalaṃ sarvaṃ pūrvavat, mṛtyoranāgamanena rogādipīḍābhāvo viśeṣaḥ.
analyzed: chāyāyām bāhye tamasi adhyātmam ca āvaraṇa ātmake jñāne hṛdi ca ekā devatā tasyāḥ viśeṣaṇam mṛtyuḥ phalam sarvam pūrvavat mṛtyoḥ anāgamanena roga ādi pīḍā bhāvaḥ viśeṣaḥ

original: ātmani prajāpatau buddhau ca hṛdi ca ekā devatā; tasyāḥ ātmanvī ātmavāniti viśeṣaṇam; phalam --- ātmanvī ha bhavati ātmavānbhavati, ātmanvinī hāsya prajā bhavati, buddhibahulatvāt prajāyāṃ saṃpādanamiti viśeṣaḥ. svayaṃ parijñātatvena evaṃ krameṇa pratyākhyāteṣu brahmasu sa gārgyaḥ kṣīṇabrahmavijñānaḥ apratibhāsamānottaraḥ tūṣṇīmavākiśarā āsa.
analyzed: ātmani prajāpatau buddhau ca hṛdi ca ekā devatā tasyāḥ ātmanvī ātmavān iti viśeṣaṇam phalam ātmanvī ha bhavati ātmavān bhavati ātmanvinī ha asya prajā bhavati buddhi bahula tvāt prajāyām saṃpādanam iti viśeṣaḥ svayam parijñāta tvena evam krameṇa pratyākhyāteṣu brahmasu sa gārgyaḥ kṣīṇa brahma vijñānaḥ a pratibhāsamāna uttaraḥ tūṣṇīm avākiśarāḥ āsa

original: taṃ tathābhūtam ālakṣya gārgyaṃ sa hovāca ajātaśatruḥ --- etāvannū3 iti --- kimetāvadbrahma nirjñātam, āhosvidadhikamapyastīti; itara āha --- etāvaddhīti. naitāvatā viditena brahma viditaṃ bhavatītyāha ajātaśatruḥ --- kimarthaṃ garvitośi brahma te bravāṇīti. kimetāvadviditaṃ viditameva na bhavatītyucyate? na, phalavadvijñānaśravaṇāt;
analyzed: tam tathābhūtam ālakṣya gārgyam sa ha uvāca ajātaśatruḥ etāvat nu iti kim etāvat brahma nirjñātam āhosvit adhikam api asti iti itaraḥ āha etāvat hi iti na etāvatā viditena brahma viditam bhavati iti āha ajātaśatruḥ kimartham garvita ūśi brahma te bravāṇi iti kim etāvat viditam viditam eva na bhavati iti ucyate na phalavat vijñāna śravaṇāt

original: na cārthavādatvameva vākyānāmavagantuṃ śakyam; apūrvavidhānaparāṇi hi vākyāni pratyupāsanopadeśaṃ lakṣyante --- 'atiṣṭhāḥ sarveṣāṃ bhūtānām' ityādīni; tadanurūpāṇi ca phalāni sarvatra śrūyante vibhaktāni; arthavādatve etadasamañjasam.
analyzed: na ca arthavāda tvam eva vākyānām avagantum śakyam apūrva vidhāna parāṇi hi vākyāni pratyupāsana upadeśam lakṣyante atiṣṭhāḥ sarveṣām bhūtānām ityādīni tad anurūpāṇi ca phalāni sarvatra śrūyante vibhaktāni arthavāda tve etat asamañjasam

original: kathaṃ tarhi naitāvatā viditaṃ bhavatīti? naiṣa doṣaḥ, adhikṛtāpekṣatvāt --- brahmopadeśārthaṃ hi śuśrūṣave ajātaśatrave amukhyabrahmavit gārgyaḥ pravṛttaḥ; sa yukta eva mukhyabrahmavidā ajātaśatruṇā amukhyabrahmavidgārgyo vaktum --- yanmukhyaṃ brahma vaktuṃ pravṛttaḥ tvaṃ tat na jānīṣa iti;
analyzed: katham tarhi na etāvatā viditam bhavati iti na eṣa doṣaḥ adhikṛta apekṣa tvāt brahma upadeśa artham hi śuśrūṣave ajātaśatrave amukhya brahma vid gārgyaḥ pravṛttaḥ sa yuktaḥ eva mukhya brahma vidā ajātaśatruṇā amukhya brahma vid gārgyaḥ vaktum yat mukhyam brahma vaktum pravṛttaḥ tvam tat na jānīṣe iti

original: yadyamukhyabrahmavijñānamapi pratyākhyāyeta, tadā etāvateti na brūyāt, na kiṃcijjñātaṃ tvayetyevaṃ brūyāt; tasmādbhavanti etāvanti avidyāviṣaye brahmāṇi; etāvadvijñānadvāratvācca parabrahmavijñānasya yuktameva vaktum --- naitāvatā viditaṃ bhavatīti; avidyāviṣaye vijñeyatvaṃ nāmarūpakarmātmakatvaṃ ca eṣāṃ tṛtīye'dhyāye pradarśitam;
analyzed: yadi amukhya brahma vijñānam api pratyākhyāyeta tadā etāvatā iti na brūyāt na kiṃcid jñātam tvayā iti evam brūyāt tasmāt bhavanti etāvanti avidyā viṣaye brahmāṇi etāvat vijñāna dvāra tvāt ca para brahma vijñānasya yuktam eva vaktum na etāvatā viditam bhavati iti avidyā viṣaye vijñeya tvam nāma rūpa karma ātmaka tvam ca eṣām tṛtīye dhyāye pradarśitam

original: tasmāt 'naitāvatā viditaṃ bhavati' iti bruvatā adhikaṃ brahma jñātavyamastīti darśitaṃ bhavati. tacca anupasannāya na vaktavyamityācāravidhijño gārgyaḥ svayameva āha --- upa tvā yānīti --- upagacchānīti --- tvām, yathānyaḥ śiṣyo gurum.
analyzed: tasmāt na etāvatā viditam bhavati iti bruvatā adhikam brahma jñātavyam asti iti darśitam bhavati tat ca an upasannāya na vaktavyam iti ācāra vidhi jñaḥ gārgyaḥ svayam eva āha upa tvā yāni iti upagacchāni iti tvām yathā anyaḥ śiṣyaḥ gurum

original: sa hovāca ajātaśatruḥ --- pratilomaṃ viparītaṃ caitat; kiṃ tat? yadbrāhmaṇaḥ uttamavarṇaḥ ācāryatve'dhikṛtaḥ san kṣatriyamanācāryasvabhāvam upeyāt upagacchet śiṣyavṛttyā --- brahma me vakṣyatīti; etadācāravidhiśāstreṣu niṣiddham; tasmāt tiṣṭha tvam ācārya eva san;
analyzed: sa ha uvāca ajātaśatruḥ pratilomam viparītam ca etat kim tat yat brāhmaṇaḥ uttama varṇaḥ ācārya tva adhikṛtaḥ san kṣatriyam an ācārya svabhāvam upeyāt upagacchet śiṣya vṛttyā brahma me vakṣyati iti etad ācāra vidhi śāstreṣu niṣiddham tasmāt tiṣṭha tvam ācāryaḥ eva san

original: vijñapayiṣyāmyeva tvāmaham --- yasminvidate brahma viditaṃ bhavati, yattanmukhyaṃ brahma vedyam. taṃ gārgyaṃ salajjamālakṣya visrambhajananāya pāṇau haste ādāya gṛhītvā uttasthau utthitavān. tau ha gārgyājātaśatrū puruṣaṃ suptaṃ rājagṛhapradeśe kvacit ājagmatuḥ āgatau.
analyzed: vijñapayiṣyāmi eva tvām aham yasmin vidate brahma viditam bhavati yat tat mukhyam brahma vedyam tam gārgyam sa lajjam ālakṣya visrambha jananāya pāṇau haste ādāya gṛhītvā uttasthau utthitavān tau ha gārgya ajātaśatrū puruṣam suptam rājagṛha pradeśe kvacid ājagmatuḥ āgatau

original: taṃ ca puruṣaṃ suptaṃ prāpya etairnāmabhiḥ --- bṛhan pāṇḍaravāsaḥ soma rājannityetaiḥ --- āmantrayāṃcakre. evamāmantryamāṇo'pi sa suptaḥ nottasthau. tam apratibuddhyamānaṃ pāṇinā āpeṣam āpiṣya āpiṣya bodhayāṃcakāra pratibodhitavān. tena sa hottasthau. tasmādyo gārgyeṇābhipretaḥ, nāsāvasmiñcharīre kartā bhoktā brahmeti.
analyzed: tam ca puruṣam suptam prāpya etaiḥ nāmabhiḥ bṛhan pāṇḍara vāsaḥ soma rājan iti etaiḥ āmantrayāṃcakre evam āmantryamāṇaḥ api sa suptaḥ na uttasthau tam a pratibuddhyamānam pāṇinā āpeṣam āpiṣya āpiṣya bodhayāṃcakāra pratibodhitavān tena sa ha uttasthau tasmāt yaḥ gārgyeṇa abhipretaḥ na asau asmin śarīre kartā bhoktā brahma iti

original: kathaṃ punaridamavagamyate --- suptapuruṣagamanatatsaṃbodhanānutthānaiḥ gārgyābhimatasya brahmaṇo'brahmatvaṃ jñāpitamiti?
analyzed: katham punar idam avagamyate supta puruṣa gamana tad saṃbodhana anutthānaiḥ gārgya abhimatasya brahmaṇaḥ brahmatvam jñāpitam iti

original: jāgaritakāle yo gārgyābhipretaḥ puruṣaḥ kartā bhoktā brahma saṃnihitaḥ karaṇeṣu yathā, tathā ajātaśatrvabhipreto'pi tatsvāmī bhṛtyeṣviva rājā saṃnihita eva; kiṃ tu bhṛtyasvāminoḥ gārgyājātaśatrvabhipretayoḥ yadvivekāvadhāraṇakāraṇam, tat saṃkīrṇatvādanavadhāritaviśeṣam;
analyzed: jāgarita kāle yaḥ gārgya abhipretaḥ puruṣaḥ kartā bhoktā brahma saṃnihitaḥ karaṇeṣu yathā tathā ajātaśatru abhipretaḥ upi tad svāmī bhṛtyeṣu iva rājā saṃnihitaḥ eva kim tu bhṛtya svāminoḥ gārgya ajātaśatru abhipretayoḥ yat viveka avadhāraṇa kāraṇam tat saṃkīrṇa tvāt anavadhārita viśeṣam

original: yat draṣṭṛtvameva bhoktuḥ na dṛśyatvam, yacca abhokturdṛśyatvameva na tu draṣṭṛtvam, tacca ubhayam iha saṃkīrṇatvādvivicya darśayitumaśakyamiti suptapuruṣagamanam. nanu supte'pi puruṣe viśiṣṭairnāmabhirāmantrito bhoktaiva pratipatsyate, na abhoktā --- iti naiva nirṇayaḥ syāditi.
analyzed: yat draṣṭṛ tvam eva bhoktuḥ na dṛśya tvam yat ca abhoktuḥ dṛśya tvam eva na tu draṣṭṛ tvam tat ca ubhayam iha saṃkīrṇa tvāt vivicya darśayitum aśakyam iti supta puruṣa gamanam nanu supte api puruṣe viśiṣṭaiḥ nāmabhiḥ āmantritaḥ bhoktā eva pratipatsyate na abhoktā iti nā eva nirṇayaḥ syāt iti

original: na, nirdhāritaviśeṣatvādgārgyābhipretasya --- yo hi satyena cchannaḥ prāṇa ātmā amṛtaḥ vāgādiṣu anastamitaḥ nimlocatsu, yasya āpaḥ śarīraṃ pāṇḍaravāsāḥ, yaśca asapatnatvāt bṛhan, yaśca somo rājā ṣoḍaśakālaḥ, sa svavyāpārārūḍho yathānirjñāta eva anastamitasvabhāva āste; na ca anyasya kasyacidvyāpāraḥ tasminkāle gārgyeṇābhipreyate tadvirodhinaḥ;
analyzed: na nirdhārita viśeṣa tvāt gārgya abhipretasya yaḥ hi satyena channaḥ prāṇaḥ ātmā amṛtaḥ vāc ādiṣu an astamitaḥ nimlocatsu yasya āpaḥ śarīram pāṇḍara vāsāḥ yaḥ ca asapatna tvāt bṛhan yaḥ ca somaḥ rājā ṣoḍaśa kālaḥ sa sva vyāpāra ārūḍhaḥ yathā nirjñātaḥ eva an astamita svabhāvaḥ āste na ca anyasya kasyacid vyāpāraḥ tasmin kāle gārgyeṇa abhipreyate tad virodhinaḥ

original: tasmāt svanāmabhirāmantritena pratiboddhavyam; na ca pratyabudhyata; tasmāt pāriśeṣyāt gārgyābhipretasya abhoktṛtvaṃ brahmaṇaḥ. bhoktṛsvabhāvaścet bhuñjītaiva svaṃ viṣayaṃ prāptam; na hi dagdhṛsvabhāvaḥ prakāśayitṛsvabhāvaḥ san vahniḥ tṛṇolapādi dāhyaṃ svaviṣayaṃ prāptaṃ na dahati, prakāśyaṃ vā na prakāśayati;
analyzed: tasmāt sva nāmabhiḥ āmantritena pratiboddhavyam na ca pratyabudhyata tasmāt pāriśeṣyāt gārgya abhipretasya abhoktṛ tvam brahmaṇaḥ bhoktṛ svabhāvaḥ ced bhuñjīta eva svam viṣayam prāptam na hi dagdhṛ svabhāvaḥ prakāśayitṛ svabhāvaḥ san vahniḥ tṛṇa ulapa ādi dāhyam sva viṣayam prāptam na dahati prakāśyam vā na prakāśayati

original: na cet dahati prakāśayati vā prāptaṃ svaṃ viṣayam, nāsau vahniḥ dagdhā prakāśayitā veti niścīyate; tathā asau prāptaśabdādiviṣayopalabdhṛsvabhāvaścet gārgyābhipretaḥ prāṇaḥ, bṛhanpāṇḍaravāsa ityevamādiśabdaṃ svaṃ viṣayamupalabheta --- yathā prāptaṃ tṛṇolapādi vahniḥ dahet prakāśayecca avyabhicāreṇa tadvat.
analyzed: na ced dahati prakāśayati vā prāptam svam viṣayam na asau vahniḥ dagdhā prakāśayitā vā iti niścīyate tathā asau prāpta śabda ādi viṣaya upalabdhṛ svabhāvaḥ ced gārgya abhipretaḥ prāṇaḥ bṛhan pāṇḍara vāsaḥ iti evamādi śabdam svam viṣayam upalabheta yathā prāptam tṛṇa ulapa ādi vahniḥ dahet prakāśayet ca avyabhicāreṇa tadvat

original: tasmāt prāptānāṃ śabdādīnām apratibodhāt abhoktṛsvabhāva iti niścīyate; na hi yasya yaḥ svabhāvo niścitaḥ, sa taṃ vyabhicarati kadācidapi; ataḥ siddhaṃ prāṇasyābhoktṛtvam.
analyzed: tasmāt prāptānām śabda ādīnām apratibodhāt abhoktṛ svabhāvaḥ iti niścīyate na hi yasya yaḥ svabhāvaḥ niścitaḥ sa tam vyabhicarati kadācid api atas siddham prāṇasya abhoktṛ tvam

original: saṃbodhanārthanāmaviśeṣeṇa saṃbandhāgrahaṇāt apratibodha iti cet --- syādetat --- yathā bahuṣvāsīneṣu svanāmaviśeṣeṇa saṃbandhāgrahaṇāt māmayaṃ saṃbodhayatīti, śrṛṇvannapi saṃbodhyamānaḥ viśeṣato na pratipadyate;
analyzed: saṃbodhana artha nāma viśeṣeṇa saṃbandha agrahaṇāt apratibodhaḥ iti ced syāt etat yathā bahuṣu āsīneṣu sva nāma viśeṣeṇa saṃbandha agrahaṇāt mām ayam saṃbodhayati iti śrṛṇvan api saṃbodhyamānaḥ viśeṣataḥ na pratipadyate

original: tathā imāni bṛhannityevamādīni mama nāmānīti agṛhītasaṃbandhatvāt prāṇo na gṛhṇāti saṃbodhanārthaṃ śabdam, na tvavijñātṛtvādeva --- iti cet --- na, devatābhyupagame agrahaṇānupapatteḥ; yasya hi candrādyabhimāninī devatā adhyātmaṃ prāṇo bhoktā abhyupagamyate, tasya tayā saṃvyavahārāya viśeṣanāmnā saṃbandho'vaśyaṃ grahītavyaḥ;
analyzed: tathā imāni bṛhan iti evamādīni mama nāmāni iti agṛhīta saṃbandha tvāt prāṇaḥ na gṛhṇāti saṃbodhana artham śabdam na tu avijñātṛ tvāt eva iti ced na devatā abhyupagame agrahaṇa anupapatteḥ yasya hi candra ādi abhimāninī devatā adhyātmam prāṇaḥ bhoktā abhyupagamyate tasya tayā saṃvyavahārāya viśeṣa nāmnā saṃbandhaḥ vaśyam grahītavyaḥ

original: anyathā āhvānādiviṣaye saṃvyavahāro'nupapannaḥ syāt. vyatiriktapakṣe'pi apratipatteḥ ayuktamiti cet --- yasya ca prāṇavyatirikto bhoktā, tasyāpi bṛhannityādināmabhiḥ saṃbodhane bṛhattvādināmnāṃ tadā tadviṣayatvāt pratipattiryuktā; na ca kadācidapi bṛhattvādiśabdaiḥ saṃbodhitaḥ pratipadyamāno dṛśyate;
analyzed: anyathā āhvāna ādi viṣaye saṃvyavahāraḥ anupapannaḥ syāt vyatirikta pakṣe api apratipatteḥ ayuktam iti ced yasya ca prāṇa vyatiriktaḥ bhoktā tasya api bṛhan ityādi nāmabhiḥ saṃbodhane bṛhat tva ādi nāmnām tadā tad viṣaya tvāt pratipattiḥ yuktā na ca kadācid api bṛhat tva ādi śabdaiḥ saṃbodhitaḥ pratipadyamānaḥ dṛśyate

original: tasmāt akāraṇam abhoktṛtve saṃbodhanāpratipattiriti cet --- na, tadvataḥ tāvanmātrābhimānānupapatteḥ; yasya prāṇavyatirikto bhoktā, saḥ prāṇādikaraṇavān prāṇī; tasya na prāṇadevatāmātre'bhimānaḥ, yathā haste; tasmāt prāṇanāmasaṃbodhane kṛtsnābhimānino yuktaiva apratipattiḥ, na tu prāṇasya asādhāraṇanāmasaṃyoge; devatātmatvānabhimānācca ātmanaḥ.
analyzed: tasmāt akāraṇam abhoktṛ tve saṃbodhana apratipattiḥ iti ced na tadvataḥ tāvat mātra abhimāna anupapatteḥ yasya prāṇa vyatiriktaḥ bhoktā saḥ prāṇa ādi karaṇavān prāṇī tasya na prāṇa devatā mātra abhimānaḥ yathā haste tasmāt prāṇa nāma saṃbodhane kṛtsna abhimāninaḥ yuktā eva apratipattiḥ na tu prāṇasya asādhāraṇa nāma saṃyoge devatā ātmatva anabhimānāt ca ātmanaḥ

original: svanāmaprayoge'pyapratipattidarśanādayuktamiti cet --- suṣuptasya yallaukikaṃ devadattādi nāma tenāpi saṃbodhyamānaḥ kadācinna pratipadyate suṣuptaḥ; tathā bhoktāpi san prāṇo na pratipadyata iti cet --- na, ātmaprāṇayoḥ suptāsuptatvaviśeṣopapatteḥ; suṣuptatvāt prāṇagrastatayā uparatakaraṇa ātmā svaṃ nāma prayujyamānamapi na pratipadyate;

original: svābhāvika eva svātmani vartamāno'pi karmānugatabuddhyanuvṛttitvāt purītati śeta ityucyate. na hi suṣuptikāle śarīrasaṃbandhośti. 'tīrṇo hi tadā sarvāñchokānhṛdayasya' iti hi vakṣyati.

original: kvaiṣa tadābhūdityasya praśnasya prativacanamuktam; anena ca praśnanirṇayena vijñānamayasya svabhāvato viśuddhiḥ asaṃsāritvaṃ ca uktam; kuta etadāgādityasya praśnasyāpākaraṇārthaḥ ārambhaḥ. nanu yasmingrāme nagave vā yo bhavati, so'nyatra gacchan tata eva grāmānnagarādvā gacchati, nānyataḥ; tathā sati kvaiṣa tadābhūdityetāvānevāstu praśnaḥ;

original: yatrābhūt tata eva āgamanaṃ prasiddhaṃ syāt nānyata iti kuta etadāgāditi praśno nirarthaka eva --- kiṃ śrutirupālabhyate bhavatā? na; kiṃ tarhi dvitīyasya praśnasya arthāntaraṃ śrotumicchāmi, ata ānarthakyaṃ codayāmi. evaṃ tarhi kuta ityapādānārthatā na gṛhyate; apādānārthatve hi punaruktatā, nānyārthatve;

analyzed: astu tarhi nimitta arthaḥ praśnaḥ kutas etat āgāt kiṃnimittam iha āgamanam iti na nimitta artha tā api prativacana vairūpyāt ātmanaḥ ca sarvasya jagataḥ agni visphuliṅga ādi vat utpattiḥ prativacane śrūyate na hi visphuliṅgānām vidravaṇe agniḥ nimittam apādānam eva tu saḥ

original: tasya ca yāthātmyaṃ kriyākārakaphalabhedaśūnyam atyantaviśuddhamadvaitam --- ityetadvivakṣitam. atastadanurūpa praśnāvutthāpyete śrutyā --- kvaiṣa tadābhūtkuta etadāgāditi. tatra --- yatra bhavati tat adhikaraṇam, yadbhavati tadadhikartavyam --- tayośca adhikaraṇādhikartavyayorbhedaḥ dṛṣṭo loke.

original: kiṃcātaḥ? yadi saṃsāriṇaḥ tadā saṃsāry eva vijñeyaḥ, tadvijñānād eva sarvaprāptiḥ, sa eva brahmaśabdavācyaḥ tadvidyaiva brahamavidyeti; atha asaṃsāriṇaḥ, tadā tadviṣayā vidyā brahmavidyā, tasmāc ca brahmavijñānāt sarvabhāvāpattiḥ; sarvam etac chāstraprāmāṇyād bhaviṣyati;

original: kiṃtu asminpakṣe 'ātmety evopāsīta' 'ātmānam evāved ahaṃ brahmāsmi ---' iti parabrahmaikatvapratipādikāḥ śrutayaḥ kupyeran, saṃsāriṇaś ca anyasyābhāve upadeśānarthakyāt. yata evaṃ paṇḍitānāmapyetanmahāmohasthānam anuktaprativacanapraśnaviṣayam, ato yathāśakti brahmavidyāpratipādakavākyeṣu brahma vijijñāsūnāṃ buddhivyutpādanāya vicārayiṣyāmaḥ.
analyzed: kiṃtu asmin pakṣe ātmā iti eva upāsīta ātmānam eva avet aham brahma asmi iti para brahma ekatva pratipādikāḥ śrutayaḥ kupyeran saṃsāriṇaḥ ca anyasya abhāve upadeśa ānarthakyāt yatas evam paṇḍitānām api etat mahā moha sthānam anukta prativacana praśna viṣayam atas yathāśakti brahma vidyā pratipādaka vākyeṣu brahma vijijñāsūnām buddhi vyutpādanāya vicārayiṣyāmaḥ

original: na tāvat asaṃsārī paraḥ --- pāṇipeṣaṇapratibodhitāt śabdādibhujaḥ avasthāntaraviśiṣṭāt utpattiśruteḥ; na praśāsitā aśanāyādivarjitaḥ paro vidyate;

original: kasmāt? yasmāt 'brahma jñapayiṣyāmi' iti pratijñāya, suptaṃ puruṣaṃ pāṇipeṣaṃ bodhayitvā, taṃ śabdādibhoktṛtvaviśiṣṭaṃ darśayitvā, tasyaiva svapnadvāreṇa suṣuptyākhyamavasthāntaramunnīya, tasmādeva ātmanaḥ suṣuptyavasthāviśiṣṭāt agnivisphuliṅgorṇanābhidṛṣṭāntābhyām utpattiṃ darśayati śrutiḥ --- 'evam evāsmāt' ityādinā;
analyzed: kasmāt yasmāt brahma jñapayiṣyāmi iti pratijñāya suptam puruṣam pāṇi peṣam bodhayitvā tam śabda ādi bhoktṛ tva viśiṣṭam darśayitvā tasya eva svapna dvāreṇa suṣupti ākhyam avasthā antaram unnīya tasmāt eva ātmanaḥ suṣupti avasthā viśiṣṭāt agni visphuliṅga ūrṇanābhi dṛṣṭāntābhyām utpattim darśayati śrutiḥ evam eva asmāt ityādinā

original: na cānyo jagadutpattikāraṇam antarāle śruto 'sti; vijñānamayasyaiva hi prakaraṇam. samānaprakaraṇe ca śrutyantare kauṣītakinām ādityādipuruṣānprastutya śa hovāca yo vai bālāka eteṣāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ kartā yasya caitatkarma sa vai veditavyaḥ' iti prabuddhasyaiva vijñānamayasya veditavyatāṃ darśayati, nārthāntarasya.
analyzed: na ca anyaḥ jagat utpatti kāraṇam antarāle sti vijñāna mayasya eva hi prakaraṇam samāna prakaraṇe ca śruti antare kauṣītakinām āditya ādi puruṣān prastutya śa ha uvāca yaḥ vai bālākaḥ eteṣām puruṣāṇām kartā yasya ca etat karma sa vai veditavyaḥ iti prabuddhasya eva vijñāna mayasya veditavya tām darśayati na artha antarasya

original: tathā ca 'ātmanastu kāmāya sarvaṃ priyaṃ bhavati' ityuktvā, ya eva ātmā priyaḥ prasiddhaḥ tasyaiva draṣṭavyaśrotavyamantavyanididhyāsitavyatāṃ darśayati. tathā ca vidyopanyāsakāle 'ātmetyevopāsīta' 'tadetatpreyaḥ putrātpreyo vittāt' 'tadātmānamevāvedahaṃ brahmāsmi ---' ityevamādivākyānāmānulomyaṃ syāt parābhāve.
analyzed: tathā ca ātmanaḥ tu kāmāya sarvam priyam bhavati iti uktvā yaḥ eva ātmā priyaḥ prasiddhaḥ tasya eva draṣṭavya śrotavya mantavya nididhyāsitavya tām darśayati tathā ca vidyā upanyāsa kāle ātmā iti eva upāsīta tat etat preyaḥ putrāt preyaḥ vittāt tat ātmānam eva avet aham brahma asmi iti evamādi vākyānām ānulomyam syāt parābhāve

original: vakṣyati ca --- 'ātmānaṃ cedvijānīyādayamasmīti pūruṣaḥ' iti. sarvavedānteṣu ca pratyagātmavedyataiva pradarśyate --- ahamiti, na bahirvedyatā śabdādivat pradarśyate asau brahmeti. tathā kauṣītakināmeva 'na vācaṃ vijijñāsīta vaktāraṃ vidyāt' ityādinā vāgādikaraṇairvyāvṛttasya kartureva veditavyatāṃ darśayati.
analyzed: vakṣyati ca ātmānam ced vijānīyāt ayam asmi iti pūruṣaḥ iti sarva vedānteṣu ca pratyagātma vedya tā eva pradarśyate aham iti na bahis vedya tā śabda ādi vat pradarśyate asau brahma iti tathā kauṣītakinām eva na vācam vijijñāsīta vaktāram vidyāt ityādinā vāc ādi karaṇaiḥ vyāvṛttasya kartuḥ eva veditavya tām darśayati

original: avasthāntaraviśiṣṭośaṃsārīti cet --- athāpi syāt, yo jāgarite śabdādibhuk vijñānamayaḥ, sa eva suṣuptākhyamavasthāntaraṃ gataḥ asaṃsārī paraḥ praśāsitā anyaḥ syāditi cet --- na, adṛṣṭatvāt. na hyevaṃdharmakaḥ padārtho dṛṣṭaḥ anyatra vaināśikasiddhāntāt. na hi loke gauḥ tiṣṭhan gacchanvā gaurbhavati, śayānastu aśvādijātyantaramiti.
analyzed: avasthā antara viśiṣṭaḥ ūśaṃsārī iti ced atha api syāt yaḥ jāgarite śabda ādi bhuj vijñāna mayaḥ saḥ eva suṣupta ākhyam avasthā antaram gataḥ asaṃsārī paraḥ praśāsitā anyaḥ syāt iti ced na adṛṣṭa tvāt na hi evaṃdharmakaḥ padārthaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ anyatra vaināśika siddhāntāt na hi loke gauḥ tiṣṭhan gacchan vā gauḥ bhavati śayānaḥ tu aśva ādi jāti antaram iti

original: nyāyācca --- yaddharmako yaḥ padārtha; pramāṇenāvagato bhavati, sa deśakālāvasthāntareṣvapi taddharmaka eva bhavati; sa cet taddharmakatvaṃ vyabhicarati, sarvaḥ pramāṇavyavahāro lupyeta. tathā ca nyāyavidaḥ sāṃkhyamīmāṃsakādayaḥ asaṃsāriṇaḥ abhāvaṃ yuktiśataiḥ pratipādayanti.

original: saṃsāriṇo'pi jagadutpattisthitilayakriyākartṛtvavijñānasyābhāvāt ayuktamiti cet --- yat mahatā prapañcena sthāpitaṃ bhavatā, śabdādibhuk saṃsāryeva avasthāntaraviśiṣṭo jagata iha karteti --- tadasat; yato jagadutpattisthitilayakriyākartṛtvavijñānaśaktisādhanābhāvaḥ sarvalokapratyakṣaḥ saṃsāriṇaḥ;
analyzed: saṃsāriṇaḥ api jagat utpatti sthiti laya kriyā kartṛ tva vijñānasya abhāvāt ayuktam iti ced yat mahatā prapañcena sthāpitam bhavatā śabda ādi bhuj saṃsārī eva avasthā antara viśiṣṭaḥ jagataḥ iha kartā iti tat asat yatas jagat utpatti sthiti laya kriyā kartṛ tva vijñāna śakti sādhana abhāvaḥ sarva loka pratyakṣaḥ saṃsāriṇaḥ

original: sa katham asmadādiḥ saṃsārī manasāpi cintayitumaśakyaṃ pṛthivyādivinyāsaviśiṣṭaṃ jagat nirminuyāt ato'yuktamiti cet --- na, śāstrāt; śāstraṃ saṃsāriṇaḥ 'evamevāsmādātmanaḥ' iti jagadutpattyādi darśayati; tasmāt sarvaṃ śraddheyam iti syād ayam ekaḥ pakṣaḥ.
analyzed: sa katham asmad ādiḥ saṃsārī manasā api cintayitum aśakyam pṛthivī ādi vinyāsa viśiṣṭam jagat nirminuyāt atas yuktam iti ced na śāstrāt śāstram saṃsāriṇaḥ evam eva asmāt ātmanaḥ iti jagat utpatti ādi darśayati tasmāt sarvam śraddheyam iti syāt ayam ekaḥ pakṣaḥ

original: 'yaḥ sarvajñaḥ sarvavit' 'yo'śanāyāpipāse atyeti' 'asaṅgo na hi sajjate' 'etasya vā akṣarasya praśāsane' 'yaḥ sarveṣu bhūteṣu tiṣṭhan --- antaryāmyamṛtaḥ' 'sa yas tān puruṣān niruhyāty akrāmat' 'sa vā eṣa mahān aja ātmā' 'eṣa setur vidharaṇaḥ' 'sarvasya vaśī sarvasyeśānaḥ' 'ya ātmāpahatapāpmā vijaro vimṛtyuḥ' 'tattejo .asṛjata' 'ātmā vā idam eka
