original: evāgra āsīt' 'na lipyate lokaduḥkhena bāhyaḥ' ityādiśrutiśatebhyaḥ --- smṛteś ca 'ahaṃ sarvasya prabhavo mattaḥ sarvaṃ pravartate' --- iti --- paro.asti asaṃsārī śrutismṛtinyāyebhyaś ca; sa ca kāraṇaṃ jagataḥ.
analyzed: eva agre āsīt na lipyate loka duḥkhena bāhyaḥ ityādi śruti śatebhyaḥ smṛteḥ ca aham sarvasya prabhavaḥ mattaḥ sarvam pravartate iti paraḥ asti asaṃsārī śruti smṛti nyāyebhyaḥ ca sa ca kāraṇam jagataḥ

original: nanu 'evamevāsmādātmanaḥ' iti saṃsāriṇa evotpattiṃ darśayatītyuktam --- na, 'ya eṣo'ntarhṛdaya ākāśaḥ' iti parasya prakṛtatvāt, 'asmādātmanaḥ' iti yuktaḥ parasyaiva parāmarśaḥ. 'kvaiṣa tadābhūt' ityasya praśnasya prativacanatvena ākāśaśabdavācyaḥ para ātmā uktaḥ 'ya eṣo'ntarhṛdaya ākāśastasmiñchete' iti;
analyzed: nanu evam eva asmāt ātmanaḥ iti saṃsāriṇaḥ eva utpattim darśayati iti uktam na yaḥ eṣaḥ antar hṛdaye ākāśaḥ iti parasya prakṛta tvāt asmāt ātmanaḥ iti yuktaḥ parasya eva parāmarśaḥ kva eṣa tadā abhūt iti asya praśnasya prativacana tvena ākāśa śabda vācyaḥ paraḥ ātmā uktaḥ yaḥ eṣaḥ antar hṛdaye ākāśaḥ tasmin śete iti

original: śatā somya tadā saṃpanno bhavati' 'aharahargacchantya etaṃ brahmalokaṃ na vindanti' 'prājñenātmanā saṃpariṣvaktaḥ' 'para ātmani saṃpratiṣṭhate' ityādiśrutibhya ākāśaśabdaḥ parāatmeti niścīyate; 'daharośminnantarākāśaḥ' iti prastutya tasminneva ātmaśabdaprayogācca; prakṛta eva para ātmā.
analyzed: śatā somya tadā saṃpannaḥ bhavati ahar ahar gacchantyaḥ etam brahma lokam na vindanti prājñena ātmanā saṃpariṣvaktaḥ parasmin ātmani saṃpratiṣṭhate ityādi śrutibhyaḥ ākāśa śabdaḥ parāatmā iti niścīyate dahara ūśmin antarākāśaḥ iti prastutya tasmin eva ātma śabda prayogāt ca prakṛtaḥ eva paraḥ ātmā

original: tasmāt yuktam 'evamevāsmādātmanaḥ' iti paramātmana eva sṛṣṭir iti; saṃsāriṇaḥ sṛṣṭisthitisaṃhārajñānasāmarthyābhāvaṃ ca avocāma. atra ca 'ātmetyevopāsīta' 'ātmānamevāvedahaṃ brahmāsmi ---' iti brahmavidyā prastutā; brahmaviṣayaṃ ca brahmavijñānamiti; 'brahma te bravāṇi' iti 'brahma jñapayiṣyāmi' iti prārabdham.
analyzed: tasmāt yuktam evam eva asmāt ātmanaḥ iti paramātmanaḥ eva sṛṣṭiḥ iti saṃsāriṇaḥ sṛṣṭi sthiti saṃhāra jñāna sāmarthya abhāvam ca avocāma atra ca ātmā iti eva upāsīta ātmānam eva avet aham brahma asmi iti brahma vidyā prastutā brahma viṣayam ca brahma vijñānam iti brahma te bravāṇi iti brahma jñapayiṣyāmi iti prārabdham

original: tatra idānīm asaṃsāri brahma jagataḥ kāraṇam aśanāyādyatītaṃ nityaśuddhabuddhamuktasvabhāvam; tadviparītaśca saṃsārī; tasmāt ahaṃ brahmāsmīti na gṛhṇīyāt; paraṃ hi devamīśānaṃ nikṛṣṭaḥ saṃsāryātmatvena smaran kathaṃ na doṣabhāksyāt; tasmāt na ahaṃ brahmāsmīti yuktam.
analyzed: tatra idānīm asaṃsāri brahma jagataḥ kāraṇam aśanāya ādi atītam nitya śuddha buddha mukta svabhāvam tad viparītaḥ ca saṃsārī tasmāt aham brahma asmi iti na gṛhṇīyāt param hi devam īśānam nikṛṣṭaḥ saṃsārī ātma tvena smaran katham na doṣa bhāj syāt tasmāt na aham brahma asmi iti yuktam

original: tasmāt puṣpodakāñjalistunamaskārabalyupahārasvādhyāyadhyānayogādibhiḥ ārirādhayiṣeta; ārādhanena viditvā sarveśitṛ brahma bhavati; na punar asaṃsāri brahma saṃsāryātmatvena cintayet --- agnim iva śītatvena ākāśam iva mūrtimattvena. brahmātmatvapratipādakamapi śāstram arthavādo bhaviṣyati. sarvatarkaśāstralokānyāyaiśca evamavirodhaḥ syāt.
analyzed: tasmāt puṣpa udaka añjali stu namaskāra bali upahāra svādhyāya dhyāna yoga ādibhiḥ ārirādhayiṣeta ārādhanena viditvā sarva īśitṛ brahma bhavati na punar asaṃsāri brahma saṃsāri ātmatvena cintayet agnim iva śīta tvena ākāśam iva mūrtimattvena brahma ātmatva pratipādakam api śāstram arthavādaḥ bhaviṣyati sarva tarka śāstra loka anyāyaiḥ ca evam avirodhaḥ syāt

original: na, mantrabrāhmaṇavādebhyaḥ tasyaiva praveśaśravaṇāt. 'puraścakre' iti prakṛtya 'puraḥ puruṣa āviśat' iti, 'rūpaṃ rūpaṃ pratirūpo babhūva tadasya rūpaṃ praticakṣaṇāya' śarvāṇi rūpāṇi vicitya dhīro nāmāni kṛtvābhivadanyadāste' iti sarvaśākhāsu sahasraśo mantravādāḥ sṛṣṭikarturevāsaṃsāriṇaḥ śarīrapraveśaṃ darśayanti.
analyzed: na mantra brāhmaṇa vādebhyaḥ tasya eva praveśa śravaṇāt puras cakre iti prakṛtya puras puruṣaḥ āviśat iti rūpam rūpam pratirūpaḥ babhūva tat asya rūpam praticakṣaṇāya śarvāṇi rūpāṇi vicitya dhīraḥ nāmāni kṛtvā abhivadan yat āste iti sarva śākhāsu sahasraśas mantra vādāḥ sṛṣṭi kartuḥ eva asaṃsāriṇaḥ śarīra praveśam darśayanti

original: tathā brāhmaṇavādāḥ --- tatsṛṣṭvā tadevānuprāviśat' śa etameva sīmānaṃ vidāryaitayā dvārā prāpadyata' śeyaṃ devatā --- imāstisro devatā anena jīvena ātmanānupraviśya' 'eṣa sarveṣu bhūteṣu gūḍhotmā na prakāśate' ityādyāḥ.
analyzed: tathā brāhmaṇa vādāḥ tat sṛṣṭvā tat eva anuprāviśat śaḥ etam eva sīmānam vidārya etayā dvārā prāpadyata śā iyam devatāḥ imāḥ tisraḥ devatāḥ anena jīvena ātmanā anupraviśya eṣa sarveṣu bhūteṣu gūḍha utmā na prakāśate ityādyāḥ

original: sarvaśrutiṣu ca brahmaṇi ātmaśabdaprayogāt ātmaśabdasya ca pratyagātmābhidhāyakatvāt, 'eṣa sarvabhūtāntarātmā' iti ca śruteḥ paramātmavyatirekeṇa saṃsāriṇo'bhāvāt --- 'ekamevādvitīyam' 'brahmaivedam' 'ātmaivedam' ityādiśrutibhyaḥ yuktameva ahaṃ brahmāsmītyavadhārayitum.
analyzed: sarva śrutiṣu ca brahmaṇi ātma śabda prayogāt ātma śabdasya ca pratyagātma abhidhāyaka tvāt eṣa sarva bhūta antarātmā iti ca śruteḥ paramātma vyatirekeṇa saṃsāriṇaḥ bhāvāt ekam eva advitīyam brahma eva idam ātmā eva idam ityādi śrutibhyaḥ yuktam eva aham brahma asmi iti avadhārayitum

original: yadā evaṃ sthitaḥ śāstrārthaḥ, tadā paramātmanaḥ saṃsāritvam; tathā ca sati śāstrānarthakyam, asaṃsāritve ca upadeśānarthakyaṃ spaṣṭo doṣaḥ prāptaḥ; yadi tāvat paramātmā sarvabhūtāntarātmā sarvaśarīrasaṃparkajanitaduḥkhāni anubhavatīti, spaṣṭaṃ parasya saṃsāritvaṃ prāptam;
analyzed: yadā evam sthitaḥ śāstra arthaḥ tadā paramātmanaḥ saṃsāri tvam tathā ca sati śāstra ānarthakyam asaṃsāri tve ca upadeśa ānarthakyam spaṣṭaḥ doṣaḥ prāptaḥ yadi tāvat paramātmā sarva bhūta antarātmā sarva śarīra saṃparka janita duḥkhāni anubhavati iti spaṣṭam parasya saṃsāri tvam prāptam

original: tathā ca parasya asaṃsāritvapratipādikāḥ śrutayaḥ kupyeran, smṛtayaśca, sarve ca nyāyāḥ; atha kathaṃcit prāṇaśarīrasaṃbandhajairduḥkhairna saṃbadhyata iti śakyaṃ pratipādayitum, paramātmanaḥ sādhyaparihāryābhāvāt upadeśānarthakyadoṣo na śakyate nivārayitum. atra kecitparihāramācakṣate --- paramātmā na sākṣādbhūteṣvanupraviṣṭaḥ svena rūpeṇa;
analyzed: tathā ca parasya asaṃsāri tva pratipādikāḥ śrutayaḥ kupyeran smṛtayaḥ ca sarve ca nyāyāḥ atha kathaṃcid prāṇa śarīra saṃbandha jaiḥ duḥkhaiḥ na saṃbadhyate iti śakyam pratipādayitum paramātmanaḥ sādhya parihārya abhāvāt upadeśa ānarthakya doṣaḥ na śakyate nivārayitum atra kecid parihāram ācakṣate paramātmā na sākṣāt bhūteṣu anupraviṣṭaḥ svena rūpeṇa

original: kiṃ tarhi vikārabhāvamāpanno vijñānātmatvaṃ pratipede; sa ca vijñānātmā parasmāt anyaḥ ananyaśca; yenānyaḥ, tena saṃsāritvasaṃbandhī, yena ananyaḥ tena ahaṃ brahmetyavadhāraṇārhaḥ; evaṃ sarvamaviruddhaṃ bhaviṣyatīti.
analyzed: kim tarhi vikāra bhāvam āpannaḥ vijñāna ātma tvam pratipede sa ca vijñāna ātmā parasmāt anyaḥ ananyaḥ ca yena anyaḥ tena saṃsāri tva saṃbandhī yena ananyaḥ tena aham brahma iti avadhāraṇa arhaḥ evam sarvam aviruddham bhaviṣyati iti

original: tatra vijñānātmano vikārapakṣa etā gatayaḥ --- pṛthivīdravyavat anekadravyasamāhārasya sāvayavasya paramātmanaḥ, ekadeśavipariṇāmo vijñānātmā ghaṭādivat; pūrvasaṃsthānāvasthasya vā parasya ekadeśo vikriyate keśoṣarādivat, sarva eva vā paraḥ pariṇamet kṣīrādivat.
analyzed: tatra vijñāna ātmanaḥ vikāra pakṣe etāḥ gatayaḥ pṛthivī dravya vat aneka dravya samāhārasya sa avayavasya paramātmanaḥ eka deśa vipariṇāmaḥ vijñāna ātmā ghaṭa ādi vat pūrva saṃsthāna avasthasya vā parasya eka deśaḥ vikriyate keśa ūṣara ādi vat sarvaḥ eva vā paraḥ pariṇamet kṣīra ādi vat

original: tatra samānajātīyānekadravyavasamūhasya kaściddravyaviśeṣo vijñānātmatvaṃ pratipadyate yadā, tadā samānajātīyatvāt ekatvamupacaritameva na tu paramārthataḥ tathā ca sati siddhāntavirodhaḥ.
analyzed: tatra samāna jātīya aneka dravya va samūhasya kaścid dravya viśeṣaḥ vijñāna ātma tvam pratipadyate yadā tadā samāna jātīya tvāt eka tvam upacaritam eva na tu paramārthataḥ tathā ca sati siddhānta virodhaḥ

original: atha nityāyutasiddhāvayavānugataḥ avayavī para ātmā, tasya tadavasthasya ekadeśo vijñānātmā saṃsārī --- tadāpi sarvāvayavānugatatvāt avayavina eva avayavagato doṣo guṇo veti, vijñānātmanaḥ saṃsāritvadoṣeṇa para eva ātmā saṃbadhyata iti, iyamapyaniṣṭā kalpanā. kṣīravat sarvapariṇāmapakṣe sarvaśrutismṛtikopaḥ, sa ca aniṣṭaḥ.
analyzed: atha nitya ayuta siddha avayava anugataḥ avayavī paraḥ ātmā tasya tad avasthasya eka deśaḥ vijñānātmā saṃsārī tadā api sarva avayava anugata tvāt avayavinaḥ eva avayava gataḥ doṣaḥ guṇaḥ vā iti vijñānātmanaḥ saṃsāri tva doṣeṇa paraḥ eva ātmā saṃbadhyate iti iyam api aniṣṭā kalpanā kṣīra vat sarva pariṇāma pakṣe sarva śruti smṛti kopaḥ sa ca aniṣṭaḥ

original: 'niṣkalaṃ niṣkriyaṃ śāntam' 'divyo hyamūrtaḥ puruṣaḥ sabāhyābhyantaro hyajaḥ' 'ākāśavatsarvagataśca nityaḥ' śa vā eṣa mahānaja ātmājaro'maro'mṛtaḥ' 'na jāyate mriyate vā kadācit' 'avyakto'yam' ityādiśrutismṛtinyāyaviruddhā ete sarve pakṣāḥ.
analyzed: niṣkalam niṣkriyam śāntam divyaḥ hi amūrtaḥ puruṣaḥ sa bāhya abhyantaraḥ hi ajaḥ ākāśa vat sarva gataḥ ca nityaḥ vai eṣa mahān ajaḥ ātmā aja roma romṛtaḥ na jāyate mriyate vā kadācid avyakta uyam ityādi śruti smṛti nyāya viruddhāḥ ete sarve pakṣāḥ

original: acalasya paramātmana ekadeśapakṣe vijñānātmanaḥ karmaphaladeśasaṃsaraṇānupapattiḥ, parasya vā saṃsāritvam --- ityuktam. parasyaikadeśaḥ agnivisphuliṅgavat sphuṭitaḥ vijñānātmā saṃsaratīti cet --- tathāpi parasyāvayavasphuṭanena kṣataprāptiḥ, tatsaṃsaraṇe ca paramātmanaḥ pradeśāntarāvayavavyūhe chidratāprāptiḥ, avraṇatvavākyavirodhaśca;
analyzed: acalasya paramātmanaḥ eka deśa pakṣe vijñānātmanaḥ karma phala deśa saṃsaraṇa anupapattiḥ parasya vā saṃsāri tvam iti uktam parasya eka deśaḥ agni visphuliṅga vat sphuṭitaḥ vijñānātmā saṃsarati iti ced tathā api parasya avayava sphuṭanena kṣata prāptiḥ tad saṃsaraṇe ca paramātmanaḥ pradeśa antara avayava vyūhe chidra tā prāptiḥ avraṇa tva vākya virodhaḥ ca

original: ātmāvayavabhūtasya vijñānātmanaḥ saṃsaraṇe paramātmaśūnyapradeśābhāvāt avayavāntaranodanavyūhanābhyāṃ hṛdayaśūleneva paramātmano duḥkhitvaprāptiḥ. agnivisphuliṅgādidṛṣṭāntaśruterna doṣa iti cet, na; śruterjñāpakatvāt --- na śāstraṃ padārthānanyathā kartuṃ pravṛttam, kiṃ tarhi yathābhūtānām ajñātānāṃ jñāpane; kiṃcātaḥ? śrṛṇu, ato yadbhavati;
analyzed: ātma avayava bhūtasya vijñānātmanaḥ saṃsaraṇe paramātma śūnya pradeśa abhāvāt avayava antara nodana vyūhanābhyām hṛdaya śūlena iva paramātmanaḥ duḥkhi tva prāptiḥ agni visphuliṅga ādi dṛṣṭānta śruteḥ na doṣaḥ iti ced na śruteḥ jñāpaka tvāt na śāstram padārthān anyathā kartum pravṛttam kim tarhi yathā bhūtānām ajñātānām jñāpane kiṃca atas śrṛṇu atas yat bhavati

original: yathābhūtā mūrtāmūrtādipadārthadharmā loke prasiddhāḥ; taddṛṣṭāntopādānena tadavirodhyeva vastvantaraṃ jñāpayituṃ pravṛttaṃ śāstraṃ na laukikavastuvirodhajñāpanāya laukikameva dṛṣṭāntamupādatte; upādīyamāno'pi dṛṣṭāntaḥ anarthakaḥ syāt, dārṣṭāntikāsaṃgateḥ;
analyzed: yathābhūtāḥ mūrta amūrta ādi padārtha dharmāḥ loke prasiddhāḥ tad dṛṣṭānta upādānena tad avirodhi eva vastu antaram jñāpayitum pravṛttam śāstram na laukika vastu virodha jñāpanāya laukikam eva dṛṣṭāntam upādatte upādīyamānaḥ api dṛṣṭāntaḥ anarthakaḥ syāt dārṣṭāntika asaṃgateḥ

original: na hi agniḥ śītaḥ ādityo na tapatīti vā dṛṣṭāntaśatenāpi pratipādayituṃ śakyam, pramāṇāntareṇa anyathādhigatatvādvastunaḥ; na ca pramāṇaṃ pramāṇāntareṇa virudhyate; pramāṇāntaraviṣayameva hi pramāṇāntaraṃ jñāpayati; na ca laukikapadapadārthāśrayaṇavyatirekeṇa āgamena śakyamajñātaṃ vastvantaram avagamayitum;
analyzed: na hi agniḥ śītaḥ ādityaḥ na tapati iti vā dṛṣṭānta śatena api pratipādayitum śakyam pramāṇa antareṇa anyathā adhigata tvāt vastunaḥ na ca pramāṇam pramāṇa antareṇa virudhyate pramāṇa antara viṣayam eva hi pramāṇa antaram jñāpayati na ca laukika pada padārtha āśrayaṇa vyatirekeṇa āgamena śakyam ajñātam vastu antaram avagamayitum

original: tasmāt prasiddhanyāyamanusaratā na śakyā paramātmanaḥ sāvayavāṃśāṃśitvakalpanā paramārthataḥ pratipādayitum. 'kṣudrā visphuliṅgāḥ' 'mamaivāṃśaḥ' iti ca śrūyate smaryate ceti cet, na, ekatvapratyayārthaparatvāt; agnerhi visphuliṅgaḥ agnireva ityekatvapratyayārho dṛṣṭo loke; tathā ca aṃśaḥ aṃśinā ekatvapratyayārhaḥ;
analyzed: tasmāt prasiddha nyāyam anusaratā na śakyā paramātmanaḥ sāvayava aṃśa aṃśi tva kalpanā paramārthataḥ pratipādayitum kṣudrāḥ visphuliṅgāḥ mama eva aṃśaḥ iti ca śrūyate smaryate ca iti ced na ekatva pratyaya artha paratvāt agneḥ hi visphuliṅgaḥ agniḥ eva iti ekatva pratyaya arhaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ loke tathā ca aṃśaḥ aṃśinā ekatva pratyaya arhaḥ

original: tatraivaṃ sati vijñānātmanaḥ paramātmavikārāṃśatvavācakāḥ śabdāḥ paramātmaikatvapratyayādhitsavaḥ. upakramopasaṃhārābhyāṃ ca --- sarvāsu hi upaniṣatsu pūrvamekatvaṃ pratijñāya, dṛṣṭāntairhetubhiśca paramātmano vikārāṃśāditvaṃ jagataḥ pratipādya, punarekatvamupasaṃharati;
analyzed: tatra evam sati vijñānātmanaḥ paramātma vikāra aṃśa tva vācakāḥ śabdāḥ paramātma ekatva pratyaya ādhitsavaḥ upakrama upasaṃhārābhyām ca sarvāsu hi upaniṣatsu pūrvam ekatvam pratijñāya dṛṣṭāntaiḥ hetubhiḥ ca paramātmanaḥ vikāra aṃśa āditvam jagataḥ pratipādya punar ekatvam upasaṃharati

original: tadyathā ihaiva tāvat 'idaṃ sarvaṃ yadayamātmā' iti pratijñāya, utpattisthitilayahetudṛṣṭāntaiḥ vikāravikāritvādyekatvapratyayahetūn pratipādya 'anantaramabāhyam' 'ayamātmā brahma' ityupasaṃhariṣyati; tasmāt upakramopasaṃhārābhyāmayamartho niścīyate --- paramātmaikatvapratyayadraḍhimne utpattisthitilayapratipādakāni vākyānīti;
analyzed: tat yathā iha eva tāvat idam sarvam yat ayam ātmā iti pratijñāya utpatti sthiti laya hetu dṛṣṭāntaiḥ vikāra vikāri tva ādi ekatva pratyaya hetūn pratipādya anantaram abāhyam ayam ātmā brahma iti upasaṃhariṣyati tasmāt upakrama upasaṃhārābhyām ayam arthaḥ niścīyate paramātma ekatva pratyaya draḍhimne utpatti sthiti laya pratipādakāni vākyāni iti

original: anyathā vākyabhedaprasaṅgācca --- sarvopaniṣatsu hi vijñānātmanaḥ paramātmanā ekatvapratyayo vidhīyata ityavipratipattiḥ sarveṣāmupaniṣadvādinām; tadvidhyekavākyayoge ca saṃbhavati utpattyādivākyānāṃ vākyāntaratvakalpanāyāṃ na pramāṇamasti; phalāntaraṃ ca kalpayitavyaṃ syāt; tasmādutpattyādiśrutaya ātmaikatvapratipādanaparāḥ.
analyzed: anyathā vākya bheda prasaṅgāt ca sarva upaniṣatsu hi vijñāna ātmanaḥ paramātmanā ekatva pratyayaḥ vidhīyate iti avipratipattiḥ sarveṣām upaniṣad vādinām tad vidhi eka vākya yoge ca saṃbhavati utpatti ādi vākyānām vākya antara tva kalpanāyām na pramāṇam asti phala antaram ca kalpayitavyam syāt tasmāt utpatti ādi śrutayaḥ ātma ekatva pratipādana parāḥ

original: atra ca saṃpradāyavida ākhyāyikāṃ saṃpracakṣate --- kaścit kila rājaputraḥ jātamātra eva mātāpitṛbhyām apaviddhaḥ vyādhagṛhe saṃvardhitaḥ; saḥ amuṣya vaṃśyatāmajānan vyādhajātipratyayaḥ vyādhajātikarmāṇyevānuvartate, na rājāsmīti rājajātikarmāṇy anuvartate;
analyzed: atra ca saṃpradāya vidaḥ ākhyāyikām saṃpracakṣate kaścid kila rāja putraḥ jāta mātraḥ eva mātā pitṛbhyām apaviddhaḥ vyādha gṛhe saṃvardhitaḥ saḥ amuṣya vaṃśya tām a jānan vyādha jāti pratyayaḥ vyādha jāti karmāṇi eva anuvartate na rājā asmi iti rāja jāti karmāṇi anuvartate

original: yadā punaḥ kaścit paramakāruṇikaḥ rājaputrasya rājaśrīprāptiyogyatāṃ jānan amuṣya putratāṃ bodhayati --- 'na tvaṃ vyādhaḥ, amuṣya rājñaḥ putraḥ; kathaṃcidvyādhagṛhamanupraviṣṭaḥ' iti --- sa evaṃ bodhitaḥ tyaktvā vyādhajātipratyayakarmāṇi pitṛpaitāmahīm ātmanaḥ padavīmanuvartate --- rājāhamasmīti.
analyzed: yadā punar kaścid parama kāruṇikaḥ rāja putrasya rāja śrī prāpti yogyatām jānan amuṣya putra tām bodhayati na tvam vyādhaḥ amuṣya rājñaḥ putraḥ kathaṃcid vyādha gṛham anupraviṣṭaḥ iti saḥ evam bodhitaḥ tyaktvā vyādha jāti pratyaya karmāṇi pitṛpaitāmahīm ātmanaḥ padavīm anuvartate rājā aham asmi iti

original: tathā kila ayaṃ parasmāt agnivisphuliṅgādivat tajjātir eva vibhaktaḥ iha dehendriyādigahane praviṣṭaḥ asaṃsārī san dehendriyādisaṃsāradharmamanuvartate --- dehendriyasaṃghātośmi kṛśaḥ sthūlaḥ sukhī duḥkhīti --- paramātmatāmajānannātmanaḥ;
analyzed: tathā kila ayam parasmāt agni visphuliṅga ādi vat tad jātiḥ eva vibhaktaḥ iha deha indriya ādi gahane praviṣṭaḥ asaṃsārī san deha indriya ādi saṃsāra dharmam anuvartate deha indriya saṃghāta ūśmi kṛśaḥ sthūlaḥ sukhī duḥkhī iti parama ātma tām a jānan ātmanaḥ

original: na tvam etadātmakaḥ parameva brahmāsi asaṃsārī --- iti pratibodhita ācāryeṇa, hitvā eṣaṇātrayānuvattiḥ brahmaivāsmīti pratipadyate. atra rājaputrasya rājapratyayavat brahmapratyayo dṛḍhī bhavatī --- visphuliṅgavadeva tvaṃ parasmādbrahmaṇo bhraṣṭa ityukte, visphuliṅgasya prāgagnerbhraṃśāt agnyekatvadarśanāt.
analyzed: na tvam etad ātmakaḥ param eva brahma asi asaṃsārī iti pratibodhitaḥ ācāryeṇa hitvā eṣaṇā traya anuvattiḥ brahma eva asmi iti pratipadyate atra rāja putrasya rāja pratyaya vat brahma pratyayaḥ dṛḍhī bhavatī visphuliṅga vat eva tvam parasmāt brahmaṇaḥ bhraṣṭaḥ iti ukte visphuliṅgasya prāk agneḥ bhraṃśāt agni eka tva darśanāt

original: tasmāt ekatvapratyayadārḍhyāya suvarṇamaṇilohāgnivisphuliṅgadṛṣṭāntāḥ, na utpattyādibhedapratipādanaparāḥ. saindhavaghanavat prajñaptyekarasanairantaryāvadhāraṇāt 'ekadhaivānudraṣṭavyam' iti ca --- yadi ca brahmaṇaḥ citrapaṭavat vṛkṣasamudrādivacca utpattyādyanekadharmavicitratā vijigrāhayiṣitā, ekarasaṃ saindhavaghanavadanantaramabāhyam --- iti
analyzed: tasmāt ekatva pratyaya dārḍhyāya suvarṇa maṇi loha agni visphuliṅga dṛṣṭāntāḥ na utpatti ādi bheda pratipādana parāḥ saindhava ghana vat prajñapti ekarasa nairantarya avadhāraṇāt ekadhā eva anudraṣṭavyam iti ca yadi ca brahmaṇaḥ citra paṭa vat vṛkṣa samudra ādi vat ca utpatti ādi aneka dharma vicitra tā vijigrāhayiṣitā ekarasam saindhava ghana vat anantaram abāhyam iti

original: nopasamahariṣyat, 'ekadhaivānudraṣṭavamay' iti ca na prāyokṣyata --- 'ya iha nāneva paśyati' iti nindāvacanaṃ ca. tasmāt ekarūpaikatvapratyayadārḍhyāyaiva sarvavedānteṣu utpattisthitilayādikalpanā, na tatpratyayakaraṇāya.
analyzed: na upasamahariṣyat ekadhā eva anudraṣṭavamai iti ca na prāyokṣyata yaḥ iha nānā iva paśyati iti nindā vacanam ca tasmāt eka rūpa ekatva pratyaya dārḍhyāya eva sarva vedānteṣu utpatti sthiti laya ādi kalpanā na tad pratyaya karaṇāya

original: na ca niravayavasya paramātmanaḥ asaṃsāriṇaḥ saṃsāryekadeśakalpanā nyāyyā, svato'deśatvāt paramātmanaḥ. adeśasya parasya ekadeśasaṃsāritvakalpanāyāṃ para eva saṃsārīti kalpitaṃ bhavet. atha paropādhikṛta ekadeśaḥ parasya, ghaṭakarakādyākāśavat. na tadā tatra vivekināṃ paramātmaikadeśaḥ pṛthaksaṃvyavahārabhāgiti buddhirutpadyate.
analyzed: na ca niravayavasya paramātmanaḥ asaṃsāriṇaḥ saṃsāri eka deśa kalpanā nyāyyā svatas deśa tvāt paramātmanaḥ adeśasya parasya eka deśa saṃsāri tva kalpanāyām paraḥ eva saṃsārī iti kalpitam bhavet atha para upādhi kṛtaḥ eka deśaḥ parasya ghaṭa karaka ādi ākāśa vat na tadā tatra vivekinām paramātma eka deśaḥ pṛthak saṃvyavahāra bhāj iti buddhiḥ utpadyate

original: avivekināṃ vivekināṃ ca upacaritā buddhirdṛṣṭeti cet, na, avivekināṃ mithyābuddhitvāt, vivekināṃ ca saṃvyavahāramātrālambanārthatvāt --- yathā kṛṣṇo raktaśca ākāśa iti vivekināmapi kadācit kṛṣṇatā raktatā ca ākāśasya saṃvyavahāramātrālambanārthatvaṃ pratipadyata iti, na paramārthataḥ kṛṣṇo rakto vā ākāśo bhavitumarhati.
analyzed: avivekinām vivekinām ca upacaritā buddhiḥ dṛṣṭā iti ced na avivekinām mithyā buddhi tvāt vivekinām ca saṃvyavahāra mātra ālambana artha tvāt yathā kṛṣṇaḥ raktaḥ ca ākāśaḥ iti vivekinām api kadācid kṛṣṇa tā rakta tā ca ākāśasya saṃvyavahāra mātra ālambana artha tvam pratipadyate iti na paramārthataḥ kṛṣṇaḥ raktaḥ vā ākāśaḥ bhavitum arhati

original: ato na paṇḍitairbrahmasvarūpapratipattiviṣaye brahmaṇaḥ aṃśāṃśyekadeśaikadeśivikāravikāritvakalpanā kāryā, sarvakalpanāpanayanārthasāraparatvāt sarvopaniṣadām. ato hitvā sarvakalpanām ākāśasyeva nirviśeṣatā pratipattavyā --- 'ākāśavatsarvagataśca nityaḥ' 'na lipyate lokaduḥkhena bāhyaḥ' ityādiśrutiśatebhyaḥ.
analyzed: atas na paṇḍitaiḥ brahma svarūpa pratipatti viṣaye brahmaṇaḥ aṃśa aṃśi eka deśa eka deśi vikāra vikāri tva kalpanā kāryā sarva kalpanā apanayana artha sāra para tvāt sarva upaniṣadām atas hitvā sarva kalpanām ākāśasya iva nirviśeṣa tā pratipattavyā ākāśa vat sarva gataḥ ca nityaḥ na lipyate loka duḥkhena bāhyaḥ ityādi śruti śatebhyaḥ

original: na ātmānaṃ brahmavilakṣaṇaṃ kalpayet --- uṣṇātmaka ivāgnau śītaikadeśam, prakāśātmake vā savitari tamaekadeśam --- sarvakalpanāpanayanārthasāraparatvāt sarvopaniṣadām.
analyzed: na ātmānam brahma vilakṣaṇam kalpayet uṣṇa ātmake iva agnau śīta eka deśam prakāśa ātmake vā savitari tamaḥ eka deśam sarva kalpanā apanayana artha sāra para tvāt sarva upaniṣadām

original: tasmāt nāmarūpopādhinimittā eva ātmani asaṃsāradharmiṇi sarve vyavahārāḥ --- 'rūpaṃ rūpaṃ pratirūpo babhūva' 'sarvāṇi rūpāṇi vicitya dhīro nāmāni kṛtvābhivadanyadāste' ityevamādimantravarṇebhyaḥ --- na svata ātmanaḥ saṃsāritvam, alaktakādyupādhisaṃyogajanitaraktasphaṭikādibuddhivat bhrāntameva na paramārthataḥ.
analyzed: tasmāt nāma rūpa upādhi nimittāḥ eva ātmani asaṃsāra dharmiṇi sarve vyavahārāḥ rūpam rūpam pratirūpaḥ babhūva sarvāṇi rūpāṇi vicitya dhīraḥ nāmāni kṛtvā abhivat anyat āste iti evamādi mantra varṇebhyaḥ na svatas ātmanaḥ saṃsāri tvam alaktaka ādi upādhi saṃyoga janita rakta sphaṭika ādi buddhi vat bhrāntam eva na paramārthataḥ

original: 'dhyāyatīva lelāyatīva' 'na karmaṇā vardhate no kanīyān' 'na karmaṇā lipyate pāpakena' śamaṃ sarveṣu bhūteṣu tiṣṭhantam' 'śuni caiva śvapāke ca' ityādiśrutismṛtinyāyebhyaḥ paramātmanośaṃsāritaiva. ata ekadeśo vikāraḥ śaktirvā vijñānātmā anyo veti vikalpayituṃ niravayavatvābhyupagame viśeṣato na śakyate.
analyzed: dhyāyati iva lelāyati iva na karmaṇā vardhate no kanīyān na karmaṇā lipyate pāpakena śamam sarveṣu bhūteṣu tiṣṭhantam śuni ca eva śvapāke ca ityādi śruti smṛti nyāyebhyaḥ atas eka deśaḥ vikāraḥ śaktiḥ vā vijñānātmā anyaḥ vā iti vikalpayitum niravayava tva abhyupagame viśeṣataḥ na śakyate

original: aṃśādiśrutismṛtivādāśca ekatvārthāḥ, na tu bhedapratipādakāḥ, vivakṣitārthaikavākyayogāt --- ityavocāma.
analyzed: aṃśa ādi śruti smṛti vādāḥ ca ekatva arthāḥ na tu bheda pratipādakāḥ vivakṣita artha eka vākya yogāt iti avocāma

original: sarvopaniṣadāṃ paramātmaikatvajñāpanaparatve atha kimarthaṃ tatpratikūlo'rthaḥ vijñānātmabhedaḥ parikalpyata iti. karmakāṇḍaprāmāṇyavirodhaparihārāyetyeke; karmapratipādakāni hi vākyāni anekakriyākārakaphalabhoktṛkartrāśrayāṇi,
analyzed: sarva upaniṣadām paramātma ekatva jñāpana paratve atha kimartham tad pratikūlaḥ ūrthaḥ vijñāna ātma bhedaḥ parikalpyate iti karmakāṇḍa prāmāṇya virodha parihārāya iti eke karma pratipādakāni hi vākyāni aneka kriyā kāraka phala bhoktṛ kartṛ āśrayāṇi

original: vijñānātmabhedābhāve hi asaṃsāriṇa eva paramātmana ekatve, katham iṣṭaphalāsu kriyāsu pravartayeyuḥ, aniṣṭaphalābhyo vā kriyābhyo nivartayetuḥ? kasya vā baddhasya mokṣāya upaniṣadārabhyeta? api ca paramātmaikatvavādipakṣe kathaṃ paramātmaikatvopadeśaḥ? kathaṃ vā tadupadeśagrahaṇaphalam? baddhasya hi bandhanāśāya upadeśaḥ;
analyzed: vijñāna ātma bheda abhāve hi asaṃsāriṇaḥ eva paramātmanaḥ ekatve katham iṣṭa phalāsu kriyāsu pravartayeyuḥ aniṣṭa phalābhyaḥ vā kriyābhyaḥ nivartayetuḥ kasya vā baddhasya mokṣāya upaniṣad ārabhyeta api ca paramātma ekatva vādi pakṣe katham paramātma ekatva upadeśaḥ katham vā tad upadeśa grahaṇa phalam baddhasya hi bandha nāśāya upadeśaḥ

original: tadabhāve upaniṣacchāstraṃ nirviṣayameva. evaṃ tarhi upaniṣadvādipakṣasya karmakāṇḍavādipakṣeṇa codyaparihārayoḥ samānaḥ panthāḥ --- yena bhedābhāve karmakāṇḍaṃ nirālambanamātmānaṃ na labhate prāmāṇyaṃ prati, tathā upaniṣadapi. evaṃ tarhi yasya prāmāṇye svārthavighāto nāsti, tasyaiva karmakāṇḍasyāstu prāmāṇyam;
analyzed: tad abhāve upaniṣad śāstram nirviṣayam eva evam tarhi upaniṣad vādi pakṣasya karmakāṇḍa vādi pakṣeṇa codya parihārayoḥ samānaḥ panthāḥ yena bheda abhāve karmakāṇḍam nirālambanam ātmānam na labhate prāmāṇyam prati tathā upaniṣad api evam tarhi yasya prāmāṇye svārtha vighātaḥ na asti tasya eva karmakāṇḍasya astu prāmāṇyam

original: upaniṣadāṃ tu prāmāṇyakalpanāyāṃ svārthavighāto bhavediti mā bhūtprāmāṇyam. na hi karmakāṇḍaṃ pramāṇaṃ sat apramāṇaṃ bhavitumarhati; na hi pradīpaḥ prakāśyaṃ prakāśayati, na prakāśayati ca iti. pratyakṣādipramāṇavipratiṣedhācca --- na kevalamupaniṣado brahmaikatvaṃ pratipādayantyaḥ svārthavighātaṃ karmakāṇḍaprāmāṇyavighātaṃ ca kurvanti;
analyzed: upaniṣadām tu prāmāṇya kalpanāyām svārtha vighātaḥ bhavet iti mā bhūt prāmāṇyam na hi karmakāṇḍam pramāṇam sat apramāṇam bhavitum arhati na hi pradīpaḥ prakāśyam prakāśayati na prakāśayati ca iti pratyakṣa ādi pramāṇa vipratiṣedhāt ca na kevalam upaniṣadaḥ brahma eka tvam pratipādayantyaḥ svārtha vighātam karmakāṇḍa prāmāṇya vighātam ca kurvanti

original: pratyakṣādiniścitabhedapratipattyarthapramāṇaiśca virudhyante. tasmādaprāmāṇyameva upaniṣadām; anyarthatā vāstu; na tveva brahmaikatvapratipattyarthatā.
analyzed: pratyakṣa ādi niścita bheda pratipatti artha pramāṇaiḥ ca virudhyante tasmāt aprāmāṇyam eva upaniṣadām anyartha tā vā astu na tu eva brahma ekatva pratipatti artha tā

original: na uktottaratvāt. pramāṇasya hi pramāṇatvam apramāṇatvaṃ vā pramotpādanānutpādananimittam, anyathā cet stambhādīnāṃ prāmāṇyaprasaṅgāt śabdādau prameye. kiṃcātaḥ? yadi tāvat upaniṣado brahmaikatvapratipattipramāṃ kurvanti, kathamapramāṇaṃ bhaveyuḥ.
analyzed: na ukta uttara tvāt pramāṇasya hi pramāṇa tvam apramāṇa tvam vā pramā utpādana anutpādana nimittam anyathā ced stambha ādīnām prāmāṇya prasaṅgāt śabda ādau prameye kiṃca atas yadi tāvat upaniṣadaḥ brahma ekatva pratipatti pramām kurvanti katham apramāṇam bhaveyuḥ

original: na kurvantyeveti cet --- yathā agniḥ śītam --- iti, sa bhavānevaṃ vadan vaktavyaḥ --- upaniṣatprāmāṇyapratiṣedhārthaṃ bhavato vākyam upaniṣatprāmāṇyapratiṣedhaṃ kiṃ na karotyeva, agnirvā rūpaprakāśam; atha karoti --- yadi karoti, bhavatu tadā pratiṣedhārthaṃ pramāṇaṃ bhavadvākyam, agniśca rūpaprakāśako bhavet;
analyzed: na kurvanti eva iti ced yathā agniḥ śītam iti sa bhavān evam vadan vaktavyaḥ upaniṣad prāmāṇya pratiṣedha artham bhavataḥ vākyam upaniṣad prāmāṇya pratiṣedham kim na karoti eva agniḥ vā rūpa prakāśam atha karoti yadi karoti bhavatu tadā pratiṣedha artham pramāṇam bhavat vākyam agniḥ ca rūpa prakāśakaḥ bhavet

original: pratiṣedhavākyaprāmāṇye bhavatyevopaniṣadāṃ prāmāṇyam. annabhavanto bruvantu kaḥ parihāra iti. nanu atra pratyakṣā madvākya upaniṣatprāmāṇyapratiṣedhārthapratipattiḥ agnau ca rūpaprakāśanapratipattiḥ pramā; kastarhi bhavataḥ pradveṣaḥ brahmaikatvapratyaye pramāṃ pratyakṣaṃ kurvatīṣu upaniṣatsu upalabhyamānāsu? pratiṣedhānupapatteḥ.
analyzed: pratiṣedha vākya prāmāṇye bhavati eva upaniṣadām prāmāṇyam anna bhavantaḥ bruvantu kaḥ parihāraḥ iti nanu atra pratyakṣā mad vākye upaniṣad prāmāṇya pratiṣedha artha pratipattiḥ agnau ca rūpa prakāśana pratipattiḥ pramā kaḥ tarhi bhavataḥ pradveṣaḥ brahma eka tva pratyaye pramām pratyakṣam kurvatīṣu upaniṣatsu upalabhyamānāsu pratiṣedha anupapatteḥ

original: śokamohādinivṛttiśca pratyakṣaṃ phalaṃ brahmaikatvapratipattipāramparyajanitam ityavocāma. tasmād uktottaratvāt upaniṣadaṃ prati aprāmāṇyaśaṅkā tāvan nāsti.
analyzed: śoka moha ādi nivṛttiḥ ca pratyakṣam phalam brahma ekatva pratipatti pāramparya janitam iti avocāma tasmāt ukta uttara tvāt upaniṣadam prati aprāmāṇya śaṅkā tāvat nā asti

original: yaccoktam svārthavighātakaratvādaprāmāṇyamiti, tadapi na, tadarthapratipatterbādhakābhāvāt. na hi upaniṣadbhyaḥ --- brahmaikamevādvitīyam, naiva ca --- iti pratipattirasti --- yathā agniruṣṇaḥ śītaścetyasmādvākyāt viruddhārthadvayapratipattiḥ. abhyupagamya caitadavocāma;
analyzed: yat ca uktam svārtha vighāta kara tvāt aprāmāṇyam iti tat api na tad artha pratipatteḥ bādhaka abhāvāt na hi upaniṣadbhyaḥ brahma ekam eva advitīyam na eva ca iti pratipattiḥ asti yathā agniḥ uṣṇaḥ śītaḥ ca iti asmāt vākyāt viruddha artha dvaya pratipattiḥ abhyupagamya ca etat avocāma

original: na tu vākyaprāmāṇyasamaye eṣa nyāyaḥ --- yaduta ekasya vākyasya anekārthatvam; sati ca anekārthatve, svārthaśca syāt, tadvighātakṛcca viruddhaḥ anyo'rthaḥ. na tvetat --- vākyapramāṇakānāṃ viruddhamaviruddhaṃ ca, ekaṃ vākyam, anekamarthaṃ pratipādayatītyeṣa samayaḥ; arthaikatvāddhi ekavākyatā.
analyzed: na tu vākya prāmāṇya samaye eṣa nyāyaḥ yat uta ekasya vākyasya aneka artha tvam sati ca aneka artha tve svārthaḥ ca syāt tad vighāta kṛt ca viruddhaḥ anyaḥ arthaḥ na tu etat vākya pramāṇakānām viruddham aviruddham ca ekam vākyam anekam artham pratipādayati iti eṣa samayaḥ artha eka tvāt hi eka vākya tā

original: na ca kānicidupaniṣadvākyāni brahmaikatvapratiṣedhaṃ kurvanti. yattu laukikaṃ vākyam --- agniruṣṇaḥ śītaśceti, na tatra ekavākyatā, tadekadeśasya pramāṇāntaraviṣayānuvāditvāt; agniḥ śīta ityetat ekaṃ vākyam; agniruṣṇa iti tu pramāṇāntarānubhavasmārakam, na tu svayamarthāvabodhakam;
analyzed: na ca kānicid upaniṣad vākyāni brahma ekatva pratiṣedham kurvanti yat tu laukikam vākyam agniḥ uṣṇaḥ śītaḥ ca iti na tatra ekavākyatā tad eka deśasya pramāṇa antara viṣaya anuvādi tvāt agniḥ śītaḥ iti etat ekam vākyam agniḥ uṣṇaḥ iti tu pramāṇa antara anubhava smārakam na tu svayam artha avabodhakam

original: ato na agniḥ śīta ityanena ekavākyatā, pramāṇāntarānubhavasmāraṇenaivopakṣīṇatvāt. yattu viruddhārthapratipādakamidaṃ vākyamiti manyate, tat śītoṣṇapadābhyām agnipadasāmānādhikaraṇyaprayoganimittā bhrāntiḥ; na tveva ekasya vākyasya anekārthatvaṃ laukikasya vaidikasya vā.
analyzed: atas na agniḥ śītaḥ iti anena eka vākyatā pramāṇa antara anubhava smāraṇena eva upakṣīṇa tvāt yat tu viruddha artha pratipādakam idam vākyam iti manyate tat śīta uṣṇa padābhyām agni pada sāmānādhikaraṇya prayoga nimittā bhrāntiḥ na tu eva ekasya vākyasya aneka artha tvam laukikasya vaidikasya vā

original: yaccoktam --- karmakāṇḍaprāmāṇyavighātakṛt upaniṣadvākyamiti, tanna, anyārthatvāt. brahmaikatvapratipādanaparā hi upaniṣadaḥ na iṣṭārthaprāptau sādhanopadeśaṃ tasminvā puruṣaniyogaṃ vārayanti, anekārthatvānupapattereva. na ca karmakāṇḍavākyānāṃ svārthe pramā notpadyate. asādhāraṇe cetsvārthe pramām utpādayati vākyam, kuto'nyena virodhaḥ syāt.
analyzed: yat ca uktam karmakāṇḍa prāmāṇya vighāta kṛt upaniṣad vākyam iti tat na anya artha tvāt brahma eka tva pratipādana parāḥ hi upaniṣadaḥ na iṣṭa artha prāptau sādhana upadeśam tasmin vā puruṣa niyogam vārayanti aneka artha tva anupapatteḥ eva na ca karmakāṇḍa vākyānām sva arthe pramā na utpadyate asādhāraṇe ced sva arthe pramām utpādayati vākyam kutonyena virodhaḥ syāt

original: brahmaikatve nirviṣayatvāt pramā notpadyata eveti cet, na, pratyakṣatvātpramāyāḥ. 'darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ svargakāmo yajeta' 'brāhmaṇo na hantavyaḥ' ityevamādivākyebhyaḥ pratyakṣā pramā jāyamānā; sā naiva bhaviṣyati, yadyupaniṣado brahmaikatvaṃ bodhayiṣyantītyanumānam; na ca anumānaṃ pratyakṣavirodhe prāmāṇyaṃ labhate;
analyzed: brahma ekatve nirviṣaya tvāt pramā nā utpadyate eva iti ced na pratyakṣa tvāt pramāyāḥ darśa pūrṇamāsābhyām svarga kāmaḥ yajeta brāhmaṇaḥ na hantavyaḥ iti evamādi vākyebhyaḥ pratyakṣā pramā jāyamānā sā nā eva bhaviṣyati yadi upaniṣadaḥ brahma ekatvam bodhayiṣyanti iti anumānam na ca anumānam pratyakṣa virodhe prāmāṇyam labhate

original: tasmādasadevaitadgīyate --- pramaiva notpadyata iti. api ca yathāprāptasyaiva avidyāpratyupasthāpitasya kriyākārakaphalasya āśrayaṇena iṣṭāniṣṭaprāptiparihāropāyasāmānye pravṛttasya tadviśeṣamajānataḥ tadācakṣāṇā śrutiḥ kriyākārakaphalabhedasya lokaprasiddhasya satyatām asatyatāṃ vā na ācaṣṭe na ca vārayati,
analyzed: tasmāt asat eva etat gīyate pramā eva na utpadyate iti api ca yathāprāptasya eva avidyā pratyupasthāpitasya kriyā kāraka phalasya āśrayaṇena iṣṭa aniṣṭa prāpti parihāra upāya sāmānye pravṛttasya tad viśeṣam a jānataḥ tad ācakṣāṇā śrutiḥ kriyā kāraka phala bhedasya loka prasiddhasya satya tām asatya tām vā na ācaṣṭe na ca vārayati

original: iṣṭāniṣṭaphalaprāptiparihāropāyavidhiparatvāt. yathā kāmyeṣu pravṛttā śrutiḥ kāmānāṃ mithyājñānaprabhavatve satyapi yathāprāptāneva kāmānupādāya tatsādhanānyeva vidhatte, na tu --- kāmānāṃ mithyājñānaprabhavatvādanartharūpatvaṃ ceti --- na vidadhāti;
analyzed: iṣṭa aniṣṭa phala prāpti parihāra upāya vidhi paratvāt yathā kāmyeṣu pravṛttā śrutiḥ kāmānām mithyājñāna prabhava tve sati api yathā prāptān eva kāmān upādāya tad sādhanāni eva vidhatte na tu kāmānām mithyājñāna prabhava tvāt anartha rūpa tvam ca iti na vidadhāti

original: tathā nityāgnihotrādiśāstramapi mithyājñānaprabhavaṃ kriyākārakabhedaṃ yathāprāptameva ādāya iṣṭaviśeṣaprāptim aniṣṭaviśeṣaparihāraṃ vā kimapi prayojanaṃ paśyat agnihotrādīni karmāṇi vidhatte,na --- avidyāgocarāsadvastuviṣayamiti --- na pravartate --- yathā kāmyeṣu. na ca puruṣā na pravarteran avidyāvantaḥ, dṛṣṭatvāt --- yathā kāminaḥ.
analyzed: tathā nitya agnihotra ādi śāstram api mithyājñāna prabhavam kriyā kāraka bhedam yathāprāptam eva ādāya iṣṭa viśeṣa prāptim aniṣṭa viśeṣa parihāram vā kim api prayojanam paśyat agnihotra ādīni karmāṇi vidhattena avidyā gocara asat vastu viṣayam iti na pravartate yathā kāmyeṣu na ca puruṣāḥ na pravarteran avidyāvantaḥ dṛṣṭa tvāt yathā kāminaḥ

original: vidyāvatāmeva karmādhikāra iti cet, na, brahmaikatvavidyāyāṃ karmādhikāravirodhasyoktatvāt. etena brahmaikatve nirviṣayatvāt upadeśena tadgrahaṇaphalābhāvadoṣaparihāra ukto veditavyaḥ. puruṣecchārāgādivaicitryācca --- anekā hi puruṣāṇāmicchā; rāgādayaśca doṣā vicitrāḥ; tataśca bāhyaviṣayarāgādyapahṛtacetaso na śāstraṃ nivartayituṃ śaktam;
analyzed: vidyāvatām eva karma adhikāraḥ iti ced na brahma ekatva vidyāyām karma adhikāra virodhasya ukta tvāt etena brahma ekatve nirviṣaya tvāt upadeśena tad grahaṇa phala abhāva doṣa parihāraḥ uktaḥ veditavyaḥ puruṣa icchā rāga ādi vaicitryāt ca anekāḥ hi puruṣāṇām icchāḥ rāga ādayaḥ ca doṣāḥ vicitrāḥ tatas ca bāhya viṣaya rāga ādi apahṛta cetasaḥ na śāstram nivartayitum śaktam

original: nāpi svabhāvato bāhyaviṣayaviraktacetaso viṣayeṣu pravartayituṃ śaktam; kiṃtu śāstrāt etāvadeva bhavati --- idamiṣṭasādhānam idamaniṣṭasādhanamiti sādhyasādhanasaṃbandaviśeṣābhivyaktiḥ --- pradīpādivat tamasi rūpādijñānam; na tu śāstraṃ bhṛtyāniva balāt nivartayati niyojayati vā; dṛśyante hi puruṣā rāgādigauravāt śāstramapyatikrāmantaḥ.
analyzed: nā api svabhāvataḥ bāhya viṣaya virakta cetasaḥ viṣayeṣu pravartayitum śaktam kiṃtu śāstrāt etāvat eva bhavati idam iṣṭa sādhānam idam aniṣṭa sādhanam iti sādhya sādhana saṃbanda viśeṣa abhivyaktiḥ pradīpa ādi vat tamasi rūpa ādi jñānam na tu śāstram bhṛtyān iva balāt nivartayati niyojayati vā dṛśyante hi puruṣāḥ rāga ādi gauravāt śāstram api atikrāmantaḥ

original: tasmāt puruṣamativaicitryamapekṣya sādhyasādhanasaṃbandhaviśeṣān anekadhā upadiśati. tatra puruṣāḥ svayameva yathāruci sādhanaviśeṣeṣu pravartante; śāstraṃ tu savitṛpradīpādivat udāsta eva. tathā kasyacitparo'pi puruṣārthaḥ apuruṣārthavadavabhāsate; yasya yathāvabhāsaḥ, sa tathārūpaṃ puruṣārthaṃ paśyati; tadanurūpāṇi sādhanānyupāditsate.
analyzed: tasmāt puruṣa mati vaicitryam apekṣya sādhya sādhana saṃbandha viśeṣān anekadhā upadiśati tatra puruṣāḥ svayam eva yathāruci sādhana viśeṣeṣu pravartante śāstram tu savitṛ pradīpa ādi vat udāste eva tathā kasyacid paraḥ api puruṣa arthaḥ a puruṣa artha vat avabhāsate yasya yathā avabhāsaḥ sa tathārūpam puruṣa artham paśyati tad anurūpāṇi sādhanāni upāditsate

original: tathā ca arthavādo'pi --- 'trayāḥ prājāpatyāḥ prajāpatau pitari brahmacaryamūṣuḥ' ityādiḥ. tasmāt na brahmaikatvaṃ jñāpayiṣyanto vedāntā vidhiśāstrasya bādhakāḥ. na ca vidhiśāstram etāvatā nirviṣayaṃ syāt. nāpi uktakārakādibhedaṃ vidhiśāstram upaniṣadāṃ brahmaikatvaṃ prati prāmāṇyaṃ nivartayati. svaviṣayaśūrāṇi hi pramāṇāni, śrotrādivat.
analyzed: tathā ca arthavādaḥ api trayāḥ prājāpatyāḥ prajāpatau pitari brahmacaryam ūṣuḥ ityādiḥ tasmāt na brahma eka tvam jñāpayiṣyantaḥ vedāntāḥ vidhi śāstrasya bādhakāḥ na ca vidhi śāstram etāvatā nirviṣayam syāt nā api ukta kāraka ādi bhedam vidhi śāstram upaniṣadām brahma eka tvam prati prāmāṇyam nivartayati sva viṣaya śūrāṇi hi pramāṇāni śrotra ādi vat

original: tatra paṇḍitaṃmanyāḥ kecit svacittavaśāt sarvaṃ pramāṇam itaretaraviruddhaṃ manyante, tathā pratyakṣādivirodham api codayanti brahmaikatve --- śabdādayaḥ kila śrotrādiviṣayā bhinnāḥ pratyakṣata upalabhyante; brahmaikatvaṃ bruvatāṃ pratyakṣavirodhaḥ syāt;
analyzed: tatra paṇḍitaṃmanyāḥ kecid sva citta vaśāt sarvam pramāṇam itaretara viruddham manyante tathā pratyakṣa ādi virodham api codayanti brahma eka tve śabda ādayaḥ kila śrotra ādi viṣayāḥ bhinnāḥ pratyakṣataḥ upalabhyante brahma eka tvam bruvatām pratyakṣa virodhaḥ syāt

original: tathā śrotrādibhiḥ śabdādyupalabdhāraḥ kartāraś ca dharmādharmayoḥ pratiśarīraṃ bhinnā anumīyante saṃsāriṇaḥ; tatra brahmaikatvaṃ bruvatām anumānavirodhaś ca; tathā ca āgamavirodhaṃ vadanti --- 'grāmakāmo yajeta' 'paśukāmo yajeta' 'svargakāmo yajeta' ityevamādivākyebhyaḥ grāmapaśusvargādikāmāḥ tatsādhanādyanuṣṭhātāraś ca bhinnā avagamyante.
analyzed: tathā śrotra ādibhiḥ śabda ādi upalabdhāraḥ kartāraḥ ca dharma adharmayoḥ pratiśarīram bhinnāḥ anumīyante saṃsāriṇaḥ tatra brahma eka tvam bruvatām anumāna virodhaḥ ca tathā ca āgama virodham vadanti grāma kāmaḥ yajeta paśu kāmaḥ yajeta svarga kāmaḥ yajeta iti evamādi vākyebhyaḥ grāma paśu svarga ādi kāmāḥ tad sādhana ādi anuṣṭhātāraḥ ca bhinnāḥ avagamyante

original: atrocyate --- te tu kutarkadūṣitāntaḥkaraṇāḥ brāhmaṇādivarṇāpaśadāḥ anukampanīyāḥ āgamārthavicchinnasaṃpradāyabuddhaya iti. katham? śrotrādidvāraiḥ śabdādibhiḥ pratyakṣata upalabhyamānaiḥ brahmaṇa ekatvaṃ virudhyata iti vadanto vaktavyāḥ --- kiṃ śabdādīnāṃ bhedena ākāśaikatvaṃ virudhyata iti; atha na virudhyate, na tarhi pratyakṣavirodhaḥ.
analyzed: atra ucyate te tu kutarka dūṣita antaḥkaraṇāḥ brāhmaṇa ādi varṇa apaśadāḥ anukampanīyāḥ āgama artha vicchinna saṃpradāya buddhayaḥ iti katham śrotra ādi dvāraiḥ śabda ādibhiḥ pratyakṣataḥ upalabhyamānaiḥ brahmaṇaḥ ekatvam virudhyate iti vadantaḥ vaktavyāḥ kim śabda ādīnām bhedena ākāśa ekatvam virudhyate iti atha na virudhyate na tarhi pratyakṣa virodhaḥ

original: yaccoktam --- pratiśarīraṃ śabdādyupalabdhāraḥ dharmādharmayośca kartāraḥ bhinnā anumīyante, tathā ca brahmaikatve'numānavirodha iti; bhinnāḥ kairanumīyanta iti praṣṭavyāḥ; atha yadi brūyuḥ --- sarvairasmābhiranumānakuśalairiti --- ke yūyam anumānakuśalā ityevaṃ pṛṣṭānāṃ kimuttaram;
analyzed: yat ca uktam pratiśarīram śabda ādi upalabdhāraḥ dharma adharmayoḥ ca kartāraḥ bhinnāḥ anumīyante tathā ca brahma ekatva inumāna virodhaḥ iti bhinnāḥ kaiḥ anumīyante iti praṣṭavyāḥ atha yadi brūyuḥ sarvaiḥ asmābhiḥ anumāna kuśalaiḥ iti ke yūyam anumāna kuśalāḥ iti evam pṛṣṭānām kim uttaram

original: śarīrendriyamanāatmasu ca pratyekamanumānakauśalapratyākhyāne, śarīrendriyamanaḥsādhanā ātmāno vayamanumānakuśalāḥ, anekakārakasādhyatvātkriyāṇāmiti cet --- evaṃ tarhi anumānakauśale bhavatāmanekatvaprasaṅgaḥ; anekakārakasādhyā hi kriyeti bhavadbhirevābhyupagatam; tatra anumānaṃ ca kriyā;
analyzed: ca pratyekam anumāna kauśala pratyākhyāne śarīra indriya manaḥ sādhanāḥ ātmānaḥ vayam anumāna kuśalāḥ aneka kāraka sādhya tvāt kriyāṇām iti ced evam tarhi anumāna kauśale bhavatām aneka tva prasaṅgaḥ aneka kāraka sādhyā hi kriyā iti bhavadbhiḥ eva abhyupagatam tatra anumānam ca kriyā

original: sā śarīrendriyamanāatmasādhanaiḥ kārakaiḥ ātmakartṛkā nirvartyata ityetatpratijñātam; tatra vayamanumānakuśalā ityevaṃ vadadbhiḥ --- śarīrendriyamanaḥsādhanā ātmānaḥ pratyekaṃ vayamaneke --- ityabhyupagataṃ syāt; aho anumānakauśalaṃ darśitam apucchaśrṛṅgaiḥ tārkikabalīvardaiḥ.
analyzed: sā kārakaiḥ ātma kartṛkā nirvartyate iti etat pratijñātam tatra vayam anumāna kuśalāḥ iti evam vadadbhiḥ śarīra indriya manaḥ sādhanāḥ ātmānaḥ pratyekam vayam aneke iti abhyupagatam syāt aho anumāna kauśalam darśitam apuccha śrṛṅgaiḥ tārkika balīvardaiḥ

original: yo hi ātmānam eva na jānāti, sa kathaṃ mūḍhaḥ tadgataṃ bhedam abhedaṃ vā jānīyāt; tatra kim anuminoti? kena vā liṅgena? na hi ātmanaḥ svato bhedapratipādakaṃ kiṃcil liṅgam asti, yena liṅgena ātmabhedaṃ sādhayet;
analyzed: yaḥ hi ātmānam eva na jānāti sa katham mūḍhaḥ tad gatam bhedam abhedam vā jānīyāt tatra kim anuminoti kena vā liṅgena na hi ātmanaḥ svatas bheda pratipādakam kiṃcid liṅgam asti yena liṅgena ātma bhedam sādhayet

original: yāni liṅgāni ātmabhedasādhanāya nāmarūpavanti upanyasyanti, tāni nāmarūpagatāni upādhaya eva ātmanaḥ --- ghaṭakarakāpavarakabhūchidrāṇīva ākāśasya; yadā ākāśasya bhedaliṅgaṃ paśyati, tadā ātmano'pi bhedaliṅgaṃ labheta saḥ; na hy ātmanaḥ parato viśeṣam abhyupagacchadbhis tārkikaśatair api bhedaliṅgam ātmano darśayituṃ śakyate;
analyzed: yāni liṅgāni ātma bheda sādhanāya nāma rūpavanti upanyasyanti tāni nāma rūpa gatāni upādhayaḥ eva ātmanaḥ ghaṭa karaka apavaraka bhū chidrāṇi iva ākāśasya yadā ākāśasya bheda liṅgam paśyati tadā ātmanaḥ api bheda liṅgam labheta saḥ na hi ātmanaḥ paratas viśeṣam abhyupagacchadbhiḥ tārkika śataiḥ api bheda liṅgam ātmanaḥ darśayitum śakyate

original: svatas tu dūrād apanītam eva, aviṣayatvād ātmanaḥ. yad yat paraḥ ātmadharmatvenābhyupagacchati, tasya tasya nāmarūpātmakatvābhyupagamāt, nāmarūpābhyāṃ ca ātmano'nyatvābhyupagamāt, 'ākāśo vai nāma nāmarūpayornirvahitā te yadantarā tadbrahma' iti śruteḥ, 'nāmarūpe vyākaravāṇi' iti ca --- utpattipralayātmake hi nāmarūpe, tadvilakṣaṇaṃ ca brahma ---
analyzed: svatas tu dūrāt apanītam eva aviṣaya tvāt ātmanaḥ yat yat paraḥ ātma dharma tvena abhyupagacchati tasya tasya nāma rūpa ātmaka tva abhyupagamāt nāma rūpābhyām ca ātmanaḥ nyatva abhyupagamāt ākāśaḥ vai nāma nāma rūpayoḥ nirvahitā te yat antarā tat brahma iti śruteḥ nāma rūpe vyākaravāṇi iti ca utpatti pralaya ātmake hi nāma rūpe tad vilakṣaṇam ca brahma

original: ataḥ anumānasyaivāviṣayatvāt kuto'numānavirodhaḥ. etena āgamavirodhaḥ pratyuktaḥ. yaduktam --- brahmaikatve yasmai upadeśaḥ, yasya ca upadeśagrahaṇaphalam, tadabhāvāt ekatvopadeśānarthakyamiti --- tadapi na, anekakārakasādhyatvātkriyāṇāṃ kaścodyo bhavati; ekasminbrahmaṇi nirupādhike nopadeśaḥ, nopadeṣṭā, na ca upadeśagrahaṇaphalam;
analyzed: atas anumānasya eva aviṣaya tvāt kutas anumāna virodhaḥ etena āgama virodhaḥ pratyuktaḥ yat uktam brahma ekatve yasmai upadeśaḥ yasya ca upadeśa grahaṇa phalam tad abhāvāt ekatva upadeśa ānarthakyam iti tat api na aneka kāraka sādhya tvāt kriyāṇām kaḥ codyaḥ bhavati ekasmin brahmaṇi nirupādhike na upadeśaḥ na upadeṣṭā na ca upadeśa grahaṇa phalam

original: tasmād upaniṣadāṃ ca ānarthakyam ity etat abhyupagatame va; atha anekakārakaviṣayānarthakyaṃ codyate --- na, svato 'bhyupagamavirodhād ātmavādinām.
analyzed: tasmāt upaniṣadām ca ānarthakyam iti etat atha aneka kāraka viṣaya ānarthakyam codyate na svatas bhyupagama virodhāt ātmavādinām

original: tasmāt tārkikacāṭabhaṭarājāpraveśyam abhayaṃ durgam idam alpabuddhyagamyaṃ śāstraguruprasādarahitaiś ca --- 'kastaṃ madāmadaṃ devaṃ madanyo jñātumarhati' 'devairatrāpi vicikitsitaṃ purā' 'naiṣā tarkeṇa matirāpaneyā' --- varaprasādalabhyatvaśrutismṛtivādebhyaśca;
analyzed: tasmāt tārkika cāṭa bhaṭa rāja apraveśyam abhayam durgam idam alpabuddhi agamyam śāstra guru prasāda rahitaiḥ ca kaḥ tam madāmadam devam mad anyaḥ jñātum arhati devaiḥ atrā api vicikitsitam purā na eṣā tarkeṇa matiḥ āpaneyā vara prasāda labhya tva śruti smṛti vādebhyaḥ ca

original: 'tadejati tannaijati taddūre tadvantike' ityādiviruddhadharmasamavāyitvaprakāśam antravarṇebhyaś ca; gītāsu ca 'matsthāni sarvabhūtāni' ityādi. tasmāt parabrahmavyatirekeṇa saṃsārī nāma na anyat vastvantaramasti.

analyzed: tasmāt suṣṭhu ucyate brahma vai idam agre āsīt tat ātmānam eva avet aham brahma asmi iti na anyat atośti draṣṭṛ na anyat atośti śrotṛ ityādi śruti śatebhyaḥ tasmāt parasya eva brahmaṇaḥ satyasya satyam nāma upaniṣad parā

original: 'yo'yaṃ dakṣiṇe'kṣanpuruṣaḥ' iti liṅgātmā prastutaḥ adhyātme, adhidaive ca 'ya eṣa etasminmaṇḍale puruṣaḥ' iti, 'tasya' iti prakṛtopādanāt sa evopādīyate --- yośau tyasyāmūrtasya rasaḥ, na tu vijñānamayaḥ.

analyzed: śūnyam ca iti evam vikalpayantaḥ na pāram adhigacchanti avidyāyāḥ viruddha dharma darśi tvāt sarvatra tasmāt tatra ye eva śruti ācārya darśita mārga anusāriṇaḥ te eva avidyāyāḥ pāram adhigacchanti te eva ca asmāt moha samudrāt agādhāt uttariṣyanti na itare sva buddhi kauśala anusāriṇaḥ

original: parisamāptā brahmavidyā amṛtatvasādhanabhūtā, yāṃ maitreyī pṛṣṭavatī bhartāram 'yadeva bhagavānamṛtatvasādhanaṃ veda tadeva me brūhi' iti. etasyā brahmavidyāyāḥ stutyarthā iyamākhyāyikā ānītā. tasyā ākhyāyikāyāḥ saṃkṣepato'rthaprakāśanārthāvetau mantrau bhavataḥ;
analyzed: parisamāptā brahma vidyā amṛta tva sādhana bhūtā yām maitreyī pṛṣṭavatī bhartāram yat eva bhagavān amṛta tva sādhanam veda tat eva me brūhi iti etasyāḥ brahma vidyāyāḥ stuti arthāḥ iyam ākhyāyikā ānītā tasyāḥ ākhyāyikāyāḥ saṃkṣepataḥ ūrtha prakāśana arthau etau mantrau bhavataḥ

original: evaṃ hi mantrabrāhmaṇābhyāṃ stutatvāt amṛtatvasarvaprāptisādhanatvaṃ brahmavidyāyāḥ prakaṭīkṛtaṃ rājamārgamupanītaṃ bhavati --- yathā ādityaḥ udyan śārvaraṃ tamo'panayatīti --- tadvat. api ca evaṃ stutā brahmavidyā --- yā indrarakṣitā sā duṣprāpā devairapi; yasmāt aśivabhyāmapi devabhiṣagbhyām indrarakṣitā vidyā mahatā āyāsena prāptā;
analyzed: evam hi mantra brāhmaṇābhyām stuta tvāt amṛta tva sarva prāpti sādhanatvam brahmavidyāyāḥ prakaṭīkṛtam rājamārgam upanītam bhavati yathā ādityaḥ udyan śārvaram tam opanayati iti tadvat api ca evam stutā brahmavidyā yā indra rakṣitā sā duṣprāpā devaiḥ api yasmāt aśivabhyām api deva bhiṣagbhyām indra rakṣitā vidyā mahatā āyāsena prāptā

original: brāhmaṇasya śiraśchittvā aśvyaṃ śiraḥ pratisaṃdhāya, tasminnindreṇa cchinne punaḥ svaśira eva pratisaṃdhāya, tena brāhmaṇasya svaśirasaiva uktā aśeṣā brahmavidyā śrutā; yasmāt tataḥ parataraṃ kiṃcitpuruṣārthasādhanaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhāvi vā, kuta eva vartamānam --- iti nātaḥ parā stutirasti.
analyzed: brāhmaṇasya śiraḥ chittvā aśvyam śiraḥ pratisaṃdhāya tasmin indreṇa cchinne punar sva śiraḥ eva pratisaṃdhāya tena brāhmaṇasya sva śirasā eva uktā aśeṣā brahma vidyā śrutā yasmāt tatas parataram kiṃcid puruṣa artha sādhanam na bhūtam na bhāvi vā kutas eva vartamānam iti na atas parā stutiḥ asti

original: api caivaṃ stūyate brahmavidyā --- sarvapuruṣārthānāṃ karma hi sādhanamiti loke prasiddham; tacca karma vittasādhyam, tena āśāpi nāstyamṛtatvasya; tadidamamṛtatvaṃ kevalayā ātmavidyayā karmanirapekṣayā prāpyate;
analyzed: api ca evam stūyate brahma vidyā sarva puruṣa arthānām karma hi sādhanam iti loke prasiddham tat ca karma vitta sādhyam tena āśā api na asti amṛta tvasya tat idam amṛta tvam kevalayā ātma vidyayā karma nirapekṣayā prāpyate

original: yasmāt karmaprakaraṇe vaktuṃ prāptāpi satī pravargyaprakaraṇe, karmaprakaraṇāduttīrya karmaṇā viruddhatvāt kevalasaṃnyāsasahitā abhihitā amṛtatvasādhanāya --- tasmāt nātaḥ paraṃ puruṣārthasādhanamasti. api ca evaṃ stutā brahmavidyā --- sarvo hi loko dvandvārāmaḥ, śa vai naiva reme tasmādekākī na ramate' iti śruteḥ;
analyzed: yasmāt karma prakaraṇe vaktum prāptā api satī pravargya prakaraṇe karma prakaraṇāt uttīrya karmaṇā viruddha tvāt kevala saṃnyāsa sahitā abhihitā amṛta tva sādhanāya tasmāt na atas param puruṣa artha sādhanam asti api ca evam stutā brahma vidyā sarvaḥ hi lokaḥ dvandva ārāmaḥ vai nā eva reme tasmāt ekākī na ramate iti śruteḥ

original: yājñavalkyo lokasādhāraṇo'pi san ātmajñānabalāt bhāryāputravittādisaṃsāraratiṃ parityajya prajñānatṛpta ātmaratirbabhūva. api ca evaṃ stutā brahmavidyā --- yasmāt yājñavalkyena saṃsāramārgāt vyuttiṣṭhatāpi priyāyai bhāryāyai prītyarthameva abhihitā, 'priyaṃ bhāṣasa ehyāssva' iti liṅgāt.
analyzed: yājñavalkyaḥ loka sādhāraṇaḥ api san ātma jñāna balāt bhāryā putra vitta ādi saṃsāra ratim parityajya prajñāna tṛptaḥ ātma ratiḥ babhūva api ca evam stutā brahma vidyā yasmāt yājñavalkyena saṃsāra mārgāt vyuttiṣṭhatā api priyāyai bhāryāyai prīti artham eva abhihitā priyam bhāṣase ehi āssva iti liṅgāt

original: tatra iyaṃ stutyarthā ākhyāyiketyavocāma; kā punaḥ sā ākhyāyiketi ucyate --- idamityanantaranirdiṣṭaṃ vyapadiśati, buddhau saṃnihitatvāt; vai-śabdaḥ smaraṇārthaḥ; tadityākhyāyikānirvṛttaṃ prakaraṇāntarābhihitaṃ parokṣaṃ vai-śabdena smārayan iha vyapadiśati;
analyzed: tatra iyam stuti arthā ākhyāyikā iti avocāma kā punar sā ākhyāyikā iti ucyate idam iti anantara nirdiṣṭam vyapadiśati buddhau saṃnihita tvāt vaiśabdaḥ smaraṇa arthaḥ tat iti ākhyāyikā nirvṛttam prakaraṇa antara abhihitam parokṣam vaiśabdena smārayan iha vyapadiśati

original: yat pravargyaprakaraṇe sūcitam, na āviṣkṛtaṃ madhu, tadidaṃ madhu iha anantaraṃ nirdiṣṭam --- 'iyaṃ pṛthivī' ityādinā; kathaṃ tatra prakaraṇāntare sūcitam --- dadhyaṅ ha vā ābhyāmātharvaṇo madhu nāma brāhmaṇamuvāca; tadenayoḥ priyaṃ dhāma tadevainayoretenopagacchati; sa hovācendreṇa vā uktośmyetaccedanyasmā anubrūyāstata eva te śiraśchindyāmiti;
analyzed: yat pravargya prakaraṇe sūcitam na āviṣkṛtam madhu tat idam madhu iha anantaram nirdiṣṭam iyam pṛthivī ityādinā katham tatra prakaraṇa antare sūcitam dadhyaṅ ha vai ābhyām ātharvaṇaḥ madhu nāma brāhmaṇam uvāca tat enayoḥ priyam dhāma tat eva enayoḥ etena upagacchati sa ha uvāca indreṇa vai uktaḥ uśmi etat ced anyasmai anubrūyāḥ tatas eva te śiraḥ chindyām iti

original: tasmādvai bibhemi yadvai me sa śiro na cchindyāttadvāmupaneṣya iti; tau hocaturāvāṃ tvā tasmāttrāsyāvahe iti; kathaṃ mā trāsyethe iti; yadā nāvupaneṣyase; atha te śiraśchittvānyatrāhṛtyopanidhāsyāvaḥ; athāśvasya śira āhṛtya tatte pratidhāsyāvaḥ; tena nāvanuvakṣyasi; sa yadā nāvanuvakṣyasi; atha te tadindraḥ śiraśchetsyati;
analyzed: tasmāt vai bibhemi yat vai me sa śiraḥ na chindyāt tat vām upaneṣye iti tau ha ūcatuḥ āvām tvā tasmāt trāsyāvahe iti katham mā trāsyethe iti yadā nau upaneṣyase atha te śiraḥ chittvā anyatra āhṛtya upanidhāsyāvaḥ atha āśvasya śiraḥ āhṛtya tat te pratidhāsyāvaḥ tena nau anuvakṣyasi sa yadā nau anuvakṣyasi atha te tat indraḥ śiraḥ chetsyati

original: atha te svaṃ śira āhṛtya tatte pratidhāsyāva iti; tatheti tau hopaninye; tau yadopaninye; athāsya śiraścittvā anyatropanidadhatuḥ; athāśvasya śira āhṛtya taddhāsya pratidadhatuḥ; tena hābhyāmanūvāca; sa yadābhyāmanūvāca athāsya tadindraḥ śiraśicaccheda; athāsya svaṃ śira āhṛtya taddhāsya pratidadhaturiti.
analyzed: atha te svam śiraḥ āhṛtya tat te pratidhāsyāvaḥ iti tathā iti tau ha upaninye tau yadā upaninye atha asya śiraḥ cittvā anyatra upanidadhatuḥ atha aśvasya śiraḥ āhṛtya tat ha asya pratidadhatuḥ tena ha ābhyām anūvāca sa yat ābhyām anūvāca atha asya tat indraḥ śiraḥ śicaccheda atha asya svam śiraḥ āhṛtya tat ha asya pratidadhatuḥ iti

original: yāvattu pravargyakarmāṅgabhūtaṃ madhu, tāvadeva tatrābhihitam; na tu kakṣyamātmajñānākhyam; tatra yā ākhyāyikā abhihitā, seha stutyarthā pradarśyate; idaṃ vai tanmadhu dadhyaṅṅātharvaṇaḥ anena prapañcena aśivabhyāmuvāca. tadetadṛṣiḥ --- tadetatkarma, ṛṣiḥ mantraḥ, paśyan upalabhamānaḥ, avocat uktavān;
analyzed: yāvat tu pravargya karma aṅga bhūtam madhu tāvat eva tatra abhihitam na tu kakṣyam ātma jñāna ākhyam tatra yā ākhyāyikā abhihitā sā iha stuti arthā pradarśyate idam vai tat madhu dadhyaṅ ātharvaṇaḥ anena prapañcena aśivabhyām uvāca tat etat ṛṣiḥ tat etat karma ṛṣiḥ mantraḥ paśyan upalabhamānaḥ avocat uktavān

original: katham? tat daṃsaḥ iti vyavahitena saṃbandhaḥ, daṃsa iti karmaṇo nāmadheyam; tacca daṃsaḥ kiṃviśiṣṭam? ugraṃ krūram, vāṃ yuvayoḥ, he narā narākārāvaśivanau; tacca karma kiṃnimittam? sanaye lābhāya; lābhalubdho hi loke'pi krūraṃ karma ācarati, tathaiva etāvupalabhyete yathā loke; tat āviḥ prakāśaṃ kṛṇomi karomi, yat rahasi bhavadbhyāṃ kṛtam;
analyzed: katham tat daṃsaḥ iti vyavahitena saṃbandhaḥ daṃsaḥ iti karmaṇaḥ nāmadheyam tat ca daṃsaḥ kiṃviśiṣṭam ugram krūram vām yuvayoḥ he narāḥ nara ākārau aśivanau tat ca karma kiṃnimittam sanaye lābhāya lābha lubdhaḥ hi loke api krūram karma ācarati tathā eva etau upalabhyete yathā loke tat āvis prakāśam kṛṇomi karomi yat rahasi bhavadbhyām kṛtam

original: kimivetyucyate --- tanyatuḥ parjanyaḥ, na iva; nakārastu upariṣṭādupacāraḥ upamārthīyo vede, na pratiṣedhārthaḥ --- yathā 'aśvaṃ na' aśvamiveti yadvat; tanyaturiva vṛṣṭiṃ yathā parjanyo vṛṣṭiṃ prakāśayati stanayitnvādiśabdaiḥ, tadvat ahaṃ yuvayoḥ krūraṃ karma āviṣkṛṇomīti saṃbandhaḥ.
analyzed: kim iva iti ucyate tanyatuḥ parjanyaḥ na iva nakāraḥ tu upariṣṭāt upacāraḥ upamā arthīyaḥ vede na pratiṣedha arthaḥ yathā aśvam na aśvam iva iti yadvat tanyatuḥ iva vṛṣṭim yathā parjanyaḥ vṛṣṭim prakāśayati stanayitnu ādi śabdaiḥ tadvat aham yuvayoḥ krūram karma āviṣkṛṇomi iti saṃbandhaḥ

original: nanu aśivanoḥ stutyarthau kathamimau mantrau syātām? nindāvacanau hīmau --- naiṣa doṣaḥ; stutirevaiṣā, na nindāvacanau; yasmāt īdṛśamapyatikrūraṃ karma kurvatoryuvayoḥ na loma ca mīyata iti --- na cānyatkiṃciddhīyata eveti --- stutāvetau bhavataḥ; nindāṃ praśaṃsāṃ hi laukikāḥ smaranti; tathā praśaṃsārūpā ca nindā loke prasiddhā.
analyzed: nanu stuti arthau katham imau mantrau syātām nindā vacanau hi imau na eṣa doṣaḥ stutiḥ eva eṣā na nindā vacanau yasmāt īdṛśam api ati krūram karma kurvatoḥ yuvayoḥ na loma ca mīyate iti na ca anyat kiṃcid hīyate eva iti stutau etau bhavataḥ nindām praśaṃsām hi laukikāḥ smaranti tathā praśaṃsā rūpā ca nindā loke prasiddhā

original: dadhyaṅnāma ātharvaṇaḥ; hetyanarthako nipātaḥ; yanmadhu kakṣyam ātmajñānalakṣaṇam ātharvaṇaḥ vāṃ yuvābhyām aśvasya śīrṣṇā śirasā pra yat īm uvāca --- yatprovāca madhu; īmityanarthako nipātaḥ.
analyzed: dadhyaṅ nāma ātharvaṇaḥ ha iti anarthakaḥ nipātaḥ yat madhu kakṣyam ātma jñāna lakṣaṇam ātharvaṇaḥ vām yuvābhyām aśvasya śīrṣṇā śirasā pra yat īm uvāca yat provāca madhu īm iti anarthakaḥ nipātaḥ

original: idaṃ vai tanmadhvityādi pūrvavat mantrāntarapradarśanārtham. tathā anyo mantraḥ tāmeva ākhyāyikāmanusarati sma. ātharvaṇo dadhyaṅnāma --- ātharvaṇo'nyo vidyata ityato viśinaṣṭi --- dadhyaṅnāma ātharvaṇaḥ, tasmai dadhīce ātharvaṇāya, he aśivanāviti mantradṛśo vacanam;
analyzed: idam vai tat madhu ityādi pūrvavat mantra antara pradarśana artham tathā anyaḥ mantraḥ tām eva ākhyāyikām anusarati smaḥ ātharvaṇaḥ dadhyaṅ nāma ātharvaṇaḥ anyaḥ vidyate iti atas viśinaṣṭi dadhyaṅ nāma ātharvaṇaḥ tasmai dadhīce ātharvaṇāya he aśivanau iti mantra dṛśaḥ vacanam

original: aśvyam aśvasya svabhūtam, śiraḥ, brāhmaṇasya śirasi cchinne aśvasya śiraśchittvā īdṛśamatikrūraṃ karma kṛtvā aśvyaṃ śiraḥ brāhmaṇaṃ prati airayataṃ gamitavantau, yuvām; sa ca ātharvaṇaḥ vāṃ yuvābhyām tanmadhu pravocat, yatpūrvaṃ pratijñātam --- vakṣyāmīti.
analyzed: aśvyam aśvasya sva bhūtam śiraḥ brāhmaṇasya śirasi chinne aśvasya śiraḥ chittvā īdṛśam ati krūram karma kṛtvā aśvyam śiraḥ brāhmaṇam prati airayatam gamitavantau yuvām sa ca ātharvaṇaḥ vām yuvābhyām tat madhu pravocat yat pūrvam pratijñātam vakṣyāmi iti

original: sa kimarthamevaṃ jīvitasaṃdehamāruhya pravocadityucyate --- ṛtāyan yatpūrvaṃ pratijñātaṃ satyaṃ tatparipālayitumicchan; jīvitādapi hi satyadharmaparipālanā gurutaretyetasya liṅgametat.
analyzed: sa kimartham evam jīvita saṃdeham āruhya pravocat iti ucyate ṛtāyan yat pūrvam pratijñātam satyam tat paripālayitum icchan jīvitāt api hi satya dharma paripālanā gurutarā iti etasya liṅgam etat

original: kiṃ tanmadhu pravocadityucyate --- tvāṣṭram, tvaṣṭā ādityaḥ, tasya saṃbandhi --- yajñasya śiraśchinnaṃ tvaṣṭrā abhavat, tatpratisaṃdhānārthaṃ pravargyaṃ karma, tatra pravargyakarmāṅgabhūtaṃ yadvijñānaṃ tat tvāṣṭraṃ madhu --- yajñasya śiraśchedanapratisaṃdhānādiviṣayaṃ darśanaṃ tattvāṣṭraṃ yanmadhu;

original: parityāgaḥ kārayitum; 'yajñopavītyevādhīyīta yājayedyajeta vā'. pārivrājye tāvadadhyayanaṃ vihitam --- 'vedasaṃnyasanācchūdrastasmādvedaṃ na saṃnyaset' iti; śvādhyāya evotsṛjyamāno vācam' iti ca āpastambaḥ; 'brahmojjñaṃ vedanindā ca kauṭasākṣyaṃ suhṛdvadhaḥ. garhitānnādyayorjagdhiḥ surāpānasamāni ṣaṭ' --- iti vedaparityāge doṣaśravaṇāt.

original: 'upāsane gurūṇāṃ vṛddhānāmatithīnāṃ home japyakarmaṇi bhojana ācamane svādhyāye ca yajñopavītī syāt' iti parivrājakadharmeṣu ca gurūpāsanasvādhyāya bhojanācamanādīnāṃ karmaṇāṃ śrutismṛtiṣu kartavyatayā coditatvāt gurvādyupāsanāṅgatvena yajñopavītasya vihitatvāt tatparityāgo naivāvagantuṃ śakyate.
analyzed: upāsane gurūṇām vṛddhānām atithīnām home japya karmaṇi bhojane ācamane svādhyāye ca yajña upavītī syāt iti parivrājaka dharmeṣu ca guru upāsana svādhyāya bhojana ācamana ādīnām karmaṇām śruti smṛtiṣu kartavya tayā codita tvāt guru ādi upāsana aṅga tvena yajñopavītasya vihita tvāt tad parityāgaḥ na eva avagantum śakyate

original: yadyapi eṣaṇābhyo vyutthānaṃ vidhīyata eva, tathāpi putrādyeṣaṇābhyastisṛbhya eva vyutthānam, na tu sarvasmātkarmaṇaḥ karmasādhanācca vyutthānam; sarvaparityāge ca aśrutaṃ kṛtaṃ syāt, śrutaṃ ca yajñopavītādi hāpitaṃ syāt; tathā ca mahānaparādhaḥ vihitākaraṇapratiṣiddhācaraṇanimittaḥ kṛtaḥ syāt; tasmāt yajñopavītādiliṅgaparityāgo'ndhaparamparaiva.
analyzed: yadi api eṣaṇābhyaḥ vyutthānam vidhīyate eva tathā api putra ādi eṣaṇābhyaḥ tisṛbhyaḥ eva vyutthānam na tu sarvasmāt karmaṇaḥ karma sādhanāt ca vyutthānam sarva parityāge ca aśrutam kṛtam syāt śrutam ca yajñopavīta ādi hāpitam syāt tathā ca mahān aparādhaḥ vihita akaraṇa pratiṣiddha ācaraṇa nimittaḥ kṛtaḥ syāt tasmāt yajñopavīta ādi liṅga parityāga undha paramparā eva

original: na, 'yajñopavītaṃ vedāṃśca sarvaṃ tadvarjayedyatiḥ' iti śruteḥ. api ca ātmajñānaparatvātsarvasyā upaniṣadaḥ --- ātmā draṣṭavyaḥ śrotavyo mantavya iti hi prastutam; sa ca ātmaiva sākṣādaparokṣātsarvāntaraḥ aśanāyādisaṃsāradharmavarjita ityevaṃ vijñeya iti tāvat prasiddham;
analyzed: na yajñopavītam vedān ca sarvam tat varjayet yatiḥ iti śruteḥ api ca ātma jñāna para tvāt sarvasyāḥ upaniṣadaḥ ātmā draṣṭavyaḥ śrotavyaḥ mantavyaḥ iti hi prastutam sa ca ātmā eva sākṣāt aparokṣāt sarva antaraḥ aśanāya ādi saṃsāra dharma varjitaḥ iti evam vijñeyaḥ iti tāvat prasiddham

original: sarvā hīyamupaniṣat evaṃpareti vidhyantaraśeṣatvaṃ tāvannāsti, ato nārthavādaḥ, ātmajñānasya kartavyatvāt. ātmā ca aśanāyādidharmavānna bhavatīti sādhanaphalavilakṣaṇo jñātavyaḥ;

original: ato'vyatirekeṇa ātmano jñānamavidyā --- 'anyośāvanyo'hamasmīti,' 'na sa veda,' 'mṛtyoḥ sa mṛtyumāpnoti' 'ya iha nāneva paśyati,' 'ekadhaivānudraṣṭavyam,' 'ekamevādvitīyam,' 'tattvamasi' ityādiśrutibhyaḥ.

original: kāma eva yasyāyatanam. strīvyatikarābhilāṣaḥ kāmaḥ kāmaśarīra ityarthaḥ. hṛdayaṃ lokaḥ, hṛdayena buddhyā paśyati. ya evāyaṃ kāmamayaḥ puruṣaḥ adhyātmamapi kāmamaya eva, tasya kā devateti --- striya iti hovāca; strīto hi kāmasya dīptirjāyate.
analyzed: kāmaḥ eva yasya āyatanam strī vyatikara abhilāṣaḥ kāmaḥ kāma śarīraḥ iti arthaḥ hṛdayam lokaḥ hṛdayena buddhyā paśyati yaḥ eva ayam kāma mayaḥ puruṣaḥ adhyātmam api kāma mayaḥ eva tasya kā devatā iti striyaḥ iti ha uvāca strītaḥ hi kāmasya dīptiḥ jāyate

original: rūpāṇyeva yasyāyatanam. rūpāṇi śuklakṛṣṇādīni. ya evāsāvāditye puruṣaḥ --- sarveṣāṃ hi rūpāṇāṃ viśiṣṭaṃ kāryamāditye puruṣaḥ, tasya kā devateti --- satyamiti hovāca; satyamiti cakṣurucyate; cakṣuṣo hi adhyātmata ādityasyādhidaivatasya niṣpattiḥ.
analyzed: rūpāṇi eva yasya āyatanam rūpāṇi śukla kṛṣṇa ādīni yaḥ eva asau āditye puruṣaḥ sarveṣām hi rūpāṇām viśiṣṭam kāryam āditye puruṣaḥ tasya kā devatā iti satyam iti ha uvāca satyam iti cakṣuḥ ucyate cakṣuṣaḥ hi adhyātmataḥ ādityasya adhidaivatasya niṣpattiḥ

original: ākāśa eva yasyāyatanam. ya evāyaṃ śrotre bhavaḥ śrautraḥ, tatrāpi pratiśravaṇavelāyāṃ viśeṣato bhavatīti prātiśrutkaḥ, tasya kā devateti --- diśa iti hovāca; digbhyo hyasau ādhyātmiko niṣpadyate.
analyzed: ākāśaḥ eva yasya āyatanam yaḥ eva ayam śrotre bhavaḥ śrautraḥ tatra api pratiśravaṇa velāyām viśeṣataḥ bhavati iti prātiśrutkaḥ tasya kā devatā iti diśaḥ iti ha uvāca digbhyaḥ hi asau ādhyātmikaḥ niṣpadyate

original: tama eva yasyāyatanam. tama iti śārvarādyandhakāraḥ parigṛhyate; adhyātmaṃ chāyāmayaḥ ajñānamayaḥ puruṣaḥ; tasya kā devateti --- mṛtyuriti hovāca; mṛtyuradhidaivataṃ tasya niṣpattikāraṇam.
analyzed: tamaḥ eva yasya āyatanam tamaḥ iti śārvara ādi andhakāraḥ parigṛhyate adhyātmam chāyā mayaḥ ajñāna mayaḥ puruṣaḥ tasya kā devatā iti mṛtyuḥ iti ha uvāca mṛtyuḥ adhidaivatam tasya niṣpatti kāraṇam

original: rūpāṇyeva yasyāyatanam. pūrvaṃ sādhāraṇāni rūpāṇyuktāni iha tu prakāśakāni viśiṣṭāni rūpāṇi gṛhyante; rūpāyatanasya devasya viśeṣāyatanaṃ pratibimbādhāramādarśādi; tasya kā devateti --- asuriti hovāca; tasya pratibimbākhyasya puruṣasya niṣpattiḥ asoḥ prāṇāt.
analyzed: rūpāṇi eva yasya āyatanam pūrvam sādhāraṇāni rūpāṇi uktāni iha tu prakāśakāni viśiṣṭāni rūpāṇi gṛhyante rūpāyatanasya devasya viśeṣa āyatanam pratibimba ādhāram ādarśa ādi tasya kā devatā iti asuḥ iti ha uvāca tasya pratibimba ākhyasya puruṣasya niṣpattiḥ asoḥ prāṇāt

original: āpa eva yasya āyatanam. sādhāraṇāḥ sarvā āpa āyatanam; vāpīkūpataḍāgādyāśrayāsu apsu viśeṣāvasthānam; tasya kā devateti, varuṇa iti --- varuṇāt saṃghātakartryaḥ adhyātmam āpa eva vāpyādyapāṃ niṣpattikāraṇam.
analyzed: āpaḥ eva yasya āyatanam sādhāraṇāḥ sarvāḥ āpaḥ āyatanam vāpī kūpa taḍāga ādi āśrayāsu apsu viśeṣa avasthānam tasya kā devatā iti varuṇaḥ iti varuṇāt saṃghāta kartryaḥ adhyātmam āpaḥ eva vāpī ādi apām niṣpatti kāraṇam

original: reta eva yasyāyatanam; ya evāyaṃ putramayaḥ viśeṣāyatanaṃ retāayatanasya --- putrasya iti ca asthimajjāśukrāṇi piturjātāni; tasya kā devateti, prajāpatiriti hovāca --- prajāpatiḥ pitocyate, pitṛto hi putrasyotpattiḥ.
analyzed: retaḥ eva yasya āyatanam yaḥ eva ayam putra mayaḥ viśeṣa āyatanam retaḥ ayatanasya putrasya iti ca asthi majjā śukrāṇi pituḥ jātāni tasya kā devatā iti prajāpatiḥ iti ha uvāca prajāpatiḥ pitā ucyate pitṛtaḥ hi putrasya utpattiḥ

original: aṣṭadhā devalokapuruṣabhedena tridhā tridhā ātmānaṃ pravibhajya avasthita ekaiko devaḥ prāṇabheda eva upāsanārthaṃ vyapadiṣṭaḥ; adhunā digvibhāgena pañcadhā pravibhaktasya ātmanyupasaṃhārārtham āha; tūṣṇīṃbhūtaṃ śākalyaṃ yājñavalkyo graheṇeva āveśayannāha --- śākalyeti hovāca yājñavalkyaḥ;
analyzed: aṣṭadhā deva loka puruṣa bhedena tridhā tridhā ātmānam pravibhajya avasthitaḥ ekaikaḥ devaḥ prāṇa bhedaḥ eva upāsana artham vyapadiṣṭaḥ adhunā diś vibhāgena pañcadhā pravibhaktasya ātmani upasaṃhāra artham āha tūṣṇīṃbhūtam śākalyam yājñavalkyaḥ graheṇa iva āveśayan āha śākalya iti ha uvāca yājñavalkyaḥ

original: tvāṃ sviditi vitarke, ime nūnaṃ brāhmaṇāḥ, aṅgārāvakṣayaṇam --- aṅgārāḥ avakṣīyante yasmin saṃdaṃśādau tat aṅgārāvakṣayaṇam --- tat nūnaṃ tvām akrata kṛtavantaḥ brāhmaṇāḥ, tvaṃ tu tanna budhyase ātmānaṃ mayā dahyamānamityabhiprāyaḥ.
analyzed: tvām svid iti vitarke ime nūnam brāhmaṇāḥ aṅgārāvakṣayaṇam aṅgārāḥ avakṣīyante yasmin saṃdaṃśa ādau tat aṅgārāvakṣayaṇam tat nūnam tvām akrata kṛtavantaḥ brāhmaṇāḥ tvam tu tat na budhyase ātmānam mayā dahyamānam iti abhiprāyaḥ

original: yājñavalkyeti hovāca śākalyaḥ --- yadidaṃ kurupañcālānāṃ brāhmaṇān atyavādīḥ atyuktavānasi --- svayaṃ bhītāstvāmaṅgārāvakṣayaṇaṃ kṛtavanta iti --- kiṃ brahma vidvānsan evamadhikṣipasi brāhmaṇān. yājñavalkya āha --- brahmavijñānaṃ tāvadidaṃ mama; kiṃ tat? diśo veda digviṣayaṃ vijñānaṃ jāne;
analyzed: yājñavalkya iti ha uvāca śākalyaḥ yat idam kuru pañcālānām brāhmaṇān atyavādīḥ atyuktavān asi svayam bhītāḥ tvām aṅgārāvakṣayaṇam kṛtavantaḥ iti kim brahma vidvān san evam adhikṣipasi brāhmaṇān yājñavalkyaḥ āha brahma vijñānam tāvat idam mama kim tat diśaḥ veda diś viṣayam vijñānam jāne

original: tacca na kevalaṃ diśa eva, sadevāḥ devaiḥ saha digadhiṣṭhātṛbhiḥ, kiṃca sapratiṣṭhāḥ pratiṣṭhābhiśca saha. itara āha --- yat yadi diśo vettha sadevāḥ sapratiṣṭhā iti, saphalaṃ yadi vijñānaṃ tvayā pratijñātam.
analyzed: tat ca na kevalam diśaḥ eva sa devāḥ devaiḥ saha diś adhiṣṭhātṛbhiḥ kiṃca sa pratiṣṭhāḥ pratiṣṭhābhiḥ ca saha itaraḥ āha yat yadi diśaḥ vettha sa devāḥ sa pratiṣṭhāḥ iti sa phalam yadi vijñānam tvayā pratijñātam

original: kiṃdevataḥ kā devatā asya tava digbhūtasya. asau hi yājñavalkyaḥ hṛdayamātmānaṃ dikṣu pañcadhā vibhaktaṃ digātmabhūtam, tadvāreṇa sarvaṃ jagat ātmatvenopagamya, ahamasmi digātmeti vyavasthitaḥ, pūrvābhimukhaḥ --- sapratiṣṭhāvacanāt; yathā yājñavalkyasya pratijñā tathaiva pṛcchati --- kiṃdevatastvamasyāṃ diśyasīti.
analyzed: kiṃdevataḥ kā devatā asya tava diś bhūtasya asau hi yājñavalkyaḥ hṛdayam ātmānam dikṣu pañcadhā vibhaktam diś ātma bhūtam tad vāreṇa sarvam jagat ātma tvena upagamya aham asmi diś ātmā iti vyavasthitaḥ pūrva abhimukhaḥ sa pratiṣṭhā vacanāt yathā yājñavalkyasya pratijñā tathā eva pṛcchati kiṃdevataḥ tvam asyām diśi asi iti

original: sarvatra hi vede yāṃ yāṃ devatāmupāste ihaiva tadbhūtaḥ tāṃ tāṃ pratipadyata iti; tathā ca vakṣyati --- 'devo bhūtvā devānapyeti' iti. asyāṃ prācyāṃ kā devatā digātmanastava adhiṣṭhātrī, kayā devatayā tvaṃ prācīdigrūpeṇa saṃpanna ityarthaḥ. itara āha --- ādityadevata iti; prācyāṃ diśi mama ādityo devatā, so'hamādityadevataḥ.
analyzed: sarvatra hi vede yām yām devatām upāste iha eva tad bhūtaḥ tām tām pratipadyate iti tathā ca vakṣyati devaḥ bhūtvā devān apyeti iti asyām prācyām kā devatā diś ātmanaḥ tava adhiṣṭhātrī kayā devatayā tvam prācī diś rūpeṇa saṃpannaḥ iti arthaḥ itaraḥ āha āditya devataḥ iti prācyām diśi mama ādityaḥ devatā saḥ ham āditya devataḥ

original: sadevā ityetat uktam, sapratiṣṭhā iti tu vaktavyamityāha --- sa ādityaḥ kasminpratiṣṭhita iti, cakṣuṣīti; adhyātmataścakṣuṣa ādityo niṣpanna iti hi mantrabrāhmaṇavādāḥ --- 'cakṣoḥ sūryo ajāyata' 'cakṣuṣa ādityaḥ' ityādayaḥ; kāryaṃ hi kāraṇe pratiṣṭhitaṃ bhavati. kasminnu cakṣuḥ pratiṣṭhitamiti, rūpeṣviti;
analyzed: sa devāḥ iti etat uktam sa pratiṣṭhāḥ iti tu vaktavyam iti āha saḥ ādityaḥ kasmin pratiṣṭhitaḥ iti cakṣuṣi iti adhyātmataḥ cakṣuṣaḥ ādityaḥ niṣpannaḥ iti hi mantra brāhmaṇa vādāḥ cakṣoḥ sūryaḥ ajāyata cakṣuṣaḥ ādityaḥ ityādayaḥ kāryam hi kāraṇe pratiṣṭhitam bhavati kasmin nu cakṣuḥ pratiṣṭhitam iti rūpeṣu iti

original: rūpagrahaṇāya hi rūpātmakaṃ cakṣuḥ rūpeṇa prayuktam; yairhi rūpaiḥ prayuktaṃ tairātmagrahaṇāya ārabdhaṃ cakṣuḥ; tasmāt sādityaṃ cakṣuḥ saha prācyā diśā saha tatsthaiḥ sarvaiḥ rūpeṣu pratiṣṭhitam. cakṣuṣā saha prācī diksarvā rūpabhūtā; tāni ca kasminnu rūpāṇi pratiṣṭhitānīti; hṛdaya iti hovāca; hṛdayārabdhāni rūpāṇi;
analyzed: rūpa grahaṇāya hi rūpa ātmakam cakṣuḥ rūpeṇa prayuktam yaiḥ hi rūpaiḥ prayuktam taiḥ ātma grahaṇāya ārabdham cakṣuḥ tasmāt sa ādityam cakṣuḥ saha prācyā diśā saha tad sthaiḥ sarvaiḥ rūpeṣu pratiṣṭhitam cakṣuṣā saha prācī diś sarvā rūpa bhūtā tāni ca kasmin nu rūpāṇi pratiṣṭhitāni iti hṛdaye iti ha uvāca hṛdaya ārabdhāni rūpāṇi

original: rūpākāreṇa hi hṛdayaṃ pariṇatam; yasmāt hṛdayena hi rūpāṇi sarvo loko jānāti; hṛdayamiti buddhimanasī ekīkṛtya nirdeśaḥ; tasmāt hṛdaye hyeva rūpāṇi pratiṣṭhitāni; hṛdayena hi smaraṇaṃ bhavati rūpāṇāṃ vāsanātmanām; tasmāt hṛdaye rūpāṇi pratiṣṭhitānītyarthaḥ. evamevaitadyājñavalkya.
analyzed: rūpa ākāreṇa hi hṛdayam pariṇatam yasmāt hṛdayena hi rūpāṇi sarvaḥ lokaḥ jānāti hṛdayam iti buddhi manasī ekīkṛtya nirdeśaḥ tasmāt hṛdaye hi eva rūpāṇi pratiṣṭhitāni hṛdayena hi smaraṇam bhavati rūpāṇām vāsanā ātmanām tasmāt hṛdaye rūpāṇi pratiṣṭhitāni iti arthaḥ evam eva etat yājñavalkya

original: kiṃdevatośyāṃ dakṣiṇāyāṃ diśyasīti pūrvavat --- dakṣiṇāyāṃ diśi kā devatā tava. yamadevata iti --- yamo devatā mama dakṣiṇādigbhūtasya. sa yamaḥ kasminpratiṣṭhita iti, yajña iti --- yajñe kāraṇe pratiṣṭhito yamaḥ saha diśā. kathaṃ punaryajñasya kāryaṃ yama ityucyate --- ṛtvigbhirniṣpādito yajñaḥ;
analyzed: kiṃdevatā ūśyām dakṣiṇāyām diśi asi iti pūrvavat dakṣiṇāyām diśi kā devatā tava yama devataḥ iti yamaḥ devatā mama dakṣiṇā diś bhūtasya sa yamaḥ kasmin pratiṣṭhitaḥ iti yajñaḥ iti yajñe kāraṇe pratiṣṭhitaḥ yamaḥ saha diśā katham punar yajñasya kāryam yamaḥ iti ucyate ṛtvigbhiḥ niṣpāditaḥ yajñaḥ

original: dakṣiṇayā yajamānastebhyo yajñaṃ niṣkrīya tena yajñena dakṣiṇāṃ diśaṃ saha yamenābhijāyati; tena yajñe yamaḥ kāryatvātpratiṣṭhitaḥ saha dakṣiṇayā diśā. kasminnu yajñaḥ pratiṣṭhita iti, dakṣiṇāyāmiti --- dakṣiṇayā sa niṣkrīyate; tena dakṣiṇākāryaṃ yajñaḥ.
analyzed: dakṣiṇayā yajamānaḥ tebhyaḥ yajñam niṣkrīya tena yajñena dakṣiṇām diśam saha yamena abhijāyati tena yajñe yamaḥ kārya tvāt pratiṣṭhitaḥ saha dakṣiṇayā diśā kasmin nu yajñaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ iti dakṣiṇāyām iti dakṣiṇayā sa niṣkrīyate tena dakṣiṇā kāryam yajñaḥ

original: kasminnu dakṣiṇā pratiṣṭhiteti, śraddhāyāmiti --- śraddhā nāma ditsutvam āstikyabuddhirbhaktisahitā. kathaṃ tasyāṃ pratiṣṭhitā dakṣiṇā? yasmāt yadā hyeva śraddhatte atha dakṣiṇāṃ dadāti, na aśraddadhat dakṣiṇāṃ dadāti; tasmāt śraddhāyāṃ hyeva dakṣiṇā pratiṣṭhiteti.
analyzed: kasmin nu dakṣiṇā pratiṣṭhitā iti śraddhāyām iti śraddhā nāma ditsu tvam āstikya buddhiḥ bhakti sahitā katham tasyām pratiṣṭhitā dakṣiṇā yasmāt yadā hi eva śraddhatte atha dakṣiṇām dadāti na a śraddadhat dakṣiṇām dadāti tasmāt śraddhāyām hi eva dakṣiṇā pratiṣṭhitā iti

original: kasminnu śraddhā pratiṣṭhiteti, hṛdaya iti hovāca --- hṛdayasya hi vṛttiḥ śraddhā yasmāt, hṛdayena hi śraddhāṃ jānāti; vṛttiśca vṛttimati pratiṣṭhitā bhavati; tasmāddhṛdaye hyeva śraddhā pratiṣṭhitā bhavatīti. evamevaitadyājñyavalkya.
analyzed: kasmin nu śraddhā pratiṣṭhitā iti hṛdaye iti ha uvāca hṛdayasya hi vṛttiḥ śraddhā yasmāt hṛdayena hi śraddhām jānāti vṛttiḥ ca vṛttimati pratiṣṭhitā bhavati tasmāt hṛdaye hi eva śraddhā pratiṣṭhitā bhavati iti evam eva etat yājñyavalkya

original: kiṃ devatośyāṃ pratīcyāṃ diśyasīti. tasyāṃ varuṇo'dhidevatā mama. sa varuṇaḥ kasminpratiṣṭhita iti, apsviti --- apāṃ hi varuṇaḥ kāryam, 'śraddhā vā āpaḥ' 'śraddhāto varuṇamasṛjata' iti śruteḥ. kasminnvāpaḥ pratiṣṭhitā iti, retasīti --- 'retasohyāpaḥ sṛṣṭāḥ' iti śruteḥ. kasminnu retaḥ pratiṣṭhitamiti, hṛdaya iti --- yasmāt hṛdayasya kāryaṃ retaḥ;
analyzed: kim devatā uśyām pratīcyām diśi asi iti tasyām varuṇaḥ adhidevatā mama sa varuṇaḥ kasmin pratiṣṭhitaḥ iti apsu iti apām hi varuṇaḥ kāryam śraddhā vai āpaḥ śraddhātaḥ varuṇam asṛjata iti śruteḥ kasmin vā āpaḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ iti retasi iti retasā hi apaḥ sṛṣṭāḥ iti śruteḥ kasmin nu retaḥ pratiṣṭhitam iti hṛdaye iti yasmāt hṛdayasya kāryam retaḥ

original: kāmo hṛdayasya vṛttiḥ; kāmino hi hṛdayāt reto'dhiskandati; tasmādapi pratirūpam anurūpaṃ putraṃ jātamāhurlaukikāḥ --- asya piturhṛdayādiva ayaṃ putraḥ sṛptaḥ viniḥsṛtaḥ, hṛdayādiva nirmito yathā suvarṇena nirmitaḥ kuṇḍalaḥ. tasmāt hṛdaye hyeva retaḥ pratiṣṭhitaṃ bhavatīti. evamevaitadyājñavalkya.
analyzed: kāmaḥ hṛdayasya vṛttiḥ kāminaḥ hi hṛdayāt retaḥ adhiskandati tasmāt api pratirūpam anurūpam putram jātam āhuḥ laukikāḥ asya pituḥ hṛdayāt iva ayam putraḥ sṛptaḥ viniḥsṛtaḥ hṛdayāt iva nirmitaḥ yathā suvarṇena nirmitaḥ kuṇḍalaḥ tasmāt hṛdaye hi eva retaḥ pratiṣṭhitam bhavati iti evam eva etat yājñavalkyaiḥ

original: kiṃdevatośyāmudīcyāṃ diśyasīti, somadevata iti --- soma iti latāṃ somaṃ devatāṃ caikīkṛtya nirdeśaḥ. sa somaḥ kasminpratiṣṭhita iti, dīkṣāyāmiti --- dīkṣito hi yajamānaḥ somaṃ krīṇāti; krītena somena iṣṭvā jñānavānuttarāṃ diśaṃ pratipadyate somadevatādhiṣṭhitāṃ saumyām.
analyzed: kiṃdevatā uśyām udīcyām diśi asi iti soma devataḥ iti somaḥ iti latām somam devatām ca ekīkṛtya nirdeśaḥ sa somaḥ kasmin pratiṣṭhitaḥ iti dīkṣāyām iti dīkṣitaḥ hi yajamānaḥ somam krīṇāti krītena somena iṣṭvā jñānavān uttarām diśam pratipadyate soma devatā dhiṣṭhitām saumyām

original: kasminnu dīkṣā pratiṣṭhiteti, satya iti --- katham? yasmātsatye dīkṣā pratiṣṭhitā, tasmādapi dīkṣitamāhuḥ --- satyaṃ vadeti --- kāraṇabhreṣe kāryabhreṣo mā bhūditi. satye hyeva dīkṣā pratiṣṭhiteti. kasminnu satyaṃ pratiṣṭhitamiti; hṛdaya iti hovāca; hṛdayena hi satyaṃ jānāti; tasmāt hṛdaye hyeva satyaṃ pratiṣṭhitaṃ bhavatīti.
analyzed: kasmin nu dīkṣā pratiṣṭhitā iti satye iti katham yasmāt satye dīkṣā pratiṣṭhitā tasmāt api dīkṣitam āhuḥ satyam vada iti kāraṇa bhreṣe kārya bhreṣaḥ mā bhūt iti satye hi eva dīkṣā pratiṣṭhitā iti kasmin nu satyam pratiṣṭhitam iti hṛdaye iti ha uvāca hṛdayena hi satyam jānāti tasmāt hṛdaye hi eva satyam pratiṣṭhitam bhavati iti
