original: yat yadi vṛkṣo vṛkṇaḥ chinnaḥ rohati punaḥ punaḥ prarohati prādurbhavati mūlāt punarnavataraḥ pūrvasmādabhinavataraḥ; yadetasmādviśeṣaṇātprāk vanaspateḥ puruṣasya ca, sarvaṃ sāmānyamavagatam; ayaṃ tu vansapatau viśeṣo dṛśyate --- yat chinnasya prarohaṇam; na tu puruṣe mṛtyunā vṛkṇe punaḥ prarohaṇaṃ dṛśyate; bhavitavyaṃ ca kutaścitprarohaṇena;
analyzed: yat yadi vṛkṣaḥ vṛkṇaḥ chinnaḥ rohati punar punar prarohati prādurbhavati mūlāt punarnavataraḥ pūrvasmāt abhinavataraḥ yat etasmāt viśeṣaṇāt prāk vanaspateḥ puruṣasya ca sarvam sāmānyam avagatam ayam tu vansapatau viśeṣaḥ dṛśyate yat chinnasya prarohaṇam na tu puruṣe mṛtyunā vṛkṇe punar prarohaṇam dṛśyate bhavitavyam ca kutaścid prarohaṇena

original: tasmāt vaḥ pṛcchāmi --- martyaḥ manuṣyaḥ svit mṛtyunā vṛkṇaḥ kasmāt mūlāt prarohati, mṛtasya puruṣasya kutaḥ prarohaṇamityarthaḥ.
analyzed: tasmāt vaḥ pṛcchāmi martyaḥ manuṣyaḥ svid mṛtyunā vṛkṇaḥ kasmāt mūlāt prarohati mṛtasya puruṣasya kutas prarohaṇam iti arthaḥ

original: yadi cedevaṃ vadatha --- retasaḥ prarohatīti, mā vocata maivaṃ vaktumarhatha; kasmāt? yasmāt jīvataḥ puruṣāt tat retaḥ prajāyate, na mṛtāt. api ca dhānāruhaḥ dhānā bījam, bījaruho'pi vṛkṣo bhavati, na kevalaṃ kāṇḍaruha eva; ivaśabdo'narthakaḥ; vai vṛkṣaḥ añjasā sākṣāt pretya mṛtvā saṃbhavaḥ dhānāto'pi pretya saṃbhavo bhavet añjasā punarvanaspateḥ.
analyzed: yadi ced evam vadatha retasaḥ prarohati iti mā vocata mā evam vaktum arhatha kasmāt yasmāt jīvataḥ puruṣāt tat retaḥ prajāyate na mṛtāt api ca dhānāruhaḥ dhānā bījam vṛkṣaḥ bhavati na kevalam kāṇḍaruhaḥ eva iva śabdaḥ anarthakaḥ vai vṛkṣaḥ añjasā sākṣāt pretya mṛtvā saṃbhavaḥ dhānātaḥ api pretya saṃbhavaḥ bhavet añjasā punar vanaspateḥ

original: yat yadi saha mūlena dhānayā vā āvṛheyuḥ udyaccheyuḥ utpāṭayeyuḥ vṛkṣam, na punarābhavet punarāgatya na bhavet. tasmādvaḥ pṛcchāmi --- sarvasyaiva jagato mūlaṃ martyaḥ svit mṛtyunā vṛkṇaḥ kasmāt mūlāt prarohati.
analyzed: yat yadi saha mūlena dhānayā vā āvṛheyuḥ udyaccheyuḥ utpāṭayeyuḥ vṛkṣam na punar ābhavet punar āgatya na bhavet tasmāt vaḥ pṛcchāmi sarvasya eva jagataḥ mūlam martyaḥ svid mṛtyunā vṛkṇaḥ kasmāt mūlāt prarohati

original: jāta eveti, manyadhvaṃ yadi, kimatra praṣṭavyamiti --- janiṣyamāṇasya hi saṃbhavaḥ praṣṭavyaḥ, na jātasya; ayaṃ tu jāta eva atośminviṣaye praśna eva nopapadyata iti cet --- na; kiṃ tarhi? mṛtaḥ punarapi jāyata eva anyathā akṛtābhyāgamakṛtanāśaprasaṅgāt; ato vaḥ pṛcchāmi --- ko nvenaṃ mṛtaṃ punarjanayet.
analyzed: jātaḥ eva iti manyadhvam yadi kim atra praṣṭavyam iti janiṣyamāṇasya hi saṃbhavaḥ praṣṭavyaḥ na jātasya ayam tu jātaḥ eva atas uśmin viṣaye praśnaḥ eva na upapadyate iti ced na kim tarhi mṛtaḥ punar api jāyate eva anyathā akṛta abhyāgama kṛta nāśa prasaṅgāt atas vaḥ pṛcchāmi kaḥ nu enam mṛtam punar janayet

original: tat na vijajñurbrāhmaṇāḥ --- yato mṛtaḥ punaḥ prarohati jagato mūlaṃ na vijñātaṃ brāhmaṇaiḥ; ato brahmiṣṇatvāt hṛtā gāvaḥ; yājñavalkyena jitā brāhmaṇāḥ. samāptā ākhyāyikā.
analyzed: tat na vijajñuḥ brāhmaṇāḥ yatas mṛtaḥ punar prarohati jagataḥ mūlam na vijñātam brāhmaṇaiḥ atas brahmiṣṇa tvāt hṛtāḥ gāvaḥ yājñavalkyena jitāḥ brāhmaṇāḥ samāptā ākhyāyikā

original: yajjagato mūlam, yena ca śabdena sākṣādvyapadiśyate brahma, yat yājñavalkyo brāhmaṇānpṛṣṭavān, tat svena rūpeṇa śrutirasmabhyamāha --- vijñānaṃ vijñaptiḥ vijñānam, tacca ānandam, na viṣayavijñānavadduḥkhānuviddham, kiṃ tarhi prasannaṃ śivamatulamanāyāsaṃ nityatṛptamekarasamityarthaḥ.
analyzed: yat jagataḥ mūlam yena ca śabdena sākṣāt vyapadiśyate brahma yat yājñavalkyaḥ brāhmaṇān pṛṣṭavān tat svena rūpeṇa śrutiḥ asmabhyam āha vijñānam vijñaptiḥ vijñānam tat ca ānandam na viṣaya vijñānavat duḥkha anuviddham kim tarhi prasannam śivam atulam anāyāsam nitya tṛptam ekarasam iti arthaḥ

original: kiṃ tat brahma ubhayaviśeṣaṇavadrātiḥ rāteḥ ṣaṣṭhyarthe prathamā, dhanasyetyarthaḥ; dhanasya dātuḥ karmakṛto yajamānasya parāyaṇaṃ parā gatiḥ karmaphalasya pradātṛ. kiṃca vyutthāyaiṣaṇābhyaḥ tasminneva brahmaṇi tiṣṭhatiṃ akarmakṛt, tat brahma vettīti tadvicca, tasya --- tiṣṭhamānasya ca tadvidaḥ, brahmavida ityarthaḥ, parāyaṇamiti.
analyzed: kim tat brahma ubhaya viśeṣaṇavat rātiḥ rāteḥ ṣaṣṭhī arthe prathamā dhanasya iti arthaḥ dhanasya dātuḥ karma kṛtaḥ yajamānasya parāyaṇam parā gatiḥ karma phalasya pradātṛ kiṃca vyutthāya eṣaṇābhyaḥ tasmin eva brahmaṇi a karma kṛt tat brahma vetti iti tad vid ca tasya tiṣṭhamānasya ca tad vidaḥ brahma vidaḥ iti arthaḥ parāyaṇam iti

original: atredaṃ vicāryate --- ānandaśabdo loke sukhavācī prasiddhaḥ; atra ca brahmaṇo viśeṣaṇatvena ānandaśabdaḥ śrūyate --- ānandaṃ brahmeti; śrutyantare ca --- 'ānando brahmeti vyajānāt' 'ānandaṃ brahmaṇo vidvān' 'yadeṣa ākāśa
analyzed: atra idam vicāryate ānanda śabdaḥ loke sukha vācī prasiddhaḥ atra ca brahmaṇaḥ viśeṣaṇa tvena ānanda śabdaḥ śrūyate ānandam brahma iti śruti antare ca ānandaḥ brahma iti vyajānāt ānandam brahmaṇaḥ vidvān yat eṣa ākāśa

original: ānando na syāt' 'yo vai bhūmā tatsukham' iti ca; 'eṣa parama ānandaḥ' ityevamādyāḥ; saṃvedye ca sukhe ānandaśabdaḥ prasiddhaḥ; brahmānandaśca yadi saṃvedyaḥ syāt, yuktā ete brahmaṇi ānandaśabdāḥ. nanu ca śrutiprāmāṇyāt saṃvedyānandasvarūpameva brahma, kiṃ tatra vicāryamiti --- na, viruddhaśrutivākyadarśanāt ---satyam, ānandaśabdo brahmaṇi śrūyate;
analyzed: ānandaḥ na syāt yaḥ vai bhūmā tat sukham iti ca eṣa paramaḥ ānandaḥ iti evamādyāḥ saṃvedye ca sukhe ānanda śabdaḥ prasiddhaḥ brahma ānandaḥ ca yadi saṃvedyaḥ syāt yuktāḥ ete brahmaṇi ānanda śabdāḥ nanu ca śruti prāmāṇyāt saṃvedya ānanda svarūpam eva brahma kim tatra vicāryam iti na viruddha śruti vākya darśanāt satyam ānanda śabdaḥ brahmaṇi śrūyate

original: vijñānapratiṣedhaśca ekatve --- 'yatra tvasya sarvamātmaivābhūt, tatkena kaṃ paśyet, tatkena kaṃ vijānīyāt' 'yatra nānyatpaśyati nānyacchṛṇoti nānyadvijānāti sa bhūmā' 'prājñenātmanā saṃpariṣvakto na bāhyaṃ kiṃcana veda' ityādi; viruddhaśrutivākyadarśanāt tena kartavyo vicāraḥ. tasmāt yuktaṃ vedavākyārthanirṇayāya vicārayitum.
analyzed: vijñāna pratiṣedhaḥ ca ekatve yatra tu asya sarvam ātmā eva abhūt tat kena kam paśyet tat kena kam vijānīyāt yatra na anyat paśyati na anyat śṛṇoti na anyat vijānāti sa bhūmā prājñena ātmanā saṃpariṣvaktaḥ na bāhyam kiṃcana veda ityādi viruddha śruti vākya darśanāt tena kartavyaḥ vicāraḥ tasmāt yuktam veda vākya artha nirṇayāya vicārayitum

original: mokṣavādivipratipatteśca --- sāṃkhyā vaiśeṣikāśca mokṣavādino nāsti mokṣe sukhaṃ saṃvedyamityevaṃ vipratipannāḥ; anye niratiśayaṃ sukhaṃ svasaṃvedyamiti.
analyzed: mokṣa vādi vipratipatteḥ ca sāṃkhyāḥ vaiśeṣikāḥ ca mokṣa vādinaḥ na asti mokṣe sukham saṃvedyam iti evam vipratipannāḥ anye niratiśayam sukham sva saṃvedyam iti

original: kiṃ tāvadyuktam? ānandādiśravaṇāt 'jakṣatkrīḍannamamāṇaḥ' śa yadi pitṛlokakāmo bhavati' 'yaḥ sarvajñaḥ sarvavit' śarvānkāmānsamaśnute' ityādiśrutibhyaḥ mokṣe sukhaṃ saṃvedyamiti. nanu ekatve kārakavibhāgābhāvāt vijñānānupapattiḥ, kriyāyāścānekakārakasādhyatvāt vijñānasya ca kriyātvāt --- naiṣa doṣaḥ; śabdaprāmāṇyāt bhavet vijñānamānandaviṣaye;
analyzed: kim tāvat yuktam ānanda ādi śravaṇāt jakṣat krīḍat namamāṇaḥ yadi pitṛ loka kāmaḥ bhavati yaḥ sarvajñaḥ sarva vid śarvān kāmān samaśnute ityādi śrutibhyaḥ mokṣe sukham saṃvedyam iti nanu eka tve kāraka vibhāga abhāvāt vijñāna anupapattiḥ kriyāyāḥ ca aneka kāraka sādhya tvāt vijñānasya ca kriyā tvāt na eṣa doṣaḥ śabda prāmāṇyāt bhavet vijñānam ānanda viṣaye

original: 'vijñānamānandam' ityādīni ānandasvarūpasyāsaṃvedyatve'nupapannāni vacanānītyavocāma. nanu vacanenāpi agneḥ śaityam udakasya ca auṣṇyaṃ na kriyata eva, jñāpakatvādvacanānām; na ca deśāntare'gniḥ śīta iti śakyate jñāpayitum; agamye vā deśāntare uṣṇamudakamiti --- na, pratyagātmanyānandavijñānadarśanāt;
analyzed: vijñānam ānandam ityādīni ānanda sva rūpasya asaṃvedya tvena upapannāni vacanāni iti avocāma nanu vacanena api agneḥ śaityam udakasya ca auṣṇyam na kriyate eva jñāpaka tvāt vacanānām na ca deśa antare agniḥ śītaḥ iti śakyate jñāpayitum agamye vā deśa antare uṣṇam udakam iti na pratyagātmani ānanda vijñāna darśanāt

original: na 'vijñānamānandam' ityevamādīnāṃ vacanānāṃ śīto'gnirityādivākyavat pratyakṣādiviruddhārthapratipādakatvam. anubhūyate tu aviruddhārthatā; sukhī aham iti sukhātmakamātmānaṃ svayameva vedayate; tasmāt sutarāṃ pratyakṣāviruddhārthatā; tasmāt ānandaṃ brahma vijñānātmakaṃ sat svayameva vedayate.
analyzed: na vijñānam ānandam iti evamādīnām vacanānām śītaḥ agniḥ ityādi vākya vat pratyakṣa ādi viruddha artha pratipādaka tvam anubhūyate tu aviruddha arthatā sukhī aham iti sukha ātmakam ātmānam svayam eva vedayate tasmāt sutarām pratyakṣa aviruddha arthatā tasmāt ānandam brahma vijñāna ātmakam sat svayam eva vedayate

original: tathā ānandapratipādikāḥ śrutayaḥ samañjasāḥ syuḥ 'jakṣatkrīḍannamamāṇaḥ' ityevamādyāḥ pūrvoktāḥ.
analyzed: tathā ānanda pratipādikāḥ śrutayaḥ samañjasāḥ syuḥ jakṣat krīḍat namamāṇaḥ iti evamādyāḥ pūrvoktāḥ

original: na, kāryakaraṇābhāve anupapattervijñānasya --- śarīraviyogo hi mokṣa ātyantikaḥ; śarīrābhāve ca karaṇānupapattiḥ, āśrayābhāvāt; tataśca vijñānānupapattiḥ akāryakaraṇatvāt; dehādyabhāve ca vijñānotpattau sarveṣāṃ kāryakaraṇopādānānarthakyaprasaṅgaḥ. ekatvavirodhācca --- paraṃ cedbrahma ānandātmakam ātmānaṃ nityavijñānatvāt
analyzed: na kārya karaṇa abhāve anupapatteḥ vijñānasya śarīra viyogaḥ hi mokṣaḥ ātyantikaḥ śarīra abhāve ca karaṇa anupapattiḥ āśraya abhāvāt tatas ca vijñāna anupapattiḥ akārya karaṇa tvāt deha ādi abhāve ca vijñāna utpattau sarveṣām kārya karaṇa upādāna ānarthakya prasaṅgaḥ ekatva virodhāt ca param ced brahma ānanda ātmakam ātmānam nitya vijñāna tvāt

original: nityameva vijānīyāt, tanna; saṃsāryapi saṃsāravinirmuktaḥ svābhāvyaṃ pratipadyeta; jalāśaya ivodakāñjaliḥ kṣiptaḥ na pṛthaktvena vyavatiṣṭhate ānandātmakabrahmavijñānāya; tadā mukta ānandātmakamātmānaṃ vedayata ityetadanarthakaṃ vākyam. atha brahmānandam anyaḥ san mukto vedayate, pratyagātmānaṃ ca, ahamasmyānandasvarūpa iti; tadā ekatvavirodhaḥ;
analyzed: nityam eva vijānīyāt tat na saṃsārī api saṃsāra vinirmuktaḥ svābhāvyam pratipadyeta jalāśaye iva udaka añjaliḥ kṣiptaḥ na pṛthaktvena vyavatiṣṭhate ānanda ātmaka brahma vijñānāya tadā muktaḥ ānanda ātmakam ātmānam vedayate iti etat anarthakam vākyam atha brahma ānandam anyaḥ san muktaḥ vedayate pratyagātmānam ca aham asmi ānanda svarūpaḥ iti tadā ekatva virodhaḥ

original: tathā ca sati sarvaśrutivirodhaḥ. tṛtīyā ca kalpanā nopapadyate. kiṃcānyat, brahmaṇaśca nirantarātmānandavijñāne vijñānāvijñānakalpanānarthakyam; nirantaraṃ cet ātmānandaviṣayaṃ brahmaṇo vijñānam, tadeva tasya svabhāva iti ātmānandaṃ vijānātīti kalpanā anupapannā; atadvijñānaprasaṅge hi kalpanāyā arthavattvam, yathā ātmānaṃ paraṃ ca vettīti;
analyzed: tathā ca sati sarva śruti virodhaḥ tṛtīyā ca kalpanā na upapadyate kiṃca anyat brahmaṇaḥ ca nirantara ātma ānanda vijñāne vijñāna avijñāna kalpanā ānarthakyam nirantaram ced ātma ānanda viṣayam brahmaṇaḥ vijñānam tat eva tasya svabhāvaḥ iti ātma ānandam vijānāti iti kalpanā anupapannā a tad vijñāna prasaṅge hi kalpanāyāḥ arthavat tvam yathā ātmānam param ca vetti iti

original: na hi iṣvādyāsaktamanaso nairantaryeṇa iṣujñānājñānakalpanāyā arthavattvam. atha vicchinnamātmānandaṃ vijānāti --- vijñānasya ātmavijñānacchidre anyaviṣayatvaprasaṅgaḥ; ātmanaśca vikriyāvattvam, tataścānityatvaprasaṅgaḥ. tasmāt 'vijñānamānandam' iti svarūpānvākhyānaparaiva śrutiḥ, nātmānandasaṃvedyatvārthā.
analyzed: na hi iṣu ādi āsakta manasaḥ nairantaryeṇa iṣu jñāna ajñāna kalpanāyāḥ arthavat tvam atha vicchinnam ātma ānandam vijānāti vijñānasya ātma vijñāna chidre anya viṣaya tva prasaṅgaḥ ātmanaḥ ca vikriyāvat tvam tatas ca anitya tva prasaṅgaḥ tasmāt vijñānam ānandam iti svarūpa anvākhyāna parā eva śrutiḥ na ātma ānanda saṃvedya tva arthā

original: 'jakṣatkrīḍan' ityādiśrutivirodhośaṃvedyatva iti cenna, sarvātmaikatve yathāprāptānuvāditvāt --- muktasya sarvātmabhāve sati yatra kvacit yogiṣu deveṣu vā jakṣaṇādi prāptam; tat yathāprāptamevānūdyate --- tat tasyaiva sarvātmabhāvāditi sarvātmabhāvamokṣastutaye.
analyzed: jakṣat krīḍan ityādi śruti virodha uśam vedya tve iti ced na sarva ātma ekatve yathāprāpta anuvādi tvāt muktasya sarva ātma bhāve sati yatra kvacid yogiṣu deveṣu vā jakṣaṇa ādi prāptam tat yathāprāptam eva anūdyate tat tasya eva sarva ātma bhāvāt iti sarva ātma bhāva mokṣa stutaye

original: yathāprāptānuvāditve duḥkhitvamapīti cet --- yogyādiṣu yathāprāptajakṣaṇādivat sthāvarādiṣu yathāprāptaduḥkhitvamapīti cet --- na, nāmarūpakṛtakāryakaraṇopādhisaṃparkajanitabhrāntyadhyāropitatvāt sukhitvaduḥkhitvādiviśeṣasyeti parihṛtametatsarvam. viruddhaśrutīnāṃ ca viṣayamavocāma.
analyzed: yathāprāpta anuvādi tve duḥkhi tvam api iti ced yogya ādiṣu yathāprāpta jakṣaṇa ādi vat sthāvara ādiṣu yathāprāpta duḥkhi tvam api iti ced na nāma rūpa kṛta kārya karaṇa upādhi saṃparka janita bhrānti adhyāropita tvāt sukhi tva duḥkhi tva ādi viśeṣasya iti parihṛtam etat sarvam viruddha śrutīnām ca viṣayam avocāma

original: tasmāt 'eṣośya parama ānandaḥ' itivat sarvāṇyānandavākyāni draṣṭavyāni.
analyzed: tasmāt eṣa uśya paramaḥ ānandaḥ iti vat sarvāṇi ānanda vākyāni draṣṭavyāni

original: ucyate --- nanu uktam 'asya lokasya sarvāvato mātrāmapādāya svayaṃ vihatya svayaṃ nirmāya' iti; antaḥkaraṇavṛttiḥ asya lokasya vāsanā mātrā, tāmapādāya, rathādivāsanārūpāntaḥkaraṇavṛttiḥ tadupalabdhinimittena karmaṇā codyamānā dṛśyatvena vyavatiṣṭhate; taducyate --- svayaṃ nirmāyeti; tadeva āha --- rathādīnsṛjata iti;

original: na tu tatra karaṇaṃ vā, karaṇānugrāhakāṇi vā ādityādijyotīṃṣi, tadavabhāsyā vā rathādayo viṣayāḥ vidyante; tadvāsanāmātraṃ tu kevalaṃ tadupalabdhikarmanimittacoditodbhūtāntaḥkaraṇavṛttyāśraya dṛśyate. tat yasya jyotiṣo dṛśyate aluptadṛśaḥ, tat ātmajyotiḥ atra kevalam asiriva kośāt viviktam.

original: tasmāt prasiddhyāpi svapne svayaṃjyotiṣṭvam asya gamyate. svapno bhūtvā atikrānto matyo rūpāṇīti tasmāt svapne svayaṃ jyotirātmā. atho api khalu anye āhuḥ --- jāgaritadeśa evāsya eṣaḥ, yaḥ svapnaḥ --- na saṃdhyaṃ sthānāntaram ihalokaparalokābhyāṃ vyatiriktam, kiṃ tarhi ihaloka eva jāgaritadeśaḥ.

original: yadyevam, kiṃca ataḥ? śrṛṇu ato yadbhavati --- yadā jāgaritadeśa evāyaṃ svapnaḥ, tadā ayamātmā kāryakaraṇebhyo na vyāvṛttaḥ tairmiśrībhūtaḥ, ato na svayaṃ jyotirātmā --- ityataḥ svayaṃjyotiṣṭvabādhanāya anye āhuḥ --- jāgaritadeśe evāsyaiṣa iti.

original: tatra na hetumācakṣate --- jāgaritadeśatve yāni hi yasmāt hastyādīni padārthajātāni, jāgrat jāgaritadeśe, paśyati laukikaḥ, tānyeva supto'pi paśyatīti. tadasat, indriyoparamāt; uparateṣu hi indriyeṣu svapnānpaśyati; tasmāt nānyasya jyotiṣaḥ tatra saṃbhavośti; taduktam 'na tatra rathā na rathayogāḥ' ityādi;

original: tasmāt atrāyaṃ puruṣaḥ svayaṃ jyotirbhavatyeva. svayaṃ jyotiḥ ātmā astīti svapnanidarśanena pradarśitam, atikrāmati mṛtyo rūpāṇīti ca; krameṇa saṃcaran ihalokaparalokādīn ihalokaparalokādivyatiriktaḥ, tathā jāgratsvapnakulāyābhyāṃ vyatiriktaḥ, tatra ca kramasaṃcārānnityaśca --- ityetat pratipāditaṃ yājñavalkyena.
analyzed: tasmāt atra ayam puruṣaḥ svayam jyotiḥ bhavati eva svayam jyotiḥ ātmā asti iti svapna nidarśanena pradarśitam atikrāmati mṛtyoḥ rūpāṇi iti ca krameṇa saṃcaran ihaloka para loka ādīn ihaloka para loka ādi vyatiriktaḥ tathā jāgrat svapna kulāyābhyām vyatiriktaḥ tatra ca krama saṃcārāt nityaḥ ca iti etat pratipāditam yājñavalkyena

original: ataḥ vidyāniṣkrayārthaṃ sahasraṃ dadāmītyāha janakaḥ; so'ham evaṃ bodhitaḥ tvayā bhagavate tubhyam sahasraṃ dadāmi; vimokṣaśca kāmapraśano mayā abhipretaḥ; tadupayogī ayaṃ tādarthyāt tadekadeśa eva; ataḥ tvāṃ niyokṣyāmi samastakāmapraśnanirṇayaśravaṇena --- vimokṣāya ata ūrdhvaṃ brūhīti, yena saṃsārāt vipramucyeyaṃ tvatprasādāt.

original: yat prastutam --- ātmanaivāyaṃ jyotiṣāste iti, tat pratyakṣataḥ pratipāditam --- 'atrāyaṃ puruṣaḥ svayaṃ jyotirbhavati' iti svapne. yattu uktam --- śvapno bhūtvemaṃ lokamatikrāmati mṛtyo rūpāṇi' iti, tatra etat āśaṅkyate --- mṛtyo rūpāṇyeva atikrāmati, na mṛtyum; pratyakṣaṃ hyetat svapne kāryakaraṇavyāvṛttasyāpi modatrāsādidarśanam;

original: tasmāt nūnaṃ naivāyaṃ mṛtyumatikrāmati; karmaṇo hi mṛtyoḥ kāryaṃ modatrāsādi dṛśyate; yadi ca mṛtyunā baddha eva ayaṃ svabhāvataḥ, tataḥ vimokṣo nopapadyate; na hi svabhāvātkaścit vimucyate; atha svabhāvo na bhavati mṛtyuḥ, tataḥ tasmāt mokṣa upapatsyate;

original: yathā asau mṛtyuḥ ātmīyo dharmo na bhavati, tathā pradarśanāya --- ata ūrdhvaṃ vimokṣāya brūhītyevaṃ janakena paryanuyuktaḥ yājñavalkyaḥ taddidarśayiṣayā pravavṛte ---

original: saṃprasādaḥ; jāgarite dehendriyavyāpāraśatasaṃnipātajaṃ hitvā kāluṣyaṃ tebhyo vipramuktaḥ īṣat prasīdati svapne, iha tu suṣupte samyak prasīdati --- ityataḥ suṣuptaṃ saṃprasāda ucyate; 'tīrṇo hi tadā sarvāñśokān' iti śalila eko draṣṭā' iti hi vakṣyati suṣuptastham ātmānam --- sa vai eṣaḥ etasmin saṃprasāde krameṇa saṃprasannaḥ san suṣupte sthitvā;
analyzed: saṃprasādaḥ jāgarite deha indriya vyāpāra śata saṃnipāta jam hitvā kāluṣyam tebhyaḥ vipramuktaḥ īṣat prasīdati svapne iha tu suṣupte samyak prasīdati iti atas suṣuptam saṃprasādaḥ ucyate tīrṇaḥ hi tadā sarvān śokān iti śalilaḥ ekaḥ draṣṭā iti hi vakṣyati suṣupta stham ātmānam sa vai eṣaḥ etasmin saṃprasāde krameṇa saṃprasannaḥ san suṣupte sthitvā

original: kathaṃ saṃprasannaḥ? svapnāt suṣuptaṃ pravivikṣuḥ san suṣupte sthitvā; kathaṃ saṃprasannaḥ? svapnāt suṣuptaṃ pravivikṣuḥ svapnāvastha eva ratvā ratimanubhūya mitrabandhujanadarśanādinā, caritvā vihṛtya anekadhā caraṇaphalaṃ śramamupalabhyetyarthaḥ, dṛṣṭvaiva na kṛtvetyarthaḥ, puṇyaṃ ca puṇyaphalam, pāpaṃ ca pāpaphalam;
analyzed: katham saṃprasannaḥ svapnāt suṣuptam pravivikṣuḥ san suṣupte sthitvā katham saṃprasannaḥ svapnāt suṣuptam pravivikṣuḥ svapna avasthe eva ratvā ratim anubhūya mitra bandhu jana darśana ādinā caritvā vihṛtya anekadhā caraṇa phalam śramam upalabhya iti arthaḥ dṛṣṭvā eva na kṛtvā iti arthaḥ puṇyam ca puṇya phalam pāpam ca pāpa phalam

original: na tu puṇyapāpayoḥ sākṣāddarśanamastītyavocāma; tasmāt na puṇyapāpābhyāmanubaddhaḥ, yo hi karoti puṇyapāpe, sa tābhyāmanubadhyate; na hi darśanamātreṇa tadanubaddhaḥ syāt. tasmāt svapno bhūtvā mṛtyumatikrāmatyeva, na mṛtyurūpāṇyeva kevalam. ataḥ na mṛtyoḥ ātmasvabhātvāśaṅkā; mṛtyuścet svabhāvośya, svapne'pi kuryāt; na tu karoti;
analyzed: na tu puṇya pāpayoḥ sākṣāt darśanam asti iti avocāma tasmāt na puṇya pāpābhyām anubaddhaḥ yaḥ hi karoti puṇya pāpe sa tābhyām anubadhyate na hi darśana mātreṇa tad anubaddhaḥ syāt tasmāt svapnaḥ bhūtvā mṛtyum atikrāmati eva na mṛtyu rūpāṇi eva kevalam atas na mṛtyoḥ ātma svabhā tva āśaṅkā mṛtyuḥ ced svabhāvaḥ ūśya svapne api kuryāt na tu karoti

original: svabhāvaścet kriyā syāt; anirmokṣataiva syāt; na tu svabhāvaḥ, svapne abhāvāt, ataḥ vimokṣaḥ asya upapadyate mṛtyoḥ puṇyapāpābhyām. nanu jāgarite asya svabhāva eva --- na; buddhyādyupādhikṛtaṃ hi tat; tacca pratipāditaṃ sādṛśyāt 'dhyāyatīva lelāyatīva' iti. tasmāt ekāntenaiva svapne mṛtyurūpātikramaṇāt na svābhāvikatvāśaṅkā anirmokṣatā vā.
analyzed: svabhāvaḥ ced kriyā syāt anirmokṣatā eva syāt na tu svabhāvaḥ svapne abhāvāt atas vimokṣaḥ asya upapadyate mṛtyoḥ puṇya pāpābhyām nanu jāgarite asya svabhāvaḥ eva na buddhi ādi upādhi kṛtam hi tat tat ca pratipāditam sādṛśyāt dhyāyati iva lelāyati iva iti tasmāt ekāntena eva svapne mṛtyu rūpa atikramaṇāt na svābhāvika tva āśaṅkā anirmokṣatā vā

original: tatra 'caritvā' iti --- caraṇaphalaṃ śramamupalabhyetyarthaḥ, tataḥ saṃprasādānubhavottarakālaṃ punaḥ pratinyāyam yathānyāyaṃ yathāgatam --- niścita āyaḥ nyāyaḥ, ayanam āyaḥ nirgamanam, punaḥ pūrvagamanavaiparītyena yat āgamanaṃ sa pratinyāyaḥ --- yathāgataṃ punarāgacchatītyarthaḥ. pratiyoni yathāsthānam;
analyzed: tatra caritvā iti caraṇa phalam śramam upalabhya iti arthaḥ tatas saṃprasāda anubhava uttara kālam punar pratinyāyam yathānyāyam yathāgatam niścitaḥ āyaḥ nyāyaḥ ayanam āyaḥ nirgamanam punar pūrva gamana vaiparītyena yat āgamanam sa pratinyāyaḥ yathāgatam punar āgacchati iti arthaḥ pratiyoni yathāsthānam

original: svapnasthānāddhi suṣuptaṃ pratipannaḥ san yathāsthānameva punarāgacchati --- pratiyoni ādravati, svapnāyaiva svapnasthānāyaiva.
analyzed: svapna sthānāt hi suṣuptam pratipannaḥ san yathāsthānam eva punar āgacchati pratiyoni ādravati svapnāya eva svapna sthānāya eva

original: nanu svapne na karoti puṇyapāpe tayoḥ phalameva paśyatīti kathamavagamyate? yathā jāgarite tathā karotyeva svapne'pi, tulyatvāddarśanasya --- ityata āha --- saḥ ātmā, yat kiṃcit tatra svapne paśyati puṇyapāpaphalam, ananvāgataḥ ananubaddhaḥ tena dṛṣṭena bhavati, naiva anubaddho bhavati; yadi hi svapne kṛtameva tena syāt, tena anubadhyeta;
analyzed: nanu svapne na karoti puṇya pāpe tayoḥ phalam eva paśyati iti katham avagamyate yathā jāgarite tathā karoti eva svapne pi tulya tvāt darśanasya iti atas āha saḥ ātmā yat kiṃcid tatra svapne paśyati puṇya pāpa phalam an anvāgataḥ an anubaddhaḥ tena dṛṣṭena bhavati na eva anubaddhaḥ bhavati yadi hi svapne kṛtam eva tena syāt tena anubadhyeta

original: svapnādutthito'pi samanvāgataḥ syāt; na ca tat loke --- svapnakṛtakarmaṇā anvāgatatvaprasiddhiḥ; na hi svapnakṛtena āgasā āgaskāriṇamātmānaṃ manyate kaścit; na ca svapnadṛśa āgaḥ śrutvā lokaḥ taṃ garhati pariharati vā; ataḥ ananvāgata eva tena bhavati; tasmāt svapne kurvanniva upalabhyate, na tu kriyā paramārthataḥ;
analyzed: svapnāt utthitaḥ api samanvāgataḥ syāt na ca tat loke svapna kṛta karmaṇā anvāgata tva prasiddhiḥ na hi svapna kṛtena āgasā āgaskāriṇam ātmānam manyate kaścid na ca svapnadṛśaḥ āgaḥ śrutvā lokaḥ tam garhati pariharati vā atas an anvāgataḥ eva tena bhavati tasmāt svapne kurvan iva upalabhyate na tu kriyā paramārthataḥ

original: 'uteva strībhiḥ saha modamānaḥ' iti śloka uktaḥ; ākhyātāraśca svapnasya saha iva-śabdena ācakṣate --- hastino'dya ghaṭīkṛtāḥ dhāvantīva mayā dṛṣṭā iti. ato na tasya kartṛtvamiti. kathaṃ punarasyākartṛtvamiti --- kāryakaraṇairmūrtaiḥ saṃśleṣaḥ mūrtasya, sa tu kriyāheturdṛṣṭaḥ; na hyamūrtaḥ kaścit kriyāvān dṛśyate; amūrtaśca ātmā, atośaṅgaḥ;
analyzed: uta iva strībhiḥ saha modamānaḥ iti ślokaḥ uktaḥ ākhyātāraḥ ca svapnasya saha iva śabdena ācakṣate hastinā udya ghaṭīkṛtāḥ dhāvanti iva mayā dṛṣṭāḥ iti atas na tasya kartṛ tvam iti katham punar asya akartṛ tvam iti kārya karaṇaiḥ mūrtaiḥ saṃśleṣaḥ mūrtasya sa tu kriyā hetuḥ dṛṣṭaḥ na hi amūrtaḥ kaścid kriyāvān dṛśyate amūrtaḥ ca ātmā atośaṅgaḥ

original: yasmācca asaṅgo'yaṃ puruṣaḥ, tasmāt ananvāgataḥ tena svapnadṛṣṭena; ata eva na kriyākartṛtvamasya kathaṃcidupapadyate; kāryakaraṇasaṃśleṣeṇa hi kartṛtvaṃ syāt; sa ca saṃśleṣaḥ saṅgaḥ asya nāsti, yataḥ asaṅgo hyayaṃ puruṣaḥ; tasmāt amṛtaḥ. evameva etat yājñavalkya; so'haṃ bhagavate sahasraṃ dadāmi; ata ūrdhvaṃ vimokṣāyaiva brūhi;
analyzed: yasmāt ca asaṅgaḥ yam puruṣaḥ tasmāt ananvāgataḥ tena svapna dṛṣṭena atas eva na kriyā kartṛ tvam asya kathaṃcid upapadyate kārya karaṇa saṃśleṣeṇa hi kartṛ tvam syāt sa ca saṃśleṣaḥ saṅgaḥ asya na asti yatas asaṅgaḥ hi ayam puruṣaḥ tasmāt amṛtaḥ evam eva etat yājñavalkya saḥ ham bhagavate sahasram dadāmi atas ūrdhvam vimokṣāya eva brūhi

original: mokṣapadārthaikadeśasya karmapravivekasya samyagdarśitatvāt; ata ūrdhvaṃ vimokṣāyaiva brūhīti.
analyzed: mokṣa padārtha eka deśasya karma pravivekasya samyak darśita tvāt atas ūrdhvam vimokṣāya eva brūhi iti

original: tatra 'asaṅgo hyayaṃ puruṣaḥ' iti asaṅgatā akartṛtve heturuktaḥ; uktaṃ ca pūrvam --- karmavaśāt sa īyate yatra kāmamiti; kāmaśca saṅgaḥ; ataḥ asiddho heturuktaḥ --- 'asaṅgo hyayaṃ puruṣaḥ' iti. na tu etat asti;
analyzed: tatra asaṅgaḥ hi ayam puruṣaḥ iti asaṅga tā akartṛ tve hetuḥ uktaḥ uktam ca pūrvam karma vaśāt saḥ īyate yatra kāmam iti kāmaḥ ca saṅgaḥ atas asiddhaḥ hetuḥ uktaḥ asaṅgaḥ hi ayam puruṣaḥ iti na tu etat asti

original: kathaṃ tarhi? asaṅga eva ityetaducyate --- sa vā eṣa etasminsvapne, sa vai eṣa puruṣaḥ saṃprasādātpratyāgataḥ svapne ratvā caritvā yathākāmam, dṛṣṭvaiva puṇyaṃ ca pāpaṃ ca --- iti sarvaṃ pūrvavat; buddhāntāyaiva jāgaritasthānāya. tasmāt asaṅga evāyaṃ puruṣaḥ; yadi svapne saṅgavān syāt kāmī, tataḥ tatsaṅgajairdoṣaiḥ buddhāntāya pratyāgato lipyeta.
analyzed: katham tarhi asaṅgaḥ eva iti etat ucyate sa vai eṣaḥ etasmin svapne sa vai eṣa puruṣaḥ saṃprasādāt pratyāgataḥ svapne ratvā caritvā yathākāmam dṛṣṭvā eva puṇyam ca pāpam ca iti sarvam pūrvavat buddha antāya eva jāgarita sthānāya tasmāt asaṅgaḥ eva ayam puruṣaḥ yadi svapne saṅgavān syāt kāmī tatas tad saṅga jaiḥ doṣaiḥ buddhāntāya pratyāgataḥ lipyeta

original: yathā asau svapne asaṅgatvāt svapnaprasaṅgajairdoṣaiḥ jāgarite pratyāgato na lipyate, evaṃ jāgaritasaṅgajairapi doṣaiḥ na lipyata eva buddhānte; tadetaducyate ---
analyzed: yathā asau svapne asaṅga tvāt svapna prasaṅga jaiḥ doṣaiḥ jāgarite pratyāgataḥ na lipyate evam jāgarita saṅga jaiḥ api doṣaiḥ na lipyate eva buddhānte tat etat ucyate

original: sa vai eṣaḥ etasmin buddhānte jāgarite ratvā caritvetyādi pūrvavat. sa yat tatra buddhānte kiṃcitpaśyati, ananvāgataḥ tena bhavati --- asaṅgo hyayaṃ puruṣa iti. nanu dṛṣṭvaiveti kathamavadhāryate? karoti ca tatra puṇyapāpe;
analyzed: sa vai eṣaḥ etasmin buddha ante jāgarite ratvā caritvā ityādi pūrvavat sa yat tatra buddha ante kiṃcid paśyati an anvāgataḥ tena bhavati a saṅgaḥ hi ayam puruṣaḥ iti nanu dṛṣṭvā eva iti katham avadhāryate karoti ca tatra puṇya pāpe

original: tatphalaṃ ca paśyati --- na, kārakāvabhāsakatvena kartṛtvopapatteḥ; 'ātmanaivāyaṃ jyotiṣāste' ityādinā ātmajyotiṣā avabhāsitaḥ kāryakaraṇasaṃghātaḥ vyavaharati; tena asya kartṛtvamupacaryate, na svataḥ kartṛtvam; tathā coktam 'dhyāyatīva lelāyatīva' iti --- buddhyādyupādhikṛtameva na svataḥ;
analyzed: tad phalam ca paśyati na kāraka avabhāsaka tvena kartṛ tva upapatteḥ ātmanā eva ayam jyotiṣā āste ityādinā ātma jyotiṣā avabhāsitaḥ kārya karaṇa saṃghātaḥ vyavaharati tena asya kartṛ tvam upacaryate na svatas kartṛ tvam tathā ca uktam dhyāyati iva lelāyati iva iti buddhi ādi upādhi kṛtam eva na svatas

original: iha tu paramārthāpekṣayā upādhinirapekṣa ucyate --- dṛṣṭvaiva puṇyaṃ ca pāpaṃ ca na kṛtveti; tena na pūrvāparavyāghātāśaṅkā, yasmāt nirupādhikaḥ paramārthato na karoti, na lipyate kriyāphalena; tathā ca bhagavatoktam --- 'anāditvānnirguṇatvātparamātmāyamavyayaḥ. śarīrastho'pi kaunteya na karoti na lipyate' iti.
analyzed: iha tu paramārtha apekṣayā upādhi nirapekṣaḥ ucyate dṛṣṭvā eva puṇyam ca pāpam ca na kṛtvā iti tena na pūrva apara vyāghāta āśaṅkā yasmāt nirupādhikaḥ paramārthataḥ na karoti na lipyate kriyā phalena tathā ca bhagavatā uktam anādi tvāt nirguṇa tvāt paramātmā ayam avyayaḥ śarīra sthaḥ upi kaunteya na karoti na lipyate iti

original: tathā sahasradānaṃ tu kāmapravivekasya darśitatvāt. tathā śa vā eṣa etasminsvapne' śa vā eṣa etasminbuddhānte' ityetābhyāṃ kaṇḍikābhyām asaṅgataiva pratipāditā; yasmāt buddhānte kṛtena svapnāntaṃ gataḥ saṃprasannaḥ asaṃbaddho bhavati stainyādikāryādarśanāt, tasmāt triṣvapi sthāneṣu svataḥ asaṅga eva ayam; ataḥ amṛtaḥ sthānatrayadharmavilakṣaṇaḥ.
analyzed: tathā sahasra dānam tu kāma pravivekasya darśita tvāt tathā vai eṣaḥ etasmin svapne śa vai eṣaḥ etasmin buddhānte iti etābhyām kaṇḍikābhyām asaṅga tā eva pratipāditā yasmāt buddhānte kṛtena svapna antam gataḥ saṃprasannaḥ asaṃbaddhaḥ bhavati stainya ādi kārya adarśanāt tasmāt triṣu api sthāneṣu svatas asaṅgaḥ eva ayam atas amṛtaḥ sthāna traya dharma vilakṣaṇaḥ

original: pratiyonyādravati svapnāntāyaiva, saṃprasādāyetyarthaḥ --- darśanavṛtteḥ svapnasya svapnaśabdena abhidhānadarśanāt, antaśabdena ca viśeṣaṇopapatteḥ; 'etasmā antāya dhāvati' iti ca suṣuptaṃ darśayiṣyati.
analyzed: pratiyoni ādravati svapna antāya eva saṃprasādāya iti arthaḥ darśana vṛtteḥ svapnasya svapna śabdena abhidhāna darśanāt anta śabdena ca viśeṣaṇa upapatteḥ etasmai antāya dhāvati iti ca suṣuptam darśayiṣyati

original: 'yadi punaḥ evamucyate --- śvapnānte ratvā caritvā' 'etāvubhāvantāvanusaṃcarati svapnāntaṃ ca buddhāntaṃ ca' iti darśanāt, śvapnāntāyaiva' ityatrāpi darśanavṛttireva svapna ucyata iti --- tathāpi na kiṃcidduṣyati; asaṅgatā hi siṣādhayiṣitā sidhyatyeva;
analyzed: yadi punar evam ucyate śvapna ante ratvā caritvā etau ubhau antau anusaṃcarati svapna antam ca buddha antam ca iti darśanāt śvapna antāya eva iti atra api darśana vṛttiḥ eva svapnaḥ ucyate iti tathā api na kiṃcid duṣyati asaṅga tā hi siṣādhayiṣitā sidhyati eva

original: yasmāt jāgarite dṛṣṭvaiva puṇyaṃ ca pāpaṃ ca ratvā caritvā ca svapnāntamāgataḥ, na jāgaritadoṣeṇānugato bhavati.
analyzed: yasmāt jāgarite dṛṣṭvā eva puṇyam ca pāpam ca ratvā caritvā ca svapna antam āgataḥ na jāgarita doṣeṇa anugataḥ bhavati

original: evam ayaṃ puruṣa ātmā svayaṃ jyotiḥ kāryakaraṇavilakṣaṇaḥ tatprayojakābhyāṃ kāmakarmabhyāṃ vilakṣaṇaḥ --- yasmāt, asaṅgo hyayaṃ puruṣaḥ, asaṅgatvāt --- ityayamarthaḥ śa vā eṣa etasminsaṃprasāde' ityādyābhistisṛbhiḥ kaṇḍikābhiḥ pratipāditaḥ;
analyzed: evam ayam puruṣaḥ ātmā svayam jyotiḥ kārya karaṇa vilakṣaṇaḥ tad prayojakābhyām kāma karmabhyām vilakṣaṇaḥ yasmāt asaṅgaḥ hi ayam puruṣaḥ asaṅga tvāt iti ayam arthaḥ vai eṣaḥ etasmin saṃprasāde ityādyābhiḥ tisṛbhiḥ kaṇḍikābhiḥ pratipāditaḥ

original: tatra asaṅgataiva ātmanaḥ kutaḥ --- yasmāt, jāgaritāt svapnam, svapnācca saṃprasādam, saṃprasādācca punaḥ svapnam, krameṇa buddhāntaṃ jāgaritam, buddhāntācca punaḥ svapnāntam --- ityevam anukramasaṃcāreṇa sthānatrayasya vyatirekaḥ sādhitaḥ.
analyzed: tatra asaṅga tā eva ātmanaḥ kutas yasmāt jāgaritāt svapnam svapnāt ca saṃprasādam saṃprasādāt ca punar svapnam krameṇa buddha antam jāgaritam buddha antāt ca punar svapna antam iti evam anukrama saṃcāreṇa sthāna trayasya vyatirekaḥ sādhitaḥ

original: pūrvamapyupanyasto'yamarthaḥ śvapno bhūtvemaṃ lokamatikrāmati mṛtyo rūpāṇi' iti --- taṃ vistareṇa pratipādya, kevalaṃ dṛṣṭāntamātramavaśiṣṭam, tadvakṣyāmītyārabhyate ---
analyzed: pūrvam api upanyastaḥ iyam arthaḥ śvapnaḥ bhūtvā imam lokam atikrāmati mṛtyoḥ rūpāṇi iti tam vistareṇa pratipādya kevalam dṛṣṭānta mātram avaśiṣṭam tat vakṣyāmi iti ārabhyate

original: tat tatra etasmin, yathā --- pradarśite'rthe dṛṣṭānto'yamupādīyate --- yathā loke mahāmatsyaḥ, mahāṃścāsau matsyaśca, nādeyena srotasā ahārya ityarthaḥ, srotaśca viṣṭambhayati, svacchandacārī, ubhe kūle nadyāḥ pūrvaṃ ca aparaṃ ca anukrameṇa saṃcarati;
analyzed: tat tatra etasmin yathā pradarśita irthe dṛṣṭāntaḥ uyam upādīyate yathā loke mahā matsyaḥ mahān ca asau matsyaḥ ca nādeyena srotasā ahāryaḥ iti arthaḥ srotaḥ ca viṣṭambhayati svacchanda cārī ubhe kūle nadyāḥ pūrvam ca aparam ca anukrameṇa saṃcarati

original: saṃcarannāpi kūladvayaṃ tanmadhyavartinā udakasrotovegena ca paravaśī kriyate --- evameva ayaṃ puruṣaḥ etau ubhau antau anusaṃcarati; kau tau? svapnāntaṃ ca buddhāntaṃ ca. dṛṣṭāntapradarśanaphalaṃ tu --- mṛtyurūpaḥ kāryakaraṇasaṃghātaḥ saha tatprayojakābhyāṃ kāmakarmabhyām anātmadharmaḥ; ayaṃ ca ātmā etasmādvilakṣaṇaḥ --- iti vistarato vyākhyātam.
analyzed: saṃcaran na api kūla dvayam tad madhya vartinā udaka srotaḥ vegena ca paravaśī kriyate evam eva ayam puruṣaḥ etau ubhau antau anusaṃcarati kau tau svapna antam ca buddha antam ca dṛṣṭānta pradarśana phalam tu mṛtyu rūpaḥ kārya karaṇa saṃghātaḥ saha tad prayojakābhyām kāma karmabhyām anātma dharmaḥ ayam ca ātmā etasmāt vilakṣaṇaḥ iti vistarataḥ vyākhyātam

original: atra ca sthānatrayānusaṃcāreṇa svayaṃjyotiṣa ātmanaḥ kāryakaraṇasaṃghātavyatiriktasya kāmakarmabhyāṃ viviktatā uktā; svataḥ nāyaṃ saṃsāradharmavān, upādhinimittameva tu asya saṃsāritvam avidyādhyāropitam --- ityeṣa samudāyārtha uktaḥ.
analyzed: atra ca sthāna traya anusaṃcāreṇa svayaṃjyotiṣaḥ ātmanaḥ kārya karaṇa saṃghāta vyatiriktasya kāma karmabhyām vivikta tā uktā svatas na ayam saṃsāra dharmavān upādhi nimittam eva tu asya saṃsāri tvam avidyā adhyāropitam iti eṣa samudāya arthaḥ uktaḥ

original: yasya paramānandasya mātrā avayavāḥ brahmādibhirmanuṣyaparyantaiḥ bhūtaiḥ upajīvyante, tadānandamātrādvāreṇa mātriṇaṃ paramānandam adhijigamayiṣan āha, saindhavalavaṇaśakalairiva lavaṇaśailam. saḥ yaḥ kaścit manuṣyāṇāṃ madhye, rāddhaḥ saṃsiddhaḥ avikalaḥ samagrāvayava ityarthaḥ, samṛddhaḥ upabhogopakaraṇasaṃpannaḥ bhavati;
analyzed: yasya paramānandasya mātrāḥ avayavāḥ brahma ādibhiḥ manuṣya paryantaiḥ bhūtaiḥ upajīvyante tad ānanda mātrā dvāreṇa mātriṇam paramānandam adhijigamayiṣan āha saindhava lavaṇa śakalaiḥ iva lavaṇaśailam saḥ yaḥ kaścid manuṣyāṇām madhye rāddhaḥ saṃsiddhaḥ avikalaḥ samagra avayavaḥ iti arthaḥ samṛddhaḥ upabhoga upakaraṇa saṃpannaḥ bhavati

original: kiṃ ca anyeṣāṃ samānajātīyānām adhipatiḥ svatantraḥ patiḥ, na māṇḍalikaḥ; sarvaiḥ samastaiḥ, mānuṣyakairiti divyabhogopakaraṇanivṛttyartham,
analyzed: kim ca anyeṣām samāna jātīyānām adhipatiḥ svatantraḥ patiḥ na māṇḍalikaḥ sarvaiḥ samastaiḥ mānuṣyakaiḥ iti divya bhoga upakaraṇa nivṛtti artham

original: manuṣyāṇāmeva yāni bhogopakaraṇāni taiḥ --- saṃpannānāmapi atiśayena saṃpannaḥ saṃpannatamaḥ --- sa manuṣyāṇāṃ parama ānandaḥ. tatra ānandānandinoḥ abhedanirdeśāt na arthāntarabhūtatvamityetat; paramānandasyaiva iyaṃ viṣayaviṣayyākāreṇa mātrā prasṛteti hi uktam 'yatra vā anyadiva syāt' ityādivākyena;
analyzed: manuṣyāṇām eva yāni bhoga upakaraṇāni taiḥ saṃpannānām api atiśayena saṃpannaḥ saṃpannatamaḥ sa manuṣyāṇām paramaḥ ānandaḥ tatra ānanda ānandinoḥ abheda nirdeśāt na artha antara bhūta tvam iti etat parama ānandasya eva iyam viṣaya viṣayya ākāreṇa mātrā prasṛtā iti hi uktam yatra vā anyat iva syāt ityādi vākyena

original: tasmāt yukto'yam --- 'parama ānandaḥ' ityabhedanirdeśaḥ. yudhiṣṭhirāditulyo rājā atra udāharaṇam. dṛṣṭaṃ manuṣyānandam ādiṃ kṛtvā śataguṇottarottarakrameṇa unnīya paramānandam, yatra bhedo nivartate tamadhigamayati;
analyzed: tasmāt yuktaḥ yam paramaḥ ānandaḥ iti abheda nirdeśaḥ yudhiṣṭhira ādi tulyaḥ rājā atra udāharaṇam dṛṣṭam manuṣya ānandam ādim kṛtvā śataguṇa uttara uttara krameṇa unnīya parama ānandam yatra bhedaḥ nivartate tam adhigamayati

original: atra ayamānandaḥ śataguṇottarottarakrameṇa vardhamānaḥ yatra vṛddhikāṣṭhāmanubhavati, yatra gaṇitabhedo nivartate, anyadarśanaśravaṇamananābhāvāt, taṃ paramānandaṃ vivakṣan āha --- atha ye manuṣyāṇām evaṃprakārāḥ śatamānandabhedāḥ, sa ekaḥ pitṛṇām; teṣāṃ viśeṣaṇam --- jitalokānāmiti;
analyzed: atra ayam ānandaḥ śataguṇa uttarottara krameṇa vardhamānaḥ yatra vṛddhi kāṣṭhām anubhavati yatra gaṇita bhedaḥ nivartate anya darśana śravaṇa manana abhāvāt tam parama ānandam vivakṣan āha atha ye manuṣyāṇām evaṃprakārāḥ śatam ānanda bhedāḥ saḥ ekaḥ pitṛṇām teṣām viśeṣaṇam jita lokānām iti

original: śrāddhādikarmabhiḥ pitṛn toṣayitvā tena karmaṇā jito loko yeṣām, te jitalokāḥ pitaraḥ; teṣāṃ pitṛṇāṃ jitalokānāṃ manuṣyānandaśataguṇīkṛtaparimāṇa eka ānando bhavati. so'pi śataguṇīkṛtaḥ gandharvaloke eka ānando bhavati. sa ca śataguṇīkṛtaḥ karmadevānām eka ānandaḥ; agnihotrādiśrautakarmaṇā ye devatvaṃ prāpnuvanti, te karmadevāḥ.
analyzed: śrāddha ādi karmabhiḥ pitṛn toṣayitvā tena karmaṇā jitaḥ lokaḥ yeṣām te jita lokāḥ pitaraḥ teṣām pitṛṇām jita lokānām manuṣya ānanda śataguṇīkṛta parimāṇaḥ ekaḥ ānandaḥ bhavati saḥ api śataguṇīkṛtaḥ gandharva loke ekaḥ ānandaḥ bhavati sa ca śataguṇīkṛtaḥ karma devānām ekaḥ ānandaḥ agnihotra ādi śrauta karmaṇā ye deva tvam prāpnuvanti te karma devāḥ

original: tathaiva ājānadevānām eka ānandaḥ; ājānata eva utpattita eva ye devāḥ, te ājānadevāḥ; yaśca śrotriyaḥ adhītavedaḥ, avṛjinaḥ vṛjinaṃ pāpam tadrahitaḥ yathoktakārītyarthaḥ, akāmahataḥ vītatṛṣṇaḥ ājānadevebhyo'rvāk yāvanto viṣayāḥ teṣu --- tasya ca evaṃbhūtasya ājānadevaiḥ samāna ānanda ityetadanvākṛṣyate ca-śabdāt.
analyzed: tathā eva ājānadevānām ekaḥ ānandaḥ ājānataḥ eva utpattitaḥ eva ye devāḥ te ājānadevāḥ yaḥ ca śrotriyaḥ adhīta vedaḥ avṛjinaḥ vṛjinam pāpam tad rahitaḥ yathā ukta kārī iti arthaḥ a kāma hataḥ vīta tṛṣṇaḥ ājānadevebhyaḥ vāc yāvantaḥ viṣayāḥ teṣu tasya ca evaṃbhūtasya ājānadevaiḥ samānaḥ ānandaḥ iti etat anvākṛṣyate caśabdāt

original: tacchataguṇīkṛtaparimāṇaḥ prajāpatiloke eka ānando virāṭśarīre; tathā tadvijñānavān śrotriyaḥ adhītavedaśca avṛjina ityādi pūrvavat. tacchataguṇīkṛtaparimāṇa eka ānando brahmaloke hiraṇyagarbhātmani; yaścetyādi pūrvavadeva. ataḥ paraṃ gaṇitanivṛttiḥ;
analyzed: tad śataguṇīkṛta parimāṇaḥ prajāpati loke ekaḥ ānandaḥ virāj śarīre tathā tad vijñānavān śrotriyaḥ adhīta vedaḥ ca a vṛjinaḥ ityādi pūrvavat tad śataguṇīkṛta parimāṇaḥ ekaḥ ānandaḥ brahma loke hiraṇyagarbha ātmani yaḥ ca ityādi pūrvavat eva atas param gaṇita nivṛttiḥ

original: eṣa parama ānanda ityuktaḥ, yasya ca paramānandasya brahmalokādyānandā mātrāḥ, udadheriva vipruṣaḥ. evaṃ śataguṇottarottaravṛddhyupetā ānandāḥ yatra ekatāṃ yānti, yaśca śrotriyapratyakṣaḥ, atha eṣa eva saṃprasādalakṣaṇaḥ parama ānandaḥ; tatra hi nānyatpaśyati nānyacchṛṇoti; ato bhūmā, bhūmatvādamṛtaḥ; itare tadviparītāḥ.
analyzed: eṣa paramaḥ ānandaḥ iti uktaḥ yasya ca paramānandasya brahma loka ādi ānandāḥ mātrāḥ udadheḥ iva vipruṣaḥ evam śataguṇa uttarottara vṛddhi upetāḥ ānandāḥ yatra ekatām yānti yaḥ ca śrotriya pratyakṣaḥ atha eṣaḥ eva saṃprasāda lakṣaṇaḥ paramaḥ ānandaḥ tatra hi na anyat paśyati na anyat śṛṇoti atas bhūmā bhūma tvāt amṛtaḥ itare tad viparītāḥ

original: atra ca śrotriyatvāvṛjinatve tulye; akāmahatatvakṛto viśeṣaḥ ānandaśataguṇavṛddhihetuḥ; atra etāni sādhanāni śrotriyatvāvṛjinatvākāmahatatvāni tasya tasya ānandasya prāptau arthādabhihitāni, yathā karmāṇi agnihotrādīni devānāṃ devatvaprāptau;
analyzed: atra ca śrotriya tva a vṛjina tve tulye a kāma hata tva kṛtaḥ viśeṣaḥ ānanda śataguṇa vṛddhi hetuḥ atra etāni sādhanāni śrotriya tva a vṛjina tva a kāma hata tvāni tasya tasya ānandasya prāptau arthāt abhihitāni yathā karmāṇi agnihotra ādīni devānām deva tva prāptau

original: tatra ca śrotriyatvāvṛjinatvalakṣaṇe karmaṇī adharabhūmiṣvapi samāne iti na uttarānandaprāptisādhane abhyupeyete; akāmahatatvaṃ tu vairāgyatāratamyopapatteḥ uttarottarabhūmyānandaprāptisādhanamityavagamyate. sa eṣa paramaḥ ānandaḥ vitṛṣṇaśrotriyapratyakṣaḥ adhigataḥ. tathā ca vedavyāsaḥ --- 'yacca kāmasukhaṃ loke yacca divyaṃ mahatsukham.
analyzed: tatra ca śrotriya tva a vṛjina tva lakṣaṇe karmaṇī adhara bhūmiṣu api samāne iti na uttara ānanda prāpti sādhane abhyupeyete akāma hata tvam tu vairāgya tāratamya upapatteḥ uttara uttara bhūmi ānanda prāpti sādhanam iti avagamyate saḥ eṣa paramaḥ ānandaḥ vitṛṣṇa śrotriya pratyakṣaḥ adhigataḥ tathā ca vedavyāsaḥ yat ca kāma sukham loke yat ca divyam mahat sukham

original: yājñavalkyasya bhayakāraṇamāha śrutiḥ --- na yājñavalkyo vaktṛtvasāmarthyābhāvādbhītavān, ajñānādvā; kiṃ tarhi medhāvī rājā sarvebhyaḥ, mā mām, antebhyaḥ praśnanirṇayāvasānebhyaḥ, udarautsīt āvṛṇot avarodhaṃ kṛtavānityarthaḥ;

original: yadyat mayā nirṇītaṃ praśnarūpaṃ vimokṣārtham, tattat ekadeśatvenaiva kāmapraśnasya gṛhītvā punaḥ punaḥ māṃ paryanuyuṅkta eva, medhāvitvāt --- ityetadbhayakāraṇam --- sarvaṃ madīyaṃ vijñānaṃ kāmapraśnavyājena upāditsatīti.
analyzed: yat yat mayā nirṇītam praśna rūpam vimokṣa artham tat tat eka deśa tvena eva kāmapraśnasya gṛhītvā punar punar mām paryanuyuṅkte eva medhāvi tvāt iti etat bhaya kāraṇam sarvam madīyam vijñānam kāmapraśna vyājena upāditsati iti

original: atra vijñānamayaḥ svayaṃjyotiḥ ātmā svapne pradarśitaḥ, svapnāntabuddhāntasaṃcāreṇa kāryakaraṇavyatiriktatā, kāmakarmapravivekaśca asaṅgatayā mahāmatsyadṛṣṭāntena pradarśitaḥ; punaśca avidyākāryaṃ svapna eva 'ghnantīva' ityādinā pradarśitam; arthāt avidyāyāḥ satattvaṃ nirdhāritam ataddharmādhyāropaṇarūpatvam anātmadharmatvaṃ ca;
analyzed: atra vijñāna mayaḥ svayam jyotiḥ ātmā svapne pradarśitaḥ svapna anta buddha anta saṃcāreṇa kārya karaṇa vyatirikta tā kāma karma pravivekaḥ ca asaṅga tayā mahā matsya dṛṣṭāntena pradarśitaḥ punar ca avidyā kāryam svapne eva ghnanti iva ityādinā pradarśitam arthāt avidyāyāḥ satattvam nirdhāritam a tad dharma adhyāropaṇa rūpa tvam anātma dharma tvam ca

original: tathā vidyāyāśca kāryaṃ pradarśitam, sarvātmabhāvaḥ, svapne eva pratyakṣataḥ --- śarvośmīti manyate sośya paramo lokaḥ'
analyzed: tathā vidyāyāḥ ca kāryam pradarśitam sarva ātma bhāvaḥ svapne eva pratyakṣatas śarvośmī iti manyate saḥ uśya paramaḥ lokaḥ

original: iti; tatra ca sarvātmabhāvaḥ svabhāvośya, evam avidyākāmakarmādisarvasaṃsāradharmasaṃbandhātītaṃ rūpamasya, sākṣāt suṣupte gṛhyate --- ityetadvijñāpitam; svayaṃjyotirātmā eṣaḥ parama ānandaḥ, eṣa vidyāyā viṣayaḥ, sa eṣa paramaḥ saṃprasādaḥ, sukhasya ca parā kāṣṭhā --- ityetat evamantena granthena vyākhyātam.
analyzed: iti tatra ca sarva ātma bhāvaḥ svabhāva uśyaḥ evam avidyā kāma karma ādi sarva saṃsāra dharma saṃbandha atītam rūpam asya sākṣāt suṣupte gṛhyate iti etat vijñāpitam svayam jyotiḥ ātmā eṣaḥ paramaḥ ānandaḥ eṣa vidyāyāḥ viṣayaḥ saḥ eṣa paramaḥ saṃprasādaḥ sukhasya ca parā kāṣṭhā iti etat evam antena granthena vyākhyātam

original: tacca etat sarvaṃ vimokṣapadārthasya dṛṣṭāntabhūtam, bandhanasya ca; te ca ete mokṣabandhane sahetuke saprapañce nirdiṣṭe vidyāvidyākārye, tatsarvaṃ dṛṣṭāntabhūtameva --- iti, taddārṣṭāntikasthānīye mokṣabandhane sahetuke kāmapraśnārthabhūte tvayā vaktavye iti punaḥ paryanuyuṅkte janakaḥ --- ata urdhvaṃ vimokṣāyaiva brūhīti.
analyzed: tat ca etat sarvam vimokṣa padārthasya dṛṣṭānta bhūtam bandhanasya ca te ca ete mokṣa bandhane sa hetuke sa prapañce nirdiṣṭe vidyā avidyā kārye tat sarvam dṛṣṭānta bhūtam eva iti tad dārṣṭāntika sthānīye mokṣa bandhane sa hetuke kāma praśna artha bhūte tvayā vaktavye iti punar paryanuyuṅkte janakaḥ atas ūrdhvam vimokṣāya eva brūhi iti

original: tatra mahāmatsyavat svapnabuddhāntau asaṅgaḥ saṃcarati eka ātmā svayaṃjyotirityuktam; yathā ca asau kāryakaraṇāni mṛtyurūpāṇi parityajan upādadānaśca mahāmatsyavat svapnabuddhāntāvanusaṃcarati, tathā jāyamāno mriyamāṇaśca taireva mṛtyurūpaiḥ saṃyujyate viyujyate ca --- 'ubhau lokāvanusaṃcarati' iti saṃcaraṇaṃ svapnabuddhāntānusaṃcārasya
analyzed: tatra mahā matsya vat svapna buddhāntau asaṅgaḥ saṃcarati ekaḥ ātmā svayam jyotiḥ iti uktam yathā ca asau kārya karaṇāni mṛtyu rūpāṇi parityajan upādadānaḥ ca mahā matsya vat svapna buddhāntau anusaṃcarati tathā jāyamānaḥ mriyamāṇaḥ ca taiḥ eva mṛtyu rūpaiḥ saṃyujyate viyujyate ca ubhau lokau anusaṃcarati iti saṃcaraṇam svapna buddhānta anusaṃcārasya

original: dārṣṭāntikatvena sūcitam. tadiha vistareṇa sanimittaṃ saṃcaraṇaṃ varṇayitavyamiti tadartho'yamārambhaḥ. tatra ca buddhāntāt svapnāntam ayamātmā anupraveśitaḥ; tasmāt saṃprasādasthānaṃ mokṣadṛṣṭāntabhūtam; tataḥ prācyavya buddhānte saṃsāravyavahāraḥ pradarśayitavya iti tena asya saṃbandhaḥ.
analyzed: dārṣṭāntika tvena sūcitam tat iha vistareṇa sa nimittam saṃcaraṇam varṇayitavyam iti tad arthaḥ yam ārambhaḥ tatra ca buddhāntāt svapna antam ayam ātmā anupraveśitaḥ tasmāt saṃprasāda sthānam mokṣa dṛṣṭānta bhūtam tatas prācyavya buddhānte saṃsāra vyavahāraḥ pradarśayitavyaḥ iti tena asya saṃbandhaḥ

original: sa vai buddhāntāt svapnāntakrameṇa saṃprasannaḥ eṣaḥ etasmin saṃprasāde sthitvā, tataḥ punaḥ īṣatpracyutaḥ --- svapnānte ratvā caritvetyādi pūrvavat --- buddhāntāyaiva ādravati.
analyzed: sa vai buddha antāt svapna anta krameṇa saṃprasannaḥ eṣaḥ etasmin saṃprasāde sthitvā tatas punar īṣat pracyutaḥ svapna ante ratvā caritvā ityādi pūrvavat buddha antāya eva ādravati

original: ita ārabhya asya saṃsāro varṇyate. yathā ayamātmā svapnāntāt buddhāntamāgataḥ; evam ayam asmāddehāt dehāntaraṃ pratipatsyata iti āha tatra dṛṣṭāntam --- tat tatra yathā loke anaḥ śakaṭam, susamāhitaṃ suṣṭhu bhṛśaṃ vā samāhitam bhāṇḍopaskaraṇena ulūkhalamusalaśūrpapiṭharādinā annādyena ca saṃpannam saṃbhāreṇa ākrāntamityarthaḥ;
analyzed: itas ārabhya asya saṃsāraḥ varṇyate yathā ayam ātmā svapna antāt buddha antam āgataḥ evam ayam asmāt dehāt deha antaram pratipatsyate iti āha tatra dṛṣṭāntam tat tatra yathā loke anaḥ śakaṭam su samāhitam suṣṭhu bhṛśam vā samāhitam bhāṇḍa upaskaraṇena ulūkhala musala śūrpa piṭhara ādinā annādyena ca saṃpannam saṃbhāreṇa ākrāntam iti arthaḥ

original: tat tasminnarthe eṣa ślokaḥ mantro'pi bhavati. tadeva eti tadeva gacchati, sakta āsaktaḥ tatra udbhūtābhilāṣaḥ
analyzed: tat tasmin arthe eṣa ślokaḥ mantraḥ api bhavati tat eva eti tat eva gacchati saktaḥ āsaktaḥ tatra udbhūta abhilāṣaḥ

original: sannityarthaḥ; kathameti? saha karmaṇā --- yat karma phalāsaktaḥ san akarot, tena karmaṇā sahaiva tat eti tatphalameti; kiṃ tat? liṅgaṃ manaḥ --- manaḥpradhānatvālliṅgasya mano liṅgamityucyate; athavā liṅgyate avagamyate --- avagacchati --- yena, tat liṅgam, tat manaḥ --- yatra yasmin niṣaktaṃ niścayena saktam udbhūtābhilāṣam asya saṃsāriṇaḥ;
analyzed: san iti arthaḥ katham eti saha karmaṇā yat karma phala āsaktaḥ san akarot tena karmaṇā saha eva tat eti tad phalam eti kim tat liṅgam manaḥ manaḥ pradhāna tvāt liṅgasya manaḥ liṅgam iti ucyate athavā liṅgyate avagamyate avagacchati yena tat liṅgam tat manaḥ yatra yasmin niṣaktam niścayena saktam udbhūta abhilāṣam asya saṃsāriṇaḥ

original: tadabhilāṣo hi tatkarma kṛtavān; tasmāttanmano'bhiṣaṅgavaśādeva asya tena karmaṇā tatphalaprāptiḥ. tena etatsiddhaṃ bhavati, kāmo mūlaṃ saṃsārasyeti. ataḥ ucchinnakāmasya vidyamānānyapi karmāṇi brahmavidaḥ vandhyāprasavāni bhavanti, 'paryāptakāmasya kṛtātmanaśca ihaiva sarve pravilīyanti kāmāḥ' iti śruteḥ.
analyzed: tad abhilāṣaḥ hi tat karma kṛtavān tasmāt tad manaḥ bhiṣaṅga vaśāt eva asya tena karmaṇā tad phala prāptiḥ tena etat siddham bhavati kāmaḥ mūlam saṃsārasya iti atas ucchinna kāmasya vidyamānāni api karmāṇi brahma vidaḥ vandhyā prasavāni bhavanti paryāpta kāmasya kṛtātmanaḥ ca iha eva sarve pravilīyanti kāmāḥ iti śruteḥ

original: kiṃca prāpyāntaṃ karmaṇaḥ --- prāpya bhuktvā antam avasānaṃ yāvat, karmaṇaḥ phalaparisamāptiṃ kṛtvetyarthaḥ; kasya karmaṇo'ntaṃ prāpyetyucyate --- tasya, yatkiṃca karma iha asmin loke karoti nirvartayati ayam, tasya karmaṇaḥ phalaṃ bhuktvā antaṃ prāpya, tasmāt lokāt punaḥ aiti āgacchati, asmai lokāya karmaṇe --- ayaṃ hi lokaḥ karmapradhānaḥ,
analyzed: kiṃca prāpya antam karmaṇaḥ prāpya bhuktvā antam avasānam yāvat karmaṇaḥ phala parisamāptim kṛtvā iti arthaḥ kasya karmaṇaḥ antam prāpya iti ucyate tasya yat kiṃca karma iha asmin loke karoti nirvartayati ayam tasya karmaṇaḥ phalam bhuktvā antam prāpya tasmāt lokāt punar aiti āgacchati asmai lokāya karmaṇe ayam hi lokaḥ karma pradhānaḥ

original: tenāha 'karmaṇe' iti --- punaḥ karmakaraṇāya; punaḥ karma kṛtvā phalāsaṅgavaśāt punaramuṃ lokaṃ yāti --- ityevam. iti nu evaṃ nu, kāmayamānaḥ saṃsarati --- yasmāt kāmayamāna eva evaṃ saṃsarati, atha tasmāt, akāmayamāno na kvacitsaṃsarati. phalāsaktasya hi gatiruktā; akāmasya hi kriyānupapatteḥ akāmayamāno mucyata eva.
analyzed: tena āha karmaṇe iti punar karma karaṇāya punar karma kṛtvā phala āsaṅga vaśāt punar amum lokam yāti iti evam iti nu evam nu kāmayamānaḥ saṃsarati yasmāt kāmayamānaḥ eva evam saṃsarati atha tasmāt a kāmayamānaḥ na kvacid saṃsarati phala āsaktasya hi gatiḥ uktā akāmasya hi kriyā anupapatteḥ a kāmayamānaḥ mucyate eva

original: kathaṃ punaḥ akāmayamāno bhavati? yaḥ akāmo bhavati, asau akāmayamānaḥ. kathamakāmatetyucyate --- yo niṣkāmaḥ yasmānnirgatāḥ kāmāḥ so'yaṃ niṣkāmaḥ. kathaṃ kāmā nirgacchanti? ya āptakāmaḥ bhavati āptāḥ kāmā yena sa āptakāmaḥ. kathamāpyante kāmāḥ? ātmakāmatvena, yasya ātmaiva nānyaḥ kāmayitavyo vastvantarabhūtaḥ padārtho bhavati;
analyzed: katham punar a kāmayamānaḥ bhavati yaḥ akāmaḥ bhavati asau a kāmayamānaḥ katham akāma tā iti ucyate yaḥ niṣkāmaḥ yasmāt nirgatāḥ kāmāḥ saḥ ayam niṣkāmaḥ katham kāmāḥ nirgacchanti yaḥ āpta kāmaḥ bhavati āptāḥ kāmāḥ yena saḥ āpta kāmaḥ katham āpyante kāmāḥ ātma kāma tvena yasya ātmā eva na anyaḥ kāmayitavyaḥ vastu antara bhūtaḥ padārthaḥ bhavati

original: ātmaiva anantaro'bāhyaḥ kṛtsnaḥ prajñānaghana ekarasaḥ norardhvaṃ na tiryak nādhaḥ ātmano'nyat kāmayitavyaṃ vastvantaram --- yasya sarvamātmaivābhūttatkena kaṃ paśyet, śrṛṇuyāt, manvīta, vijānīyādvā --- evaṃ vijānankaṃ kāmayeta. jñāyamāno hyanyatvena padārthaḥ kāmayitavyo bhavati; na cāsāvanyaḥ brahmavida āptākāmasyāsti.
analyzed: ātmā eva anantaraḥ bāhyaḥ kṛtsnaḥ prajñāna ghanaḥ ekarasaḥ noḥ ūrardhvam na tiryak na adhas ātmanaḥ anyat kāmayitavyam vastu antaram yasya sarvam ātmā eva abhūt tat kena kam paśyet śrṛṇuyāt manvīta vijānīyāt vā evam vijānan kam kāmayeta jñāyamānaḥ hi anya tvena padārthaḥ kāmayitavyaḥ bhavati na ca asau anyaḥ brahma vidaḥ āpta akāmasya asti

original: ya evātmakāmatayā āptakāmaḥ, sa niṣkāmaḥ akāmaḥ akāmayamāmānaśceti mucyate. na hi asya ātmaiva sarvaṃ bhavati, tasya anātmā kāmayitavyośti. anātmā cānyaḥ kāmayitavyaḥ, sarvaṃ ca ātmaivābhūditi vipratiṣiddham. sarvātmadarśinaḥ kāmayitavyābhāvātkarmānupapattiḥ.
analyzed: yaḥ eva ātma kāmatayā āpta kāmaḥ sa niṣkāmaḥ akāmaḥ a kāmayamāmānaḥ ca iti mucyate na hi asya ātmā eva sarvam bhavati tasya anātmā anātmā ca anyaḥ kāmayitavyaḥ sarvam ca ātmā eva abhūt iti vipratiṣiddham sarva ātma darśinaḥ kāmayitavya abhāvāt karma anupapattiḥ

original: ye tu pratyavāyaparihārārthaṃ karma kalpayanti brahmavido'pi, teṣāṃ na ātmaiva sarvaṃ bhavati, pratyavāyasya jihāsitavyasya ātmano'nyasya abhipretatvāt. yena ca aśanāyādyatītaḥ nityaṃ pratyavāyāsaṃbaddhaḥ vidita ātmā, taṃ vayaṃ brahmavidaṃ brūmaḥ; nityameva aśanāyādyatītamātmānaṃ paśyati;
analyzed: ye tu pratyavāya parihāra artham karma kalpayanti brahma vidaḥ api teṣām na ātmā eva sarvam bhavati pratyavāyasya jihāsitavyasya ātmanaḥ nyasya abhipreta tvāt yena ca aśanāyādi atītaḥ nityam pratyavāya asaṃbaddhaḥ viditaḥ ātmā tam vayam brahma vidam brūmaḥ nityam eva aśanāyādi atītam ātmānam paśyati

original: yasmācca jihāsitavyamanyam upādeyaṃ vā yo na paśyati, tasya karma na śakyata eva saṃbandhum. yastu abrahmavit, tasya bhavatyeva pratyavāyaparihārārthaṃ karmeti na virodhaḥ. ataḥ kāmābhāvāt akāmayamāno na jāyate, mucyata eva.
analyzed: yasmāt ca jihāsitavyam anyam upādeyam vā yaḥ na paśyati tasya karma na śakyate eva saṃbandhum yaḥ tu a brahma vid tasya bhavati eva pratyavāya parihāra artham karma iti na virodhaḥ atas kāma abhāvāt a kāmayamānaḥ na jāyate mucyate eva

original: tasyā evamakāmayamānasya karmābhāve gamanakāraṇābhāvāt prāṇā vāgādayaḥ, notkrāmanti nordhvaṃ krāmanti dehāt. sa ca vidvān āptakāmaḥ ātmakāmatayā ihaiva brahmabhūtaḥ. sarvātmano hi brahmaṇaḥ dṛṣṭāntatvena pradarśitam etadrūpam ---
analyzed: tasyāḥ evam a kāmayamānasya karma abhāve gamana kāraṇa abhāvāt prāṇāḥ vāc ādayaḥ na utkrāmanti na ūrdhvam krāmanti dehāt sa ca vidvān āpta kāmaḥ ātma kāmatayā iha eva brahma bhūtaḥ sarva ātmanaḥ hi brahmaṇaḥ dṛṣṭānta tvena pradarśitam etat rūpam

original: 'tadvā asyaitadāptakāmamakāmaṃ rūpam' iti; tasya hi dārṣṭāntikabhūto'yamartha upasaṃhriyate --- athākāmayamāna ityādinā. sa kathamevaṃbhūto mucyata ityucyate --- yo hi suṣuptāvasthamiva nirviśeṣamadvaitam aluptacidrūpajyotiḥsvabhāvam ātmānaṃ paśyati, tasyaiva akāmayamānasya karmābhāve gamanakāraṇābhāvāt prāṇā vāgādayo notkrāmanti.
analyzed: tat vai asya etat āpta kāmam akāmam rūpam iti tasya hi dārṣṭāntika bhūtaḥ ayam arthaḥ upasaṃhriyate atha a kāmayamānaḥ ityādinā sa katham evaṃbhūtaḥ mucyate iti ucyate yaḥ hi suṣupta avastham iva nirviśeṣam advaitam alupta cit rūpa jyotiḥ svabhāvam ātmānam paśyati tasya eva a kāmayamānasya karma abhāve gamana kāraṇa abhāvāt prāṇāḥ vāc ādayaḥ na utkrāmanti

original: kiṃtu vidvān saḥ ihaiva brahma, yadyapi dehavāniva lakṣyate; sa brahmaiva san brahma apyeti. yasmāt na hi tasya abrahmatvaparicchedahetavaḥ kāmāḥ santi, tasmāt ihaiva brahmaiva san brahma apyeti na śarīrapātottarakālam. na hi viduṣo mṛtasya bhāvāntarāpattiḥ jīvato'nyaḥ bhāvaḥ, dehāntarapratisaṃdhānābhāvamātreṇaiva tu brahmāpyetītyucyate.
analyzed: kiṃtu vidvān saḥ iha eva brahma yadi api dehavān iva lakṣyate sa brahma eva san brahma apyeti yasmāt na hi tasya abrahma tva pariccheda hetavaḥ kāmāḥ santi tasmāt iha eva brahma eva san brahma apyeti na śarīrapāta uttara kālam na hi viduṣaḥ mṛtasya bhāva antara āpattiḥ jīvataḥ nyaḥ bhāvaḥ deha antara pratisaṃdhāna abhāva mātreṇa eva tu brahma apyeti iti ucyate

original: bhāvāntarāpattau hi mokṣasya sarvopaniṣadvivakṣito'rthaḥ ātmaikatvākhyaḥ sa bādhito bhavet; karmahetukaśca mokṣaḥ prāpnoti, na jñānanimitta iti; sa cāniṣṭaḥ; anityatvaṃ ca mokṣasya prāpnoti; na hi kriyānirvṛttaḥ arthaḥ nityo dṛṣṭaḥ; nityaśca mokṣo'bhyupagamyate, 'eṣa nityo mahimā' iti mantravarṇāt.
analyzed: bhāva antara āpattau hi mokṣasya sarva upaniṣad vivakṣitaḥ ṛthaḥ ātma eka tva ākhyaḥ sa bādhitaḥ bhavet karma hetukaḥ ca mokṣaḥ prāpnoti na jñāna nimittaḥ iti sa ca aniṣṭaḥ anitya tvam ca mokṣasya prāpnoti na hi kriyā nirvṛttaḥ arthaḥ nityaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ nityaḥ ca mokṣaḥ abhyupagamyate eṣa nityaḥ mahimā iti mantra varṇāt

original: na ca svābhāvikāt svābhāvāt anyat nityaṃ kalpayituṃ śakyam. svābhāvikaścet agnyuṣṇavat ātmanaḥ svabhāvaḥ, sa na śakyate puruṣavyāpārānubhāvīti vaktum; na hi agnairauṣṇyaṃ prakāśo vā agnivyāpārānantarānubhāvī; agnivyāpārānubhāvī svābhāvikaśceti vipratiṣiddham.
analyzed: na ca svābhāvikāt svābhāvāt anyat nityam kalpayitum śakyam svābhāvikaḥ ced agni uṣṇa vat ātmanaḥ svabhāvaḥ sa na śakyate puruṣa vyāpāra anubhāvi iti vaktum na hi agnaiḥ auṣṇyam prakāśaḥ vā agni vyāpāra anantara anubhāvī agni vyāpāra anubhāvī svābhāvikaḥ ca iti vipratiṣiddham

original: jvalanavyāpārānubhāvitvam uṣṇaprakāśayoriti cet, na, anyopalabdhivyavadhānāpagamābhivyaktyapekṣatvāt; jvalanādipūrvakam agniḥ uṣṇaprakāśaguṇābhyāmabhivyajyate, tat na agnyapekṣayā; kiṃ tarhi anyadṛṣṭeḥ agnerauṣṇyaprakāśau dharmau vyavahitau, kasyaciddṛṣṭyā tu asaṃbadhyamānau, jvalanāpekṣayā vyavadhānāpagame dṛṣṭerabhivyajyete;
analyzed: jvalana vyāpāra anubhāvi tvam uṣṇa prakāśayoḥ iti ced na anya upalabdhi vyavadhāna apagama abhivyakti apekṣa tvāt jvalana ādi pūrvakam agniḥ uṣṇa prakāśa guṇābhyām abhivyajyate tat na agni apekṣayā kim tarhi anya dṛṣṭeḥ agneḥ auṣṇya prakāśau dharmau vyavahitau kasyacid dṛṣṭyā tu asaṃbadhyamānau jvalana apekṣayā vyavadhāna apagame dṛṣṭeḥ abhivyajyete

original: tadapekṣayā bhrāntirupajāyate --- jvalanapūrvakau etau uṣṇaprakāśau dharmau jātāviti. yadi uṣṇaprakāśayorapi svābhāvikatvaṃ na syāt --- yaḥ svābhāviko'gnerdharmaḥ, tamudāhariṣyāmaḥ; na ca svābhāviko dharma eva nāsti padārthānāmiti śakyaṃ vaktum.
analyzed: tad apekṣayā bhrāntiḥ upajāyate jvalana pūrvakau etau uṣṇa prakāśau dharmau jātau iti yadi uṣṇa prakāśayoḥ api svābhāvika tvam na syāt yaḥ svābhāvikaḥ agneḥ dharmaḥ tam udāhariṣyāmaḥ na ca svābhāvikaḥ dharmaḥ eva na asti padārthānām iti śakyam vaktum

original: na ca nigaḍabhaṅga iva abhāvabhūto mokṣaḥ bandhananivṛttirupapadyate, paramātmaikatvābhyupagamāt, 'ekamevādvitīyam' iti śruteḥ; na cānyo baddhośti, yasya nigaḍanivṛttivat bandhananivṛttiḥ mokṣaḥ syāt; paramātmavyatirekeṇa anyasyābhāvaṃ vistareṇa avādiṣma.
analyzed: na ca nigaḍa bhaṅgaḥ iva abhāva bhūtaḥ mokṣaḥ bandhana nivṛttiḥ upapadyate paramātma ekatva abhyupagamāt ekam eva advitīyam iti śruteḥ na ca anyaḥ yasya nigaḍa nivṛtti vat bandhana nivṛttiḥ mokṣaḥ syāt paramātma vyatirekeṇa anyasya abhāvam vistareṇa avādiṣma

original: tasmāt avidyānivṛttimātre mokṣavyavahāra iti ca avocāma, yathā rajjvādau sarpādyajñānanivṛttau sarpādinivṛttiḥ.
analyzed: tasmāt avidyā nivṛtti mātre mokṣa vyavahāraḥ iti ca avocāma yathā rajju ādau sarpa ādi ajñāna nivṛttau sarpa ādi nivṛttiḥ

original: ye'pyācakṣate --- mokṣe vijñānāntaram ānandāntaraṃ ca abhivyajyata iti, tairvaktavyaḥ abhivyaktiśabdārthaḥ. yadi tāvat laukikyeva upalabdhiviṣayavyāptiḥ abhivyaktiśabdārthaḥ, tato vaktavyam --- kiṃ vidyamānamabhivyajyate,
analyzed: ye api ācakṣate mokṣe vijñāna antaram ānanda antaram ca abhivyajyate iti taiḥ vaktavyaḥ abhivyakti śabda arthaḥ yadi tāvat laukikī eva upalabdhi viṣaya vyāptiḥ abhivyakti śabda arthaḥ tatas vaktavyam kim vidyamānam abhivyajyate

original: avidyamānamiti vā. vidyamānaṃ cet, yasya muktasya tadabhivyajyate tasya ātmabhūtameva tat iti, upalabdhivyavadhānānupapatteḥ nityābhivyaktatvāt, muktasya abhivyajyata iti viśeṣavacanamanarthakam. atha kadācideva abhivyajyate, upalabdhivyavadhānāt anātmabhūtaṃ taditi, anyato'bhivyaktiprasaṅgaḥ; tathā ca abhivyaktisādhanāpekṣatā.

original: ataḥ mṛtyuviyoge vidvān jīvanneva amṛto bhavati. ata asminneva śarīre vartamānaḥ brahma samaśnute, brahmabhāvaṃ mokṣaṃ pratipadyata ityarthaḥ. ataḥ mokṣaḥ na deśāntaragamanādi apekṣate. tasmāt viduṣo notkrāmanti prāṇāḥ, yathāvasthitā eva svakāraṇe puruṣe samavanīyante; nāmamātraṃ hi avaśiṣyate --- ityuktam.

original: kathaṃ punaḥ samavanīteṣu prāṇeṣu, dehe ca svakāraṇe pralīne, vidvān muktaḥ atraiva sarvātmā san vartamānaḥ punaḥ pūrvavat dehitvaṃ saṃsāritvalakṣaṇaṃ na pratipadyate --- ityatrocyate --- tat tatra ayaṃ dṛṣṭāntaḥ;
analyzed: katham punar samavanīteṣu prāṇeṣu dehe ca sva kāraṇe pralīne vidvān muktaḥ atra eva sarvātmā san vartamānaḥ punar pūrvavat dehi tvam saṃsāri tva lakṣaṇam na pratipadyate iti atra ucyate tat tatra ayam dṛṣṭāntaḥ

original: yathā loke ahiḥ sarpaḥ, tasya nirlvayanī, nirmokaḥ, sā ahinirlvayanī, valmīke sarpāśraye valmīkādāvityarthaḥ, mṛtā pratyastā prakṣiptā anātmabhāvena sarpeṇa parityaktā, śayīta varteta --- evameva, yathā ayaṃ dṛṣṭāntaḥ, idaṃ śarīraṃ sarpasthānīyena muktena anātmabhāvena parityaktaṃ mṛtamiva śete.

original: atha itaraḥ sarpasthānīyo muktaḥ sarvātmabhūtaḥ sarpavat tatraiva vartamāno'pi aśarīra eva, na pūrvavat punaḥ saśarīro bhavati. kāmakarmaprayuktaśarīrātmabhāvena hi pūrvaṃ saśarīraḥ martyaśca; tadviyogāt atha idānīm aśarīraḥ, ata eva ca amṛtaḥ;

original: prāṇaḥ, prāṇitīti prāṇaḥ --- 'prāṇasya prāṇam' ihi hi vakṣyamāṇe śloke, 'prāṇabandhanaṃ hi somya manaḥ' iti ca śrutyantare; prakaraṇavākyasāmarthyācca para eva ātmā atra prāṇaśabdavācyaḥ; brahmaiva paramātmaiva. kiṃ punastat? teja eva vijñānam jyotiḥ, yena ātmajyotiṣā jagat avabhāsyamānaṃ prajñānetraṃ vijñānajyotiṣmat sat avibhraṃśat vartate.
analyzed: prāṇaḥ prāṇiti iti prāṇaḥ prāṇasya prāṇam ihi hi vakṣyamāṇe śloke prāṇa bandhanam hi somya manaḥ iti ca śruti antare prakaraṇa vākya sāmarthyāt ca paraḥ eva ātmā atra prāṇa śabda vācyaḥ brahma eva paramātmā eva kim punar tat tejaḥ eva vijñānam jyotiḥ yena ātma jyotiṣā jagat avabhāsyamānam prajñā netram vijñāna jyotiṣmat sat a vibhraṃśat vartate

original: yaḥ kāmapraśno vimokṣārthaḥ yājñavalkyena varo datto janakāya, sahetukaḥ bandhamokṣārthalakṣaṇaḥ dṛṣṭāntadārṣṭāntikabhūtaḥ sa eṣa nirṇītaḥ savistaraḥ janakayājñavalkyākhyāyikārūpadhāriṇyā śrutyā; saṃsāravimokṣopāya uktaḥ prāṇibhyaḥ. idānīṃ śrutiḥ svayamevāha --- vidyāniṣkrayārthaṃ janakenaivamuktamiti;
analyzed: yaḥ kāma praśnaḥ vimokṣa arthaḥ yājñavalkyena varaḥ dattaḥ janakāya sa hetukaḥ bandha mokṣa artha lakṣaṇaḥ dṛṣṭānta dārṣṭāntika bhūtaḥ saḥ eṣa nirṇītaḥ sa vistaraḥ janaka yājñavalkya ākhyāyikā rūpa dhāriṇyā śrutyā saṃsāra vimokṣa upāyaḥ uktaḥ prāṇibhyaḥ idānīm śrutiḥ svayam eva āha vidyā niṣkraya artham janakena evam uktam iti

original: katham? so'ham evaṃ vimokṣitastvayā bhagavate tubhyaṃ vidyāniṣkrayārthaṃ sahasraṃ dadāmi --- iti ha evaṃ kila uvāca uktavān janako vaidehaḥ. atra kasmādvimokṣapadārthe nirṇīte, videharājyam ātmānameva ca na nivedayati, ekadeśoktāviva sahasrameva dadāti? tatra ko'bhiprāya iti.

original: tatra kecidvarṇayanti --- adhyātmavidyārasiko janakaḥ śrutamapyarthaṃ punarmantraiḥ śūśrūṣati; ato na sarvameva nivedayati; śrutvābhipretaṃ yājñavalkyāt punarante nivedayiṣyāmīti hi manyate; yadi cātraiva sarvaṃ nivedayāmi, nivṛttābhilāṣo'yaṃ śravaṇāditi matvā, ślokān na vakṣyati --- iti ca bhayāt sahasradānaṃ śuśrūṣāliṅgajñāpanāyeti.
analyzed: tatra kecid varṇayanti adhyātma vidyā rasikaḥ janakaḥ śrutam api artham punar mantraiḥ śūśrūṣati atas na sarvam eva nivedayati śrutvā abhipretam yājñavalkyāt punar ante nivedayiṣyāmi iti hi manyate yadi ca atra eva sarvam nivedayāmi nivṛtta abhilāṣaḥ yam śravaṇāt iti matvā ślokān na vakṣyati iti ca bhayāt sahasra dānam śuśrūṣā liṅga jñāpanāya iti

original: sarvamapyetat asat, puruṣasyeva pramāṇabhūtāyāḥ śruteḥ vyājānupapatteḥ; arthaśeṣopapatteśca --- vimokṣapadārthe ukte'pi ātmajñānasādhane, ātmajñānaśeṣabhūtaḥ sarvaiṣaṇāparityāgaḥ saṃnyāsākhyaḥ vaktavyo'rthaśeṣaḥ vidyate; tasmāt ślokamātraśuśrūṣākalpanā anujvī; agatikā hi gatiḥ punaruktārthakalpanā; sā ca ayuktā satyāṃ gatau.
analyzed: sarvam api etat asat puruṣasya iva pramāṇa bhūtāyāḥ śruteḥ vyāja anupapatteḥ artha śeṣa upapatteḥ ca vimokṣa padārthe ukte api ātma jñāna sādhane ātma jñāna śeṣa bhūtaḥ sarva eṣaṇā parityāgaḥ saṃnyāsa ākhyaḥ vaktavyaḥ arthaśeṣaḥ vidyate tasmāt śloka mātra śuśrūṣā kalpanā anujvī agatikā hi gatiḥ punarukta artha kalpanā sā ca ayuktā satyām gatau

original: na ca tat stutimātramityavocāma. nanu evaṃ sati 'ata ūrdhvaṃ vimokṣāyaiva' iti vaktavyam --- naiṣa doṣaḥ; ātmajñānavat aprayojakaḥ saṃnyāsaḥ pakṣe, pratipattikarmavat --- iti hi manyate; śaṃnyāsena tanuṃ tyajet' iti smṛteḥ. sādhanatvapakṣe'pi na 'ata ūrdhvaṃ vimokṣāyaiva' iti praśnamarhati, mokṣasādhanabhūtātmajñānaparipākārthatvāt.
analyzed: na ca tat stuti mātram iti avocāma nanu evam sati atas ūrdhvam vimokṣāya eva iti vaktavyam na eṣa doṣaḥ ātma jñāna vat aprayojakaḥ saṃnyāsaḥ pakṣe pratipatti karma vat iti hi manyate śam nyāsena tanum tyajet iti smṛteḥ sādhana tva pakṣe api na atas ūrdhvam vimokṣāya eva iti praśnam arhati mokṣa sādhana bhūta ātma jñāna paripāka artha tvāt

original: ātmakāmasya brahmavido mokṣa ityetasminnarthe mantrabrāhmaṇokte, vistarapratipādakā ete ślokā bhavanti. aṇuḥ sūkṣmaḥ
analyzed: ātma kāmasya brahma vidaḥ mokṣaḥ iti etasmin arthe mantra brāhmaṇa ukte vistara pratipādakāḥ ete ślokāḥ bhavanti aṇuḥ sūkṣmaḥ

original: panthāḥ durvijñeyatvāt, vitataḥ vistīrṇaḥ, vispaṣṭataraṇahetutvādvā 'vitaraḥ' iti pāṭhāntarāt, mokṣasādhano jñānamārgaḥ purāṇaḥ ciraṃtanaḥ nityaśrutiprakāśitatvāt, na tārkikabuddhiprabhavakudṛṣṭimārgavat arvākkālikaḥ, māṃ spṛṣṭaḥ mayā labdha ityarthaḥ; yo hi yena labhyate, sa taṃ spṛśatīva saṃbadhyate;
analyzed: panthāḥ durvijñeya tvāt vitataḥ vistīrṇaḥ vispaṣṭa taraṇa hetutvāt vā vitaraḥ iti pāṭha antarāt mokṣa sādhanaḥ jñāna mārgaḥ purāṇaḥ ciraṃtanaḥ nitya śruti prakāśita tvāt na tārkika buddhi prabhava kudṛṣṭi mārga vat arvākkālikaḥ mām spṛṣṭaḥ mayā labdhaḥ iti arthaḥ yaḥ hi yena labhyate sa tam spṛśati iva saṃbadhyate

original: tena ayaṃ brahmavidyālakṣaṇo mokṣamārgaḥ mayā labdhatvāt 'māṃ spṛṣṭaḥ' ityucyate. na kevalaṃ mayā labdhaḥ, kiṃ tu anuvitto mayaiva; anuvedanaṃ nāma vidyāyāḥ paripākāpekṣayā phalāvasānatāniṣṭhā prāptiḥ, bhujeriva tṛptyavāsānatā; pūrvaṃ tu jñānaprāptisaṃbandhamātrameveti viśeṣaḥ.
analyzed: tena ayam brahma vidyā lakṣaṇaḥ mokṣa mārgaḥ mayā labdha tvāt mām spṛṣṭaḥ iti ucyate na kevalam mayā labdhaḥ kim tu anuvittaḥ mayā eva anuvedanam nāma vidyāyāḥ paripāka apekṣayā phala avasāna tā niṣṭhā prāptiḥ bhujeḥ iva tṛpti avāsāna tā pūrvam tu jñāna prāpti saṃbandha mātram eva iti viśeṣaḥ

original: kim asāveva mantradṛk ekaḥ brahmavidyāphalaṃ prāptaḥ, nānyaḥ prāptavān, yena 'anuvitto mayaiva' ityavadhārayati --- naiṣa doṣaḥ, asyāḥ phalam ātmasākṣikamanuttamamiti brahmavidyāyāḥ stutiparatvāt; evaṃ hi kṛtārthatmābhimānakaram ātmapratyayasākṣikam ātmajñānam, kimataḥ param anyatsyāt --- iti brahmavidyāṃ stauti;
analyzed: kim asau eva mantradṛś ekaḥ brahma vidyā phalam prāptaḥ na anyaḥ prāptavān yena anuvittaḥ mayā eva iti avadhārayati na eṣa doṣaḥ asyāḥ phalam ātma sākṣikam anuttamam iti brahma vidyāyāḥ stuti paratvāt evam hi kṛtārtha tma abhimāna karam ātma pratyaya sākṣikam ātma jñānam kim atas param anyat syāt iti brahma vidyām stauti

original: na tu punaḥ anyo brahmavit tatphalaṃ na prāpnotīti, 'tadyo yo devānām' iti sarvārthaśruteḥ; tadevāha --- tena brahmavidyāmārgeṇa dhīrāḥ prajñāvantaḥ anye'pi brahmavida ityarthaḥ, apiyanti apigacchanti, brahmavidyāphalaṃ mokṣaṃ svargaṃ lokam; svargalokaśabdaḥ triviṣṭapavācyapi san iha prakaraṇāt mokṣābhidhāyakaḥ;
analyzed: na tu punar anyaḥ brahma vid tad phalam na prāpnoti iti tat yaḥ yaḥ devānām iti sarva artha śruteḥ tat eva āha tena brahma vidyā mārgeṇa dhīrāḥ prajñāvantaḥ anye api brahma vidaḥ iti arthaḥ apiyanti apigacchanti brahma vidyā phalam mokṣam svargam lokam svarga loka śabdaḥ triviṣṭapa vācī api san iha prakaraṇāt mokṣa abhidhāyakaḥ

original: itaḥ asmāccharīrapātāt ūrdhvaṃ jīvanta eva vimuktāḥ santaḥ.
analyzed: itas asmāt śarīrapātāt ūrdhvam jīvantaḥ eva vimuktāḥ santaḥ
R

original: tasmin mokṣasādhanamārge vipratipattirmumukṣūṇām; katham? tasmin śuklaṃ śuddhaṃ vimalam āhuḥ kecit mumukṣavaḥ; nīlam anye, piṅgalam anye, haritaṃ lohitaṃ ca --- yathādarśanam. nāḍyastu etāḥ suṣumnādyāḥ śleṣmādirasasaṃpūrṇāḥ --- śuklasya nīlasya piṅgalasyetyādyuktatvāt.
analyzed: tasmin mokṣa sādhana mārge vipratipattiḥ mumukṣūṇām katham tasmin śuklam śuddham vimalam āhuḥ kecid mumukṣavaḥ nīlam anye piṅgalam anye haritam lohitam ca yathādarśanam nāḍyaḥ tu etāḥ suṣumnā ādyāḥ śleṣma ādi rasa saṃpūrṇāḥ śuklasya nīlasya piṅgalasya ityādi ukta tvāt

original: ādityaṃ vā mokṣamārgam evaṃvidhaṃ manyante --- 'eṣa śukla eṣa nīlaḥ' ityādiśrutyantarāt. darśanamārgasya ca śuklādivarṇāsaṃbhavāt. sarvathāpi tu prakṛtāt brahmavidyāmārgāt anye ete śuklādayaḥ. nanu śuklaḥ śuddhaḥ advaitamārgaḥ --- na, nīlapītādiśabdaiḥ varṇavīcakaiḥ saha anudravaṇāt; yān śuklādīn yogino mokṣapathān āhuḥ, na te mokṣamārgāḥ;
analyzed: ādityam vā mokṣa mārgam evaṃvidham manyante eṣa śuklaḥ eṣa nīlaḥ ityādi śruti antarāt darśana mārgasya ca śukla ādi varṇa asaṃbhavāt sarvathā api tu prakṛtāt brahmavidyā mārgāt anye ete śukla ādayaḥ nanu śuklaḥ śuddhaḥ advaita mārgaḥ na nīla pīta ādi śabdaiḥ varṇa vīcakaiḥ saha anudravaṇāt yān śukla ādīn yoginaḥ mokṣa pathān āhuḥ na te mokṣa mārgāḥ

original: saṃsāraviṣayā eva hi te --- 'cakṣuṣṭo vā mūrdhno vānyebhyo vā śarīradeśebhyaḥ' iti śarīradeśānniḥsaraṇasaṃbandhāt, brahmādilokaprāpakā hi te.
analyzed: saṃsāra viṣayāḥ eva hi te cakṣuṣṭas vā mūrdhnaḥ vā anyebhyaḥ vā śarīra deśebhyaḥ iti śarīra deśāt niḥsaraṇa saṃbandhāt brahma ādi loka prāpakāḥ hi te

original: tasmāt ayameva mokṣamārgaḥ --- yaḥ āptakāmatvena āptakāmatayā sarvakāmakṣaye gamanānupapattau pradīpanirvāṇavat cakṣurādīnāṃ kāryakaraṇānām atraiva samavanayaḥ --- iti eṣaḥ jñānamārgaḥ panthāḥ, brahmaṇā paramātmasvarūpeṇaiva brāhmaṇena tyaktasarvaiṣaṇena, anuvittaḥ. tena brahmavidyāmārgeṇa brahmavit anyaḥ api eti.
analyzed: tasmāt ayam eva mokṣa mārgaḥ yaḥ āpta kāma tvena āpta kāma tayā sarva kāma kṣaye gamana anupapattau pradīpa nirvāṇa vat cakṣuḥ ādīnām kārya karaṇānām atra eva samavanayaḥ iti eṣaḥ jñāna mārgaḥ panthāḥ brahmaṇā paramātma svarūpeṇa eva brāhmaṇena tyakta sarva eṣaṇena anuvittaḥ tena brahma vidyā mārgeṇa brahma vid anyaḥ api eti

original: kīdṛśo brahmavit tena etītyucyate --- pūrvaṃ puṇyakṛdbhūtvā punastyaktaputrādyeṣaṇaḥ, paramātmatejasyātmānaṃ saṃyojya tasminnabhinirvṛttaḥ taijasaścātmabhūtaḥ ihaiva ityarthaḥ; īdṛśo brahmavit tena mārgeṇa eti. na punaḥ puṇyādisamuccayakāriṇo grahaṇam, virodhādityavocāma; 'apuṇyapuṇyoparame yaṃ punarbhavanirbhayāḥ.
analyzed: kīdṛśaḥ brahma vid tena eti iti ucyate pūrvam puṇya kṛt bhūtvā punar tyakta putra ādi eṣaṇaḥ paramātma tejasi ātmānam saṃyojya tasmin abhinirvṛttaḥ taijasaḥ ca ātma bhūtaḥ iha eva iti arthaḥ īdṛśaḥ brahma vid tena mārgeṇa eti na punar puṇya ādi samuccaya kāriṇaḥ grahaṇam virodhāt iti avocāma apuṇya puṇya uparame yam punarbhava nirbhayāḥ

original: śāntāḥ saṃnyāsino yānti tasmai mokṣātmane namaḥ' iti ca smṛteḥ; 'tyaja dharmamadharmaṃ ca' ityādi puṇyāpuṇyatyāgopadeśāt; 'nirāśiṣamanārambhaṃ nirnamaskāramastutim. akṣīṇaṃ kṣīṇakarmāṇaṃ taṃ devā brāhmaṇaṃ viduḥ' naitādṛśaṃ brāhmaṇasyāsti vittaṃ yathaikatā samatā satyatā ca.
analyzed: śāntāḥ saṃnyāsinaḥ yānti tasmai mokṣa ātmane namaḥ iti ca smṛteḥ tyaja dharmam adharmam ca ityādi puṇya apuṇya tyāga upadeśāt akṣīṇam kṣīṇa karmāṇam tam devāḥ brāhmaṇam viduḥ na etādṛśam brāhmaṇasya asti vittam yathā eka tā sama tā satya tā ca

original: śīlaṃ sthitirdaṇḍanidhānamārjavaṃ tatastataścoparamaḥ kriyābhyaḥ' ityādismṛtibhyaśca. upadekṣyati ca ihāpi tu --- 'eṣa nityo mahimā brāhmaṇasya na vardhate karmaṇā no kanīyān' iti karmaprayojanābhāve hetumuktvā, 'tasmādevaṃvicchānto dāntaḥ' ityādinā sarvakriyoparamam. tasmāt yathāvyākhyātameva puṇyakṛttvam.
analyzed: śīlam sthitiḥ daṇḍa nidhānam ārjavam tatas tatas ca uparamaḥ kriyābhyaḥ ityādi smṛtibhyaḥ ca upadekṣyati ca iha api tu eṣa nityaḥ mahimā brāhmaṇasya na vardhate karmaṇā no kanīyān iti karma prayojana abhāve hetum uktvā tasmāt evaṃvid śāntaḥ dāntaḥ ityādinā sarva kriyā uparamam tasmāt yathā vyākhyātam eva puṇya kṛt tvam

original: athavā yo brahmavit tena eti, sa puṇyakṛt taijasaśca --- iti brahmavitstutireṣā; puṇyakṛti taijase ca yogini mahābhāgyaṃ prasiddhaṃ loke, tābhyām ataḥ brahmavit stūyate prakhyātamahābhāgyatvālloke.
analyzed: athavā yaḥ brahma vid tena eti sa puṇya kṛt taijasaḥ ca iti brahma vid stutiḥ eṣā puṇya kṛti taijase ca yogini mahābhāgyam prasiddham loke tābhyām atas brahma vid stūyate prakhyāta mahābhāgya tvāt loke

original: andham adarśanātmakaṃ tamaḥ saṃsāriniyāmakaṃ praviśanti pratipadyante; ke? ye avidyāṃ vidyāto'nyāṃ sādhyasādhanalakṣaṇām, upāsate, karma anuvartanta ityarthaḥ; tataḥ tasmādapi bhūya iva bahutaramiva tamaḥ praviśanti; ke? ye u vidyāyām avidyāvastupratipādikāyāṃ karmārthāyāṃ trayyāmeva vidyāyām, ratā abhiratāḥ;
analyzed: andham adarśana ātmakam tamaḥ saṃsāri niyāmakam praviśanti pratipadyante ke ye avidyām vidyātas nyām sādhya sādhana lakṣaṇām upāsate karma anuvartantaḥ iti arthaḥ tatas tasmāt api bhūyas iva bahutaram iva tamaḥ praviśanti ke ye u vidyāyām avidyā vastu pratipādikāyām karma arthāyām trayyām eva vidyāyām ratāḥ abhiratāḥ

original: vidhipratiṣedhapara eva vedaḥ, nānyośti --- iti, upaniṣadarthānapekṣiṇa ityarthaḥ.
analyzed: vidhi pratiṣedha paraḥ eva vedaḥ iti upaniṣad artha anapekṣiṇaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: yadi te adarśanalakṣaṇaṃ tamaḥ praviśanti, ko doṣa ityucyate --- anandāḥ anānandāḥ asukhā nāma te lokāḥ, tena andhenādarśanalakṣaṇena tamasā āvṛtāḥ vyāptāḥ, te tasya ajñānatamaso gocarāḥ; tān te pretya mṛtvā abhigacchanti
analyzed: yadi te adarśana lakṣaṇam tamaḥ praviśanti kaḥ doṣaḥ iti ucyate anandāḥ anānandāḥ asukhāḥ nāma te lokāḥ tena andhena adarśana lakṣaṇena tamasā āvṛtāḥ vyāptāḥ te tasya ajñāna tamasaḥ gocarāḥ tān te pretya mṛtvā abhigacchanti

original: abhiyānti; ke? ye avidvāṃsaḥ; kiṃ sāmānyena avidvattāmātreṇa? netyucyate --- abuddhaḥ, budheḥ avagamanārthasya dhātoḥ kvippratyayāntasya rūpam, ātmāvagamavarjitā ityarthaḥ; janāḥ prākṛtā eva jananadharmāṇo vā ityetat.
analyzed: abhiyānti ke ye avidvāṃsaḥ kim sāmānyena avidvat tā mātreṇa na iti ucyate abuddhaḥ budheḥ avagamana arthasya dhātoḥ kvip pratyaya antasya rūpam ātma avagama varjitāḥ iti arthaḥ janāḥ prākṛtāḥ eva janana dharmāṇaḥ vā iti etat

original: ātmānaṃ svaṃ paraṃ sarvaprāṇimanīṣitajñaṃ hṛtstham aśanāyādidharmātītam, cet yadi, vijānīyāt sahasreṣu kaścit; cediti ātmavidyāyā durlabhatvaṃ darśayati; katham? ayam para ātmā sarvaprāṇipratyayasākṣī, yaḥ neti netītyādyuktaḥ, yasmānnānyośti draṣṭā śrotā mantā vijñātā, samaḥ sarvabhūtastho nityaśuddhabuddhamuktasvabhāvaḥ --- asmi bhavāmi --- iti;
analyzed: ātmānam svam param sarva prāṇi manīṣita jñam hṛd stham aśanāya ādi dharma atītam ced yadi vijānīyāt sahasreṣu kaścid ced iti ātma vidyāyāḥ durlabha tvam darśayati katham ayam paraḥ ātmā sarva prāṇi pratyaya sākṣī yaḥ na iti na iti ityādi uktaḥ draṣṭā śrotā mantā vijñātā samaḥ sarva bhūta sthaḥ nitya śuddha buddha mukta svabhāvaḥ asmi bhavāmi iti

original: pūruṣaḥ puruṣaḥ; saḥ kimicchan --- tatsvarūpavyatiriktam anyadvastu phalabhūtaṃ kimicchan kasya vā anyasya ātmano vyatiriktasya kāmāya prayojanāya; na hi tasya ātmana eṣṭavyaṃ phalam, na cāpyātmano'nyaḥ asti, yasya kāmāya icchati, sarvasya ātmabhūtatvāt;
analyzed: pūruṣaḥ puruṣaḥ saḥ kim icchan tad svarūpa vyatiriktam anyat vastu phala bhūtam kim icchan kasya vā anyasya ātmanaḥ vyatiriktasya kāmāya prayojanāya na hi tasya ātmanaḥ eṣṭavyam phalam na ca api ātmanaḥ nyaḥ asti yasya kāmāya icchati sarvasya ātma bhūta tvāt

original: ataḥ kimicchan kasya kāmāya śarīramanusaṃjvaret, bhraṃśet, śarīropādhikṛtaduḥkhamanu duḥkhī syāt, śarīratāpamanutapyeta. anātmadarśino hi tadvyatiriktavastvantarepsoḥ; 'mamadeṃ syāt, putrasya idam, bhāryāyā idam' ityevamīhamānaḥ punaḥpunarjananamaraṇaprabandharūḍhaḥ śarīrarogamanu rujyate; sarvātmadarśinastu tadasaṃbhava ityetadāha.
analyzed: atas kim icchan kasya kāmāya śarīram anusaṃjvaret bhraṃśet śarīra upādhi kṛta duḥkham anu duḥkhī syāt śarīra tāpam anutapyeta anātma darśinaḥ hi tad vyatirikta vastu antara īpsoḥ syāt putrasya idam bhāryāyāḥ idam iti evam īhamānaḥ punar punar janana maraṇa prabandha rūḍhaḥ śarīra rogam anu rujyate sarva ātma darśinaḥ tu tad asaṃbhavaḥ iti etat āha

original: kiṃ ca yasya brāhmaṇasya, anuvittaḥ anulabdhaḥ, pratibuddhaḥ sākṣātkṛtaḥ, katham? ahamasmi paraṃ brahmetyevaṃ pratyagātmatvenāvagataḥ, ātmā asminsaṃdehye saṃdehe anekānarthasaṃkaṭopacaye, gahane viṣame anekaśatasahasravivekavijñānapratipakṣe viṣame, praviṣṭaḥ; sa yasya brāhmaṇasyānuvittaḥ pratibodhenetyarthaḥ; sa viśvakṛt viśvasya kartā;
analyzed: kim ca yasya brāhmaṇasya anuvittaḥ anulabdhaḥ pratibuddhaḥ sākṣātkṛtaḥ katham aham asmi param brahma iti evam pratyagātma tvena avagataḥ ātmā asmin saṃdehye saṃdehe aneka anartha saṃkaṭa upacaye gahane viṣame aneka śata sahasra viveka vijñāna pratipakṣe viṣame praviṣṭaḥ sa yasya brāhmaṇasya anuvittaḥ pratibodhena iti arthaḥ sa viśvakṛt viśvasya kartā

original: kathaṃ viśvakṛttvam, tasya kiṃ viśvakṛditi nāma ityāśaṅkyāha --- saḥ hi yasmāt sarvasya kartā, na nāmamātram; na kevalaṃ viśvakṛt paraprayuktaḥ san, kiṃ tarhi tasya lokaḥ sarvaḥ; kimanyo lokaḥ anyośāvityucyate --- sa u loka eva; lokaśabdena ātmā ucyate; tasya sarva ātmā, sa ca sarvasyātmetyarthaḥ.

original: yathā ca vayaṃ brahma viditvā asmādvinaśanādvipramuktāḥ, evaṃ ye tadviduḥ amṛtāste bhavanti; ye punaḥ naivaṃ brahma viduḥ, te itare brahmavidbhyo'nye abrahmavida ityarthaḥ, duḥkhameva janmamaraṇādilakṣaṇameva apiyanti pratipadyante, na kadācidapi aviduṣāṃ tato vinivṛttirityarthaḥ; duḥkhameva hi te ātmatvenopagacchanti.

original: aparicchindan arvāgeva vartate, ahobhiḥ svāvayavaiḥ ahorātrairityarthaḥ; tat jyotiṣāṃ jyotiḥ ādityādijyotiṣāmapyavabhāsakatvāt, āyurityupāsate devāḥ, amṛtaṃ jyotiḥ --- ato'nyanmriyate, na hi jyotiḥ; sarvasya hi etajjyotiḥ āyuḥ. āyurguṇena yasmāt devāḥ tat jyotirupāsate, tasmāt āyuṣmantaste. tasmāt āyuṣkāmena āyurguṇena upāsyaṃ brahmetyarthaḥ.

original: kiṃ ca yasmin yatra brahmaṇi, pañca pañcajanāḥ --- gandharvādayaḥ pañcaiva saṃkhyātāḥ pitaro devā asurā rakṣāṃsi --- niṣādapañcamā vā varṇāḥ, ākāśaśca avyākṛtākhyaḥ --- yasmin sūtram otaṃ ca protaṃ ca --- yasminpratiṣṭhitaḥ; 'etasminnu khalvakṣare gārgyākāśaḥ' ityuktam; tameva ātmānam amṛtaṃ brahma manye aham, na cāhamātmānaṃ tato'nyatvena jāne.

original: kiṃ tarhi? amṛto'ham brahma vidvānsan; ajñānamātreṇa tu martyo'ham āsam; tadapagamāt vidvānaham amṛta eva.

original: kiṃ ca tena hi caitanyātmajyotiṣā avabhāsyamānaḥ prāṇaḥ ātmabhūtena prāṇiti, tena prāṇasyāpi prāṇaḥ saḥ, taṃ prāṇasya prāṇam; tathā cakṣuṣo'pi cakṣuḥ; uta śrotrasyāpi śrotram; brahmaśaktyadhiṣṭhitānāṃ hi cakṣurādīnāṃ darśanādisāmarthyam; svataḥ kāṣṭhaloṣṭasamāni hi tāni caitanyātmajyotiḥśūnyāni;
analyzed: kim ca tena hi caitanya ātma jyotiṣā avabhāsyamānaḥ prāṇaḥ ātma bhūtena prāṇiti tena prāṇasya api prāṇaḥ saḥ tam prāṇasya prāṇam tathā cakṣuṣaḥ upi cakṣuḥ uta śrotrasya api śrotram brahma śakti adhiṣṭhitānām hi cakṣuḥ ādīnām darśana ādi sāmarthyam svatas kāṣṭha loṣṭa samāni hi tāni caitanya ātma jyotiḥ śūnyāni
