original: parjanyo vā agnirgautama, dvitīya āhutyādhāraḥ āhutyorāvṛttikrameṇa. parjanyo nāma vṛṣṭyupakaraṇābhimānī devatātmā. tasya saṃvatsara eva samit; saṃvatsareṇa hi śaradādibhirgrīṣmāntaiḥ svāvayavairviparivartamānena parjanyo'gnirdīpyate. abhrāṇi dhūmaḥ, dhūmaprabhavatvāt dhūmavadupalakṣyatvādvā. vidyut arciḥ, prakāśasāmānyāt.
analyzed: parjanyaḥ vai agniḥ gautama dvitīyaḥ āhuti ādhāraḥ āhutyoḥ āvṛtti krameṇa parjanyaḥ nāma vṛṣṭi upakaraṇa abhimānī devatā ātmā tasya saṃvatsaraḥ eva samidh saṃvatsareṇa hi śarad ādibhiḥ grīṣma antaiḥ sva avayavaiḥ viparivartamānena parjanya agniḥ dīpyate abhrāṇi dhūmaḥ dhūma prabhava tvāt dhūma vat upalakṣya tvāt vā vidyut arciḥ prakāśa sāmānyāt

original: aśaniḥ aṅgārāḥ, upaśāntakāṭhinyasāmānyābhyām. hrādunayaḥ hlādunayaḥ stanayitnuśabdāḥ visphuliṅgāḥ, vikṣepānekatvasāmānyāt. tasminnetasminniti āhutyadhikaraṇanirdeśaḥ. devā iti, te eva hotāraḥ somaṃ rājānaṃ juhvati; yośau dyulokāgnau śraddhāyāṃ hutāyāmabhinirvṛttaḥ somaḥ, sa dvitīye parjanyāgnau hūyate; tasyāśca somāhutervṛṣṭiḥ saṃbhavati.
analyzed: aśaniḥ aṅgārāḥ upaśānta kāṭhinya sāmānyābhyām hrādunayaḥ hlādunayaḥ stanayitnu śabdāḥ visphuliṅgāḥ vikṣepa aneka tva sāmānyāt tasmin etasmin iti āhuti adhikaraṇa nirdeśaḥ devāḥ iti te eva hotāraḥ somam rājānam juhvati yośau dyu loka agnau śraddhāyām hutāyām abhinirvṛttaḥ somaḥ sa dvitīye parjanya agnau hūyate tasyāḥ ca soma āhuteḥ vṛṣṭiḥ saṃbhavati

original: ayaṃ vai loko'gnirgautama. ayaṃ loka iti prāṇijanmopabhogāśrayaḥ kriyākārakaphalaviśiṣṭaḥ, sa tṛtīyo'gniḥ. tasyāgneḥ pṛthivyeva samit; pṛthivyā hi ayaṃ lokaḥ anekaprāṇyupabhogasaṃpannayā samidhyate. agniḥ dhūmaḥ, pṛthivyāśrayotthānasāmānyāt; pārthivaṃ hi indhanadravyam āśritya agniḥ uttiṣṭhati, yathā samidāśrayeṇa dhūmaḥ.
analyzed: ayam vai loka ugniḥ gautama ayam lokaḥ iti prāṇi janma upabhoga āśrayaḥ kriyā kāraka phala viśiṣṭaḥ sa tṛtīyaḥ agniḥ tasya agneḥ pṛthivī eva samidh pṛthivyā hi ayam lokaḥ aneka prāṇi upabhoga saṃpannayā samidhyate agniḥ dhūmaḥ pṛthivī āśraya utthāna sāmānyāt pārthivam hi indhana dravyam āśritya agniḥ uttiṣṭhati yathā samidh āśrayeṇa dhūmaḥ

original: rātriḥ arciḥ, samitsaṃbandhaprabhavasāmānyāt; agneḥ samitsaṃbandhena hi arciḥ saṃbhavati, tathā pṛthivīsamitsaṃbandhena śarvarī; pṛthivīchāyāṃ hi śārvaraṃ tama ācakṣate. candramā aṅgārāḥ, tatprabhavatvasāmānyāt; arciṣo hi aṅgārāḥ prabhavanti, tathā rātrau candramāḥ; upaśāntatvasāmānyādvā. nakṣatrāṇi visphuliṅgāḥ, visphuliṅgavadvikṣepasāmānyāt.
analyzed: rātriḥ arciḥ samidh saṃbandha prabhava sāmānyāt agneḥ samidh saṃbandhena hi arciḥ saṃbhavati tathā pṛthivī samidh saṃbandhena śarvarī pṛthivī chāyām hi śārvaram tamaḥ ācakṣate candramāḥ aṅgārāḥ tad prabhava tva sāmānyāt arciṣaḥ hi aṅgārāḥ prabhavanti tathā rātrau candramāḥ upaśānta tva sāmānyāt vā nakṣatrāṇi visphuliṅgāḥ visphuliṅga vat vikṣepa sāmānyāt

original: tasminnetasminnatyādi pūrvavat. vṛṣṭiṃ juhvati, tasyā āhuteḥ annaṃ saṃbhavati, vṛṣṭiprabhavatvasya prasiddhatvāt vrīhiyavāderannasya.
analyzed: tasmin etasmin atyādi pūrvavat vṛṣṭim juhvati tasyāḥ āhuteḥ annam saṃbhavati vṛṣṭi prabhava tvasya prasiddha tvāt vrīhi yava ādeḥ annasya

original: puruṣo vā agnirgautama; prasiddhaḥ śiraḥpāṇyādimān puruṣaḥ caturtho'gniḥ tasya vyāttaṃ vivṛtaṃ mukhaṃ samit; vivṛtena hi mukhena dīpyate puruṣaḥ vacanasvādhyāyādau, yathā samidhā agniḥ. prāṇo dhūmaḥ tadutthānasāmānyāt; mukhāddhi prāṇa uttiṣṭhati. vāk śabdaḥ arciḥ vyañjakatvasāmānyāt; arciśca vyañjakam, tathā vāk śabdaḥ abhidheyavyañjakaḥ.
analyzed: puruṣaḥ vai agniḥ gautama prasiddhaḥ śiraḥ pāṇi ādimān puruṣaḥ caturthaḥ agniḥ tasya vyāttam vivṛtam mukham samidh vivṛtena hi mukhena dīpyate puruṣaḥ vacana svādhyāya ādau yathā samidhā agniḥ prāṇaḥ dhūmaḥ tad utthāna sāmānyāt mukhāt hi prāṇaḥ uttiṣṭhati vāc śabdaḥ arciḥ vyañjaka tva sāmānyāt arciḥ ca vyañjakam tathā vāc śabdaḥ abhidheya vyañjakaḥ

original: cakṣuḥ aṅgārāḥ, upaśamasāmānyāt prakāśāśrayatvādvā. śrotraṃ visphuliṅgāḥ, vikṣepasāmānyāt. tasmin annaṃ juhvati. nanu naiva devā annamiha juhvato dṛśyante --- naiṣa doṣaḥ, prāṇānāṃ devatvopapatteḥ; adhidaivam indrādayo devāḥ; te eva adhyātmaṃ prāṇāḥ; te ca annasya puruṣe prakṣeptāraḥ; tasyā āhuteḥ retaḥ saṃbhavati; annapariṇāmo hi retaḥ.
analyzed: cakṣuḥ aṅgārāḥ upaśama sāmānyāt prakāśa āśraya tvāt vā śrotram visphuliṅgāḥ vikṣepa sāmānyāt tasmin annam juhvati nanu na eva devāḥ annam iha juhvataḥ dṛśyante na eṣa doṣaḥ prāṇānām deva tva upapatteḥ adhidaivam indra ādayaḥ devāḥ te eva adhyātmam prāṇāḥ te ca annasya puruṣe prakṣeptāraḥ tasyāḥ āhuteḥ retaḥ saṃbhavati anna pariṇāmaḥ hi retaḥ

original: yoṣā vā agnirgautama. yoṣeti strī pañcamo homādhikaraṇam agniḥ tasyāḥ upastha eva samit; tena hi sā samidhyate. lomāni dhūmaḥ, tadutthānasāmānyāt. yoniḥ arciḥ, varṇasāmānyāt. yadantaḥ karoti, te'ṅgārāḥ; antaḥkaraṇaṃ maithunavyāpāraḥ, te'ṅgārāḥ, vīryopaśamahetutvasāmānyāt; vīryādyupaśamakāraṇaṃ maithunam, tathā aṅgārabhāvaḥ agnerupaśamakāraṇam.
analyzed: yoṣā vai agniḥ gautama yoṣā iti strī pañcamaḥ homa adhikaraṇam agniḥ tasyāḥ upasthaḥ eva samidh tena hi sā samidhyate lomāni dhūmaḥ tad utthāna sāmānyāt yoniḥ arciḥ varṇa sāmānyāt yat antar karoti teṅgārāḥ antaḥkaraṇam maithuna vyāpāraḥ teṅgārāḥ vīrya upaśama hetu tva sāmānyāt vīrya ādi upaśama kāraṇam maithunam tathā aṅgāra bhāvaḥ agneḥ upaśama kāraṇam

original: abhinandāḥ sukhalavāḥ kṣudratvasāmānyāt visphuliṅgāḥ. tasmin reto juhvati. tasyā āhuteḥ puruṣaḥ saṃbhavati. evaṃ dyuparjanyāyaṃlokapuruṣayoṣāgniṣu krameṇa hūyamānāḥ śraddhāsomavṛṣṭyannaretobhāvena sthūlatāratamyakramamāpadyamānāḥ śraddhāśabdavācyā āpaḥ puruṣaśabdamārabhante.
analyzed: abhinandāḥ sukha lavāḥ kṣudra tva sāmānyāt visphuliṅgāḥ tasmin retaḥ juhvati tasyāḥ āhuteḥ puruṣaḥ saṃbhavati evam dyu parjanya ayam loka puruṣa yoṣā agniṣu krameṇa hūyamānāḥ śraddhā soma vṛṣṭi anna retaḥ bhāvena sthūla tāratamya kramam āpadyamānāḥ śraddhā śabda vācyāḥ āpaḥ puruṣa śabdam ārabhante

original: yaḥ praśnaḥ caturthaḥ 'vettha yatithyāmāhutyāṃ hutāyāmāpaḥ puruṣavāco bhūtvā samutthāya vadantī3' iti, sa eṣa nirṇītaḥ --- pañcamyāmāhutau yoṣāgnau hutāyāṃ retobhūtā āpaḥ puruṣavāco bhavantīti. sa puruṣaḥ evaṃ krameṇa jāto jīvati; kiyantaṃ kālamityucyate --- yāvajjīvati yāvadasmin śarīre sthitinimittaṃ karma vidyate, tāvadityarthaḥ.
analyzed: yaḥ praśnaḥ caturthaḥ vettha yatithyām āhutyām hutāyām āpaḥ puruṣa vācaḥ bhūtvā samutthāya vadanti iti saḥ eṣa nirṇītaḥ pañcamyām āhutau yoṣā agnau hutāyām retaḥ bhūtāḥ āpaḥ puruṣa vācaḥ bhavanti iti sa puruṣaḥ evam krameṇa jātaḥ jīvati kiyantam kālam iti ucyate yāvat jīvati yāvat asmin śarīre sthiti nimittam karma vidyate tāvat iti arthaḥ

analyzed: atha tad kṣaye yadā yasmin kāle mriyate

original: atha tadā enaṃ mṛtam agnaye agnyarthameva antyāhutyai haranti ṛtvijaḥ; tasya āhutibhūtasya prasiddhaḥ agnireva homādhikaraṇam, na parikalpyo'gniḥ; prasiddhaiva samit samit; dhūmo dhūmaḥ; arciḥ arciḥ; aṅgārā aṅgārāḥ; visphuliṅgā visphuliṅgāḥ; yathāprasiddhameva sarvamityarthaḥ. tasmin puruṣam antyāhutiṃ juhvati;
analyzed: atha tadā enam mṛtam agnaye agni artham eva antyāhutyai haranti ṛtvijaḥ tasya āhuti bhūtasya prasiddhaḥ agniḥ eva homa adhikaraṇam na parikalpya ugniḥ prasiddhā eva samidh samidh dhūmaḥ dhūmaḥ arciḥ arciḥ aṅgārāḥ aṅgārāḥ visphuliṅgāḥ visphuliṅgāḥ yathā prasiddham eva sarvam iti arthaḥ tasmin puruṣam antyāhutim juhvati

original: tasyai āhutyai āhuteḥ, puruṣaḥ bhāsvaravarṇaḥ atiśayadīptimān, niṣekādibhirantyāhutyantaiḥ karmabhiḥ saṃskṛtatvāt, saṃbhavati niṣpadyate.
analyzed: tasyai āhutyai āhuteḥ puruṣaḥ bhāsvara varṇaḥ atiśaya dīptimān niṣeka ādibhiḥ antya āhuti antaiḥ karmabhiḥ saṃskṛta tvāt saṃbhavati niṣpadyate

original: idānīṃ prathamapraśnanirākaraṇārthamāha --- te; ke? ye evaṃ yathoktaṃ pañcāgnidarśanametat viduḥ; evaṃśabdāt agnisamiddhūmārciraṅgāravisphuliṅgaśraddhādiviśiṣṭāḥ pañcāgnayo nirdiṣṭāḥ; tān evam etān pañcāgnīn vidurityarthaḥ.
analyzed: idānīm prathama praśna nirākaraṇa artham āha te ke ye evam yathoktam pañcāgni darśanam etat viduḥ evaṃśabdāt agni samidh dhūma arciḥ aṅgāra visphuliṅga śraddhā ādi viśiṣṭāḥ pañca agnayaḥ nirdiṣṭāḥ tān evam etān pañca agnīn viduḥ iti arthaḥ

original: nanu agnihotrāhutidarśanaviṣayameva etaddarśanam; tatra hi uktam utkrāntyādipadārthaṣaṭkanirṇaye 'divamevāhavanīyaṃ kurvāte' ityādi; ihāpi amuṣya lokasyāgnitvam, ādityasya ca samittvamityādi bahu sāmyam; tasmāt
analyzed: nanu agnihotra āhuti darśana viṣayam eva etat darśanam tatra hi uktam utkrānti ādi padārtha ṣaṭka nirṇaye divam eva āhavanīyam kurvāte ityādi iha api amuṣya lokasya agni tvam ādityasya ca samidh tvam ityādi bahu sāmyam tasmāt

original: taccheṣameva etaddarśanamiti --- na, yatithyāmiti praśnaprativacanaparigrahāt; yatithyāmityasya praśnasya prativacanasya yāvadeva parigrahaḥ, tāvadeva evaṃśabdena parāmraṣṭuṃ yuktam, anyathā praśnānarthakyāt; nirjñātatvācca saṃkhyāyāḥ agnaya eva vaktavyāḥ; atha nirjñātamapyanūdyate, yathāprāptasyaiva anuvadanaṃ yuktam, na tu 'asau loko'gniḥ' iti;
analyzed: tad śeṣam eva etat darśanam iti na yatithyām iti praśna prativacana parigrahāt yatithyām iti asya praśnasya prativacanasya yāvat eva parigrahaḥ tāvat eva evaṃśabdena parāmraṣṭum yuktam anyathā praśna ānarthakyāt nirjñāta tvāt ca saṃkhyāyāḥ agnayaḥ eva vaktavyāḥ atha nirjñātam api anūdyate yathā prāptasya eva anuvadanam yuktam na tu asau lokaḥ agniḥ iti

original: atha upalakṣaṇārthaḥ, tathāpi ādyena antyena ca upalakṣaṇaṃ yuktam. śrutyantarācca; samāne hi prakaraṇe chāndogyaśrutau 'pañcāgnīnveda' iti pañcasaṃkhyāyā evopādānāt anagnihotraśeṣam etat pañcāgnidarśanam. yattu agnisamidādisāmānyam, tat agnihotrastutyarthamityavocāma;
analyzed: atha upalakṣaṇa arthaḥ tathā api ādyena antyena ca upalakṣaṇam yuktam śruti antarāt ca samāne hi prakaraṇe chāndogya śrutau pañca agnīn veda iti pañca saṃkhyāyāḥ eva upādānāt an agnihotra śeṣam etat pañca agni darśanam yat tu agni samidh ādi sāmānyam tat agnihotra stuti artham iti avocāma

original: tasmāt na utkrāntyādipadārthaṣaṭkaparijñānāt arcirādipratipattiḥ, evamiti prakṛtopādānena arcirādipratipattividhānāt.
analyzed: tasmāt na utkrānti ādi padārtha ṣaṭka parijñānāt arciḥ ādi pratipattiḥ evam iti prakṛta upādānena arciḥ ādi pratipatti vidhānāt

original: ke punaste, ye evaṃ viduḥ? gṛhasthā eva. nanu teṣāṃ yajñādisādhanena dhūmādipratipattiḥ vidhitsitā --- na, anevaṃvidāmapi gṛhasthānāṃ yajñādisādhanopapatteḥ, bhikṣuvānaprasthayośca araṇyasaṃbandhena grahaṇāt, gṛhasthakarmasaṃbaddhatvācca pañcāgnidarśanasya. ataḥ nāpi brahmacāriṇaḥ 'evaṃ viduḥ' iti gṛhyante;
analyzed: ke punar te ye evam viduḥ gṛhasthāḥ eva nanu teṣām yajña ādi sādhanena dhūma ādi pratipattiḥ vidhitsitā na anevaṃvidām api gṛhasthānām yajña ādi sādhana upapatteḥ bhikṣu vānaprasthayoḥ ca araṇya saṃbandhena grahaṇāt gṛhastha karma saṃbaddha tvāt ca pañcāgni darśanasya atas na api brahmacāriṇaḥ evam viduḥ iti gṛhyante

original: teṣāṃ tu uttare pathi praveśaḥ smṛtiprāmāṇyāt --- 'aṣṭāśītisahasrāṇāmṛṣīṇāmūrdhvaretasām. uttareṇāryamṇaḥ panthāste'mṛtatvaṃ hi bhejire' iti.
analyzed: teṣām tu uttare pathi praveśaḥ smṛti prāmāṇyāt aṣṭāśīti sahasrāṇām ṛṣīṇām ūrdhvaretasām uttareṇa aryamṇaḥ panthāḥ te mṛta tvam hi bhejire iti

original: tasmāt ye gṛhasthāḥ evam --- agnijo'ham, agnyapatyam --- iti, evam krameṇa agnibhyo jātaḥ agnirūpaḥ ityevam, ye viduḥ, te ca, ye ca amī araṇye vānaprasthāḥ parivrājakāścāraṇyanityāḥ, śraddhāṃ śraddhāyuktāḥ santaḥ, satyaṃ brahma hiraṇyagarbhātmānamupāsate, na punaḥ śraddhāṃ ca upāsate, te sarve'rcirabhisaṃbhavanti.
analyzed: tasmāt ye gṛhasthāḥ evam agni joham agni apatyam iti evam krameṇa agnibhyaḥ jātaḥ agni rūpaḥ iti evam ye viduḥ te ca ye ca amī araṇye vānaprasthāḥ parivrājakāḥ ca araṇya nityāḥ śraddhām śraddhā yuktāḥ santaḥ satyam brahma hiraṇyagarbha ātmānam upāsate na punar śraddhām ca upāsate te sarva īrciḥ abhisaṃbhavanti

original: yāvat gṛhasthāḥ pañcāgnividyāṃ satyaṃ vā brahma na viduḥ, tāvat śraddhādyāhutikrameṇa pañcamyāmāhutau hutāyāṃ tato yoṣāgnerjātāḥ, punarlokaṃ pratyutthāyinaḥ agnihotrādikarmānuṣṭhātāro bhavanti; tena karmaṇā dhūmādikrameṇa punaḥ pitṛlokam, punaḥ parjanyādikrameṇa imam āvartante.
analyzed: yāvat gṛhasthāḥ pañcāgni vidyām satyam vā brahma na viduḥ tāvat śraddhā ādi āhuti krameṇa pañcamyām āhutau hutāyām tatas yoṣā agneḥ jātāḥ punar lokam pratyutthāyinaḥ agnihotra ādi karma anuṣṭhātāraḥ bhavanti tena karmaṇā dhūma ādi krameṇa punar pitṛ lokam punar parjanya ādi krameṇa imam āvartante

original: tataḥ punaryoṣāgnerjātāḥ punaḥ karma kṛtvā --- ityevameva ghaṭīyantravat gatyāgatibhyāṃ punaḥ punaḥ āvartante. yadā tu evaṃ viduḥ, tato ghaṭīyantrabhramaṇādvinirmuktāḥ santaḥ arcirabhisaṃbhavanti; arciriti na agnijvālāmātram, kiṃ tarhi arcirabhimāninī arciḥśabdavācyā devatā uttaramārgalakṣaṇā vyavasthitaiva; tāmabhisaṃbhavanti;
analyzed: tatas punar yoṣā agneḥ jātāḥ punar karma kṛtvā iti evam eva ghaṭīyantra vat gati āgatibhyām punar punar āvartante yadā tu evam viduḥ tatas ghaṭīyantra bhramaṇāt vinirmuktāḥ santaḥ arciḥ abhisaṃbhavanti arciḥ iti na agni jvālā mātram kim tarhi arciḥ abhimāninī arciḥ śabda vācyā devatā uttara mārga lakṣaṇā vyavasthitā eva tām abhisaṃbhavanti
